tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /man ngag rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ u pa de sha rat+na ko ṣa nā ma/ bod skad du/ man ngag rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje mchog gi ye shes gru chen gyis/ /srid gsum rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin gyur cing*/ /ded dpon yid bzhin sa mthor rab gshegs pa'i/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal bzang rab mchog thar pa 'dod rnams la/ /mdo rgyud man ngag snying po'i bcud bsdus te/ /yang zab gnad rnams ma lus bstan pa ni/ /drug tshan drug gis bshad kyis gus pas nyon/ /de la thog mar 'jug pa'i chos drug ni/ /lam gyi gzhi rten bslab gsum bsrung ba dang*/ /sna tshogs thos bsam phyogs med bya ba dang*/ /sgo gsum zhi zhing rang rgyud gdul ba dang*/ /sdig la 'dzem zhing dge ba spel ba dang*/ /ngo tsha khrel yod dad pa bskyed pa dang*/ /dge ba'i bshes dang dge grogs bsten pa ste/ /dang po'i las can rnams la shin tu gces/ /de nas gcig pu dben par gnas 'dod na/ /sta gon bya ba'i chos drug gces pa ste/ /bla ma dang bral rang rkya thub pa dang*/ /the tshom gegs sel dri rgyu med pa dang*/ /lus la nad gdon bar chad med pa dang*/ /mi chos khyu nas legs par bud pa dang*/ /don gnyis bsgrub pa'i gdams pa tshang ba dang*/ /lta ba'i dgongs pa blo thag chod pa'o/ /de nas dgon pa bsten pa'i chos drug ni/ /sa phyogs dben zhing mtshan nyid tshang ba dang*/ /grub thob gong mas zhabs kyis bcags pa dang*/ /nyams grib med pas dam can 'du ba dang*/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i rkyen rnams med pa dang*/ /mthun rkyen yo byad bsgrub par sla ba dang*/ /mi dang mi min 'tshe ba med pa'o/ /de nas mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'i rdzas (1) drug ni/ /bza' btung 'tsho ba mtha' gnyis ma lhung dang*/ /dgos pa'i mchod rdzas bsgrub rdzas tshogs pa dang*/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag dpe cha tshang ba dang*/

/bar chad bzlog pa'i rten 'brel mthun rdzas dang*/ /gang dgos yan lag tshags su tshud pa dang*/ /nor rdzas mang po'i skyed 'brel med pa'o/ /de nas grogs mchog mthun pa'i chos drug ni/ /rigs rgyud bzang zhing ngang rgyud dul ba dang*/ /dad dang brtson 'grus shes rab che ba dang*/ /nyams len mthun zhing 'grogs na bde ba dang*/ /nga rgyal chung zhing dbang po dul ba dang*/ /dam tshig gtsang zhing dag snang che ba dang*/ / brtse gdung che zhing zab mo'i gsang thub bsten/ /nyams len mthar thug dam pa'i chos drug ni/ /rgyab brten lung sbyor gtan tshigs gtan la phab/ /man ngag gnad bsnun sa lam rim pa rdzogs/ /mtho dman kun 'dren mtha' 'dzin bral ba'o/ /sgrub pa bsran tshugs mthar phyin chos drug ni/ /gsod kyang dam pa'i chos las blo mi ldog /na yang log par lta ba mi skye zhing*/ /dam bca' ngo srung bar chod kyis mi shigs*/ /mnyam gzhag myong ba rjes thob bsre nus shing*/ /ma grub bar du brtson pa 'dor mi byed/ /spang gnyen thug phrad ro snyoms nus pa'o/ /de nas bsam par byed pa'i chos drug ni/ /le lan thams cad rang las byung ba dang*/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sngon gyi las las byung*/ /sngon las de yang 'phral gyi rkyen las byung*/ /rkyen ngan rang gi kun rtog g.yo las byung*/ / de yang 'khrul pa'i yul phyir 'brangs las byung*/ /de yis thar lam sgrib pa bsam pa'o/ /nyes kun rang gis byas pa'i chos drug ni/ /skye shi'i sdug bsngal rang las byung bas te/ /btsal gyis ma rnyed 'tshol ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ /'tsho skyong sdug bsngal rang gi ched kar byas/ /dgra gnyen gnyis la chags sdang 'dzin pa yis/ /dgra phrad gnyen bral sdug bsngal rang gis byas*/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal chen po yang*/ /gzhan min rang gi las kyis byas pa'o/ /nyes snang ngan rtog 'khrul pa'i chos drug ni/ /rang sems ma thul gnod byed zad med dang*/

/gnod byed snang ba rang snang ma dag dang*/ /grag stong sgra la rang gar rjes gcod dang*/ /rang yan sems la dgag sgrub 'dzin pa dang*/ / bde sdug nges med nges par 'dzin pa dang*/ /khong khro 'khon ngan rang rgyud sreg pa'o/ /'khrul snang bzlog pa don chen chos drug ni/ /gnod la bzod bya snying rje bskyed pa dang*/ /'drer rtog mi gzung pha ma ltar shes dang*/ /'khrul par zhen la bden med rtsal sbyong dang*/ /'khrul rtsa sems kyi rtsa ba bcad pa dang*/ /gang snang rkyen rnams lam du bsgyur ba dang*/ /tha mal ma yengs gnyen po bsten pa'o/ / 'khor ba'i rang rgyud nyen pa'i chos drug ni/ /lus sems sdug bsngal ma bral bde ba med/ /tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal btsal bas 'bral dus med/ /rang lus dbang ma thob pas bde don med/ /dar la snyugs ring bde ba'i go skabs med/ /las ma zad par 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal lo/ /cis kyang dgos med bsam pa'i chos drug ni/ /lam sna ma zin gang byas dgos pa med/ /dge ba ma bsgrubs cis kyang dgos pa med/ /chos la ma spyad tshe ring dgos pa med/ /chos min gzhan gyis phan btags dgos pa med*/ /tshogs gnyis ma bsags yo byad dgos pa med/ /byang chub ma bsgrubs cis kyang dgos med bsam/ /thar lam ded dpon bla ma'i chos drug ni/ /mun par 'khyams la ye shes sgron me sbor/ /g.yang sar 'khyams rnams yang dag lam la 'dzud/ /chu bos khyer ba bde chen gzings kyis 'dzin/ /btson rar tshud rnams rnam grol sa la 'dren/ /sdug bsngal 'dam bying thar pa'i skam sar 'don/ /gzung 'dzin bcings rnams ye shes ral gris gcod/ /de phyir bla ma sangs rgyas nyid du bsam/ /'dus byas mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos drug ni/ /rgyu rkyen 'dus phyir 'jig pa nyid dang ni/ /sngar skyes ma lus shi bas 'jig nges dang*/ /snod bcud mi rtag 'gyur bas 'jig nges dang*/ /tshe la nges med 'chi bas 'jig pa dang*/

/nyin mtshan skad cig 'gro bas 'jig pa dang*/ /skyes mtha' 'chi bar nges phyir 'jig pa bsam/ /de nas chos la sbyar ba'i phan yon drug /mos dang rna bar thos dang yi rang dang*/ /bstod dang zhugs dang cung zad spyad rnams kyang*/ /'khor ba mtha' can thar ba'i sa bon bskrun/ /tshul bzhin spyad pa'i phan yon rnam pa drug /kun gyis bkur dang bstod dang lhas bsrung dang*/ /tshe 'dir bde mang shi 'phos mtho ris 'gro/ /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'grub pa'o/ /chos dang mi ldan nyes pa rnam drug ni/ /ma rig gis bsgribs rgan mo long ma 'dra/ /srid par slu mkhas smad 'tshong bu mo 'dra/ /don med g.yeng bas tshong 'dus ltad mo 'dra/ / snang ba 'brid mkhas bu chung 'tsho ba 'dra/ /rig pa col chung byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ /'khrul snang bcad dka' nya mo rgyas zin 'dra/ /don chung las la mi tshe zad par byed/ /chos las nyams pa'i nyes pa rnam drug ni/ /rang bas dman pas brnyas par 'gyur ba dang*/ /lha mi'i gnas su gtam ngan grags pa dang*/ /mi gtsang snod bzhin dam pas spang ba dang*/ /bsrung ba'i lhas 'dor bar chad mang ba dang*/ /bsam pa mi 'grub bsod nams dpal nyams dang*/ /phyi mar ngan song sdug bsngal myong ba'o/ /phyi dus re ba'i nyes pa rnam drug ni/ /dal 'byor thob dus chos lam ma bsgrubs na/ /yeng ma'i lam la mi tshe zad pa dang*/ /'chi ba nges med thog rdzis 'ong ba dang*/ /shi nas 'khor ba ngan song ltung ba dang*/ /sdug bsngal drag pos lus sems gdungs pa dang*/ /'gyod pa dran yang shin tu mnar ba dang*/ /thar ba'i dus med yun ring gnas pa'o/ /'khor ba'i gnas la 'jigs pa'i chos drug ni/ /mi rnams sdug bsngal bsams na yid re skyo/ /lha min sdug bsngal bsams na skyi re g.ya'/ /lha yi sdug bsngal bsams na g.yang re za/ /byol song sdug bsngal bsams na ngu re bro/ /yi dwags sdug bsngal bsams na skyi re bung*/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bsams na snying re 'dar/

/de bas 'gro drug gnas nas 'bros re ran/ /ran pa bas kyang phyis par gyur pa tsam/ /de las thar bar byed pa'i chos drug ni/ /rtag lta yul phyung phyi dus le lo bor/ /sang phod bcas zhog ci yod chos la thong*/ /tha mal spyod bor bstan pa'i srol du zhugs/ /stobs bzhi'i gnyen pos las ngan sdig pa sbyongs/ /chos spyod rnam bcus tshogs gnyis ci nus sogs/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum chos kyi lam du chug /de yis 'khor ba'i gnas las myur du thar/ /chos kyi bar gcod nor pa rnam drug ni/ /che btsan dregs pas g.yengs pa'i chen po nor/ /mi chos bya ba bsgrub pa'i btsun pa nor/ /tha snyad mi tshe 'da' ba'i ston pa nor/ /dug lngas rang rgyud bsreg pa'i sngags pa nor/ /blun rmongs log 'tsho bsgrub pa'i sgom chen nor/ /blo ltos 'khrul snang 'cha' ba'i skye bo nor/ /nor pa spangs nas chos la brtson pa gces/ /ma nor phan par byed pa'i chos drug ni/ /brtse ba'i gdams ngag bla ma'i gsung la nyon/ /yid ches gtad sa rgyal ba'i bka' lung ltos/ / nyin mtshan thun mtshams dge sdig bsngo bgrang gyis/ /phyi ma gar 'gro rgyu 'bras rten 'brel soms/ /lus dang longs spyod gces 'dzin chags zhen spongs/ / rgyud lung man ngag sems kyi steng du phob/ /de ltar byas na myur du sangs rgyas 'grub/ /tshul bzhin legs par blta ba'i chos drug ni/ /'jig rten bya bas phan pa 'dug gam ltos/ /bsags pa'i nor rdzas bzhag nas song ba ltos/ / phan btags lan du gnod pa skyel la ltos/ /mang po'i nang nas gcig pur song ba ltos/ /so nam gsog brun rang shi rang dbang ltos/ /che btsan snyan grags bor nas song ba ltos/ /de ltar bltas nas rang la nang du sbyor/ /yang dag don chen 'gyod med rnam drug ni/ /chos phyir dka' spyad shi yang 'gyod pa med/ /dman pa'i sa bzung kha (1) nyen 'gyod pa med/ /pha yul rgyab skyur mdo chung 'gyod pa med/

/chos phyir nor btang ltogs kyang 'gyod pa med/ /sdig spangs ngan song song yang 'gyod pa med/ /snod ngan chos dang ring ba rnam drug ni/ /phag bzhin ci rnyed za bas bsgrub mi nus/ /rang mthong rma bya 'dra bas 'grogs mi shes/ /chig (2) tshugs pha bong 'dra bas skabs mi phyed/ /kun 'dzugs bze ma 'dra bas dam mi thub/ /sbrul bzhin gdug rtsub che bas rgyud mi thul/ /sprel bzhin spyam la 'byor bas bsgrub mi tshugs/ /glang bzhin shes rab blun pas chos mi go /de phyir 'di dag spangs nas bsgrub pa gces/ /snod ngan dbang du mi gtong chos drug ni/ /tshe 'dir blo 'jug byur ngan sgor dbyung zhing*/ /dge la spro ba dpal yin phugs su chug /nga rgyal rang mthong 'dre ngan bskrad bya zhing*/ /dman pa'i sa 'dzin dngos grub snga ltas bsten/ /gnyen po mchog 'dzin bdud dpung bor bya zhing*/ /rnam rtog grogs 'char ltas ngan g.yang du khug /de rnams ldan na chos rab bzang po'i snod/ /mthar phyin chos kyi blo sna rnams drug ni/ /'chi bdag 'jigs bskyed gshed mas bdas 'dra dang*/ /'khor bar skyo bskyed khyo ngan chung ma 'dra/ /'khrul snang zhen log skyugs nad zas mthong 'dra/ /mi chos yid byung mdza' bos bslus pa 'dra/ /so nam sgyid lug sad khungs zhing ngan 'dra/ /nye 'brel gdung chad dgrar langs bu tsha 'dra/ /de dang ldan pas dam chos tshad du phyin/ /de dang mi ldan 'gro ba rnam drug ni/ /thos pa byas kyang tshig gi rtsod pa mkhan/ /bshad pa byas kyang phrag dog kha sbyang mkhan/ /sgom pa byas kyang rnam rtog yid smon mkhan/ /bsam pa byas kyang zas nor khe spogs mkhan/ /gcig pur bsdad kyang nyon mongs rnam rtog mkhan/ /srung sdom byas kyang nyon mongs kha gsag mkhan/ /'gro ba drug ldan brtags te ring du spang*/ /nang du rang la blta ba'i chos drug ni/ /'khor ba'i gnas dang 'brel ba chod dam blta/ /dgra gnyen gnyis la chags sdang 'dug gam blta/

/'gro dus bzang po'i nom pa 'dug gam blta/ /bsgom dus grub rtags tshad du skyol lam blta/ /gzhan don shul du dad pa log gam blta/ /'chi dus dag pa'i snang ba 'char ram blta/ /de ltar bltas na 'dun ma legs pa'i rtse/ /chos dang ring gyur nyes pa rnam drug ni/ /don chen mi sgrub 'chi ba ma dran las/ /che btsan bsgrub pa bslu bar ma shes las/ /gnyen bshes brtse gdung 'bral bar ma shes las/ /'dod yon sred pa nyes mang ma shes las/ /nor rdzas gsog 'jog 'jog par ma shes las/ /sgom sgrub le lo mi rtag ma shes las/ /byung ba'i nyes pa 'di kun spang bar mdzod/ /rang rgyud chos dang 'dres pa'i chos drug ni/ /zhen pa rang log ro gos g.yang skyur 'dra/ /snying rjes rgyud brlan bu gcig ma dang 'dra/ /yon tan shugs skyes dbyar ka'i sa gzhi 'dra/ /brtson pa rgyun ring ral gri'i 'khor lo 'dra/ /'khrul snang rang grol sbrul gyi mdud pa 'dra/ /gnas lugs ngang phyin ded dpon yul slebs 'dra/ /de 'dra'i tshad ldan skyes mchog gong ma lags/ /chos dang mi mthun 'khrul pa'i chos drug ni/ /'khor bar zhen pa'i blo ni 'bral re dka'/ /sa zin med pa'i rig pa bslu re sla/ /tshogs drug yul gyi 'khrul ba 'brid re mkhas/ /don med 'khor ba'i bya ba 'phro re gshin/ /nyin mtshan gnyis kyis tshe 'dzad 'gro re mgyogs/ /don chung mi tshe skyel ba grangs re mang*/ /'di dag bsams nas dam pa'i chos mdzod kye/ /yang dag don la bskul ba'i chos drug ni/ /slu nges chags sdang gnyis pos nam slu'am/ /'bral nges lus sems 'di gnyis nam 'bral lam/ /khyer nges 'byung bzhi'i g.yar po nam khyer ram/ /nub nges tshe 'di'i snang ba nam nub bam/ /'jog nges sgyu ma'i nor rdzas nam 'jog gam/ /yong nges 'chi bdag thog rdzis nam yong ngam/ /snyam du snying nas nyin mtshan bsam par bya/ /rang rgyud chos dang bsre ba'i chos drug ni/

/'dod pa zad 'dod chog shes sems la bsten/ /dgra sdang zad 'dod khong khro nang du thul/ /gzhan don 'grub 'dod sems bskyed rgyud la sbyor/ /gzhan snang 'dul 'dod byin rlabs nang du sbor/ /zhing khams sbyong 'dod rang rig 'od gsal sbyongs/ /sdug bsngal zhi 'dod bde chen nang du sbor/ /nang gi rten 'brel phyi ru 'char ba yin/ /dal 'byor thob kyang snying med chos drug ni/ /ma rig gnyen po thos bsam 'dor ba dang/ /byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma spong ba dang*/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam spong ba dang*/ /bsgrub bya'i rtsa ba bsam gtan phyi bshol dang*/ /sdig sgrib chags shing nad gdon spong blo dang*/ /gzhan snang dang byed spyod lam 'gal ba rnams/ /snying med mi la khab len lcags bzhin 'du/ /gang zag rnams kyi skyon drug dor ba ni/ /zhe bcad med pa'i bya mang mgo mi thon/ /gnyen bshes brtse gdung chags sdang sgrog mi thar/ /zas la rngam pa lto gos khol por 'chor/ /kha lta'i rbad kham snying po'i don la 'dred/ /'dun pa skye dus ma 'bad 'grub dus med/ /da lta ma 'dris bar dor las stobs gcog /de bas skyon drug brtags te spang ba gces/ /blta thabs drug gis rang rgyud gdul ba ni/ /yul la bden 'dzin dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog ltos/ /tshe la rtag 'dzin rtswa kha'i zil ba ltos/ /rgyu 'bras rmongs na sa bon myu gu ltos/ /snang sems ma shes nyal ba'i rmi lam ltos/ /ro gcig ma shes bu ram gzugs brnyan ltos/ /gnyis med ma shes chu dang chab rom ltos/ /de ltar bltas pas so so'i gnyen po

(1) che/ /'du shes drug gis lam du bslang ba ni/ /bla ma mchog la sman pa'i 'du shes dang*/ / mched grogs nad g.yog nyams len nad gso dang*/ /rang la nad pa chos la sman dang ni/ /'bras bu nad sos lta bur bsam bya yis/ /phyin ci log tu sems pa dor bar bya/ /legs par spyad las nges pa rnam drug ni/ /bla ma bsten pas byin rlabs 'ong bar nges/ /yi dam bsgoms pas dngos grub 'ong bar nges/ /dam tshig bsrungs pas dam can 'du bar nges/ /nyams len brtson pas nyams rtogs 'char bar nges/ /gnas lugs bskyangs pas sgrib gnyis 'byang bar nges/ /yeng med rtsal skyongs (2) yon tan 'char bar nges/ /rang bzhin shes pas skrag pa rnam drug ni/ /'jig rten bya ba glang chen 'dam tshud dang*/ /gnyen 'brel brtse gdung btson ra'i srung ma dang*/ /tshe 'di'i longs spyod khyi rgan rus 'cha' dang*/ /ma rig sdig spyod g.yang kha'i dmus long dang*/ /dug lnga'i nyon mongs dug sbrul gtses pa dang*/ /yul drug chags pa sbrang bu rtsis zin ltar/ /skrag pa bskyed nas ring du dor ba gces/ /'jig rten mi chos nyes pa rnam drug ni/ /yul mkhar 'dzin pa dmyal ba'i lcags khang dang*/ /bu dang chung ma ral gri lo ma'i tshal/ / rgyan dang gos bzang me lce 'bar ba 'dra/ /bza' btung bsregs pa lcags kyi tho lum dang/ /bran g.yog las mi dmyal ba'i srung ma dang*/ /khro dang 'thab rtsod mdag me'i ser ba ltar/ /dge legs 'joms pa'i gnas su mkhyen par mdzod/ /'dod la nyes par shes pa'i chos drug ni/ /'dod pas tshe 'dir lus sems gdung ba dang*/ /phyi mar ngan 'gro gtan du 'khor bar 'khyam/ /kun dang rtsod bcas mi dge ngang gis 'phel/ /dge ba 'grib phyir dam pa rnams kyis smad/ /chags pas 'ching ba'i skyon drug bstan pa ni/ /lus ni mi gtsang kun gyi snod dang ni/ /rtsa rgyus rus pa 'brel ba'i dra ba dang*/ /rnag dang chu ser ngan skyugs gshang gci'i rdzing*/

/bu ga dgu yi lam dang bcas pa dang*/ /snod drug don lnga srin bu'i grong khyer dang*/ /gdos bcas nad kun 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du/ /mi shes lus la chags pas bslu bar 'gyur/ /don med snying po med pa'i chos drug ni/ /sna tshogs yul du snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /mi rtag myur du 'jig pas chu bur 'dra/ /gang yang snying po med pas chu shing 'dra/ /'khrul bas byis pa bslus pas smig rgyu 'dra/ /med bzhin sna tshogs snang bas sgyu ma 'dra/ / bag chags dbang gis snang bas rmi lam 'dra/ /ring du mi gnas 'gyur bas glog dang 'dra/ /de ltar shes rnams srid pa'i pha rol 'gro/ /chos byed tha ma 'jug pa'i tshul drug ni/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mthong bas lam sna 'tshol/ / ci byas don med go bas khe grags chung*/ /nga rgyal 'dod blo chung bas dman sa 'dzin/ /dad brtson grogs dang 'grogs pas nyams len brtson/ /theg chen rigs skyes dman pas blo mi khengs/ /shes bya'i gnas la dad pas gang la'ang mos/ /dam pa rnams kyi 'jug sgo dang po yin/ /chos byed 'bring gi dgos pa'i chos drug ni/ /so nam rmo rko zhing chu'i mu mi bsrung*/ /lang tsho khe spogs tshong gi khur mi khur/ /ngo bsrung bang chen gnyen bshes sems mi 'dzin/ /zhe sdang phyogs ris 'thab rtsod bya ba dor/ /gsog brun phyi rtsis gnas kyi mkhar len spang*/ /'du 'dzi'i bdud las mi chen bshes 'dris med/ /chos mdzad rnams kyi 'jug sdom gnyis pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rab kyi dur khrod chos drug ni/ /tha mal 'go bas mi dang mi 'grogs shing*/ /sgo gsum spyod sbas ci byed mis mi mthong*/ /zas gos mi gnyer ro zas ro gos 'tsho/ /nyam nga med pas mkha' 'gro'i spyod pa byed/ /gsang spyod nyams skyong tha mal spyod pa spang*/ /chos nyid ngang gnas bde chen rtogs pa ste/ /thar lam bgrod rnams 'jug srol gsum par bzhed/ /yang rab phyogs bral rnal 'byor chos drug ni/

/rang yul mi yul gang la'ang ma chags dang*/ /rtag dang chad pa'i mtha' gnyis las grol dang*/ /nye ring gang gis ngo mi shes pa dang*/ /sa gcig mi zhen sprin ltar 'phyo ba dang*/ /tshogs drug yul snang grogs su 'char ba dang*/ /bzang ngan gang la'ang ngos gzung med pa ste/ /rnam grol lam bzang 'jug sgo bzhi pa yin/ /bsgrub par 'dod pas dogs pa drug spang ste/ /ma mgu dogs dang mthun 'jug ngo srung spang*/ /med kyis dogs nas nor dang rdzas mi bsogs/ /sdug gis dogs nas phyi rtsis bya ba spang*/ /dmas kyis dogs nas mthon po'i sa mi sgrub/ /nyes kyis dogs nas mi chos 'dun ma dor/ /mthos kyis dogs nas gzhan gyi sems mi dkrugs/ /nyams len gnad kyi mtshams drug bcad pa ni/ /chags sdang bral bas phyi yi mtshams bcad dang*/ /sog 'jog med pas nang gi mtshams bcad dang*/ /gzung 'dzin bral bas gsang ba'i mtshams bcad dang*/ /bzang por re ba'i yar gyi mtshams bcad dang*/ /ngan par dogs pa'i mar gyi mtshams bcad dang*/ /bya byed dmigs 'dzin bar gyi mtshams bcad dang*/ /'di drug ldan na bar chad 'byung mi srid/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i rag las chos drug ni/ / bsgrub pa'i rten mchog dal 'byor rag las dang*/ /ma bsgrubs mi grol sgrub la rag las dang*/ /sgrub pa legs par shes la rag las dang*/ /shes pa dang po'i thos la rag las dang*/ /thos te gnad 'gro bsam la rag las dang*/ /thams cad dge ba'i bshes la rag las so/ /bzang po'i mtshan nyid rnam pa drug ldan ni/ /bsod nams bsags pas rigs bzang ngang rgyud dul/ /mkhyen rab rgyas pas shes bya'i don la mkhas/ /shes rab 'phags pas chos nyid phyogs bral rtogs/ /nyams len brtson pas nyams rtogs grub rtags thon/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas gzhan don skyo ngal med/ /gdams pa'i gnad ldan lam sna khrid par nus/ /'gro mchog skye bo dam pa'i tshul 'di dge /slob ma dam pas bsten pa'i chos drug ni/

/srid par skyo zhing 'khrul snang yid 'byung dang*/ /chos min bya ba dgos med bzhag pa dang*/ /'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng dgra ltar spang ba dang*/ khe grags lo 'dod re ltos med pa dang*/ /nye 'brel ngo srung 'brel thag chod pa dang*/ /dgra gnyen nye ring chags sdang bor ba dang*/ /'jig rten blos btang dam chos bsgrub pa'o/ /sna thag gzhan la ma shor chos drug ni/ /bran khol ma skyes dbang med mi 'bab dang*/ /khyim thab ma byas gnyis 'dus 'ching res med/ /chen por ma skyes gang 'dod chos la spyod/ /shol 'debs sgrog med nam dran gang dgar spyod/ /mi 'grub dam bca'i khas blangs med pa dang*/ /las ngan dmag dpung sdug bsngal mtsho ma brdol/ /'di 'dra'i rang dbang yod rnams spro bar rigs/ /bsgom zhing bsgrub pa'i 'tsho ba chos drug ni/ /mtha' gnyis ma lhung yo byad rang 'tsho dang*/ /zas kyi tshod rig 'grangs ltogs cha snyoms dang*/ /'byung 'khrugs nad kyi khams ma 'khrugs pa dang*/ kha zas bzang po'i lugs brgyags ma gyur dang*/ /ha cang ngan ches 'byung ba ma rgud dang*/ /nyin mtshan tshod zin dus min za ba spong*/ /'di ni dge sbyor gnad du 'gro ba'i grogs/ /dad brtson bskul 'debs rkyen gyi chos drug ni/ /rkyen ngan btud las mi rtag rgyud la skyes/ /rgyu 'bras shes nas las ngan dug bzhin spong*/ / mos gus tshud pas bla ma sangs rgyas mthong*/ /chos la nges pas dge sbyor brod pa skye/ /dge 'dun dad pas yar 'dren skyel ma zhu/ /sangs rgyas 'dod pas brtson pas ci thob byed/ /skal bzang dam pa rnams kyi lugs yin no/ /rang rgyud 'dul sbyong gdul ba'i chos drug ni/ /log blo mi rgod chos blo mi 'gyur ba/ /zhe bcad bzod dka' sdug bsran thub pa dang*/ /'khor ba'i nyes mthong skrag pas yid 'byung dang*/ /snod ngan skyon med rang rgyud dag pa dang*/ /thos bsam che bas chos mchog bstan pa rtogs/

/dbang dang dam tshig zab mo'i snod gyur pa/ /mtsho gling rin chen snod las dkon par snang*/ /nyams len rkyen ngan mi 'phrogs chos drug ni/ /lus kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs thub pa dang*/ /ngag gi mi dge don med 'chal gtam thub/ /sems kyi bde sdug legs nyes zug rngu thub/ /mi med dben par skyo ngal 'jigs skrag thub/ /'du 'dzi'i grong du yeng med gnyen po thub/ /srung sdom bslab pas yul rkyen ngan pa thub/ /de dag ldan na chos lam bde bar 'grub/ /thar lam yon tan 'dres pa rnam drug ni/ /thun mong chos 'dres phyi ma'i byang chub sgrub/ /gsang sngags chos 'dres sku gsum lam du slong*/ /mthar thug gnad 'dres mthar 'dzin gol sa chod/ /theg chen chos 'dres ci byed gzhan don spyod/ /nyan rang chos 'dres 'khor ba'i bya ba dor/ /de 'dra'i gang zag chos dang rang rgyud 'dres/ /mngon zhen a 'thas 'jig pa'i chos drug ni/ /yul drug rdzun pas 'khrul bar thag chod dang*/ /bya byed don med 'khrul par thag chod dang*/ /mngon zhen slu bas 'khrul par thag chod dang*/ /snyan grags bstod bkur 'khrul par thag chod dang*/ /dgra gnyen nges med 'khrul par thag chod dang*/ /bden med shes na 'khrul snang 'khrul 'dzin zhig /dal 'byor don dang bcas pa'i chos drug ni/ /'byor yang don med slu bas sgrub la 'bad/ /thos kyang tshig phyir 'chor bas sgrub la 'bad/ / shes kyang snying po stor bas sgrub la 'bad/ /bsam kyang rnam rtog mched phyir sgrub la 'bad/ /bshad kyang go yul lus pas sgrub la 'bad/ /ma bsgrubs mngon du mi snang sgrub la 'bad/ /'khor ba blos btang blo sbyong chos drug ni/ / don med slu bas 'jig rten bya ba btang*/ /sred pa 'phel bas 'dod yon zhen pa btang*/ /snying po med pas 'dun gros ngan pa btang*/ /thams cad 'dor bas nor rdzas zhen pa btang*/ /'dus byas bral bas gnyen 'dun gdung sems btang*/

/phung khrol rtsa ba chags sdang gzung 'dzin btang*/ /de dag btang na dam chos ngang gis 'grub/ /rgyu 'bras nges shes bskyed pa'i chos drug ni/ /sde snod nyan la rgyu 'bras yid ches bya/ /chu thigs bum khengs dpe yis tshogs gnyis bsags/ /me phras nags tshal bsregs dpes sdig pa spang*/ /skyid sdug sngon las gyur pas bsod nams bsags/ /dus gcig tshogs rdzogs min pas rim gyis slob/ /bdag 'dzin yod par las yod yid ches bya/ /nyan byed snod kyi skyon drug spang ba ni/ /dus la ma babs rdza so ma btang dang*/ /rna ba mi gtod kha bub lta bu dang*/ /thos pa mi brtan zhabs rdol lta bu dang*/ /nyon mongs dang 'dres dug can lta bu dang*/ /lam du mi 'gro dri mas sbags 'dra dang*/ /tshig gis nga rgyal snod ngan gang 'dra ba'i/ /skyon rnams spangs te legs par rab tu nyon/ /yang dag thos pa dam pa'i chos drug ni/ /shes rab mchog ldan don gnyer gzu bor gnas/ /bshes gnyen bsten dang thos pas mi ngoms shes/ /mang po la brten mkhas rnams mnyes byas shing*/ /mang po thos pas sna tshogs chos sgo phyed/ /mang du thos pas yang yang nges byas shing*/ /mang po thos dang dris shing brtsad pa ste/ /rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i chos mdzod 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de nas bsam pa dag pa'i chos drug ni/ /tshig 'dis don ni ci zhig bstan snyam dang*/ /dbye na gang yin bsdu na ji lta bu/ /rnam grangs ci zhig gang gi phyogs su gtogs/ /dril nas nyams len mtha' ni gang yin zhes/ /legs par bsams pas rin chen chos sgo 'byed/ /de nas sgom pa dag pa'i chos drug ni*/ /gnas lugs ma rmongs rtag chad mtha' las grol/ /theg chen lam gyur stong nyid snying rjer 'brel/ / chos nyid ngang gnas bying rgod yeng ba med/ /zhi lhag zung 'brel nyams rtogs gong du 'phel/ /re dogs gzung 'dzin dmigs pa mtshan ma med/ /nyon mongs sgrib pa'i gnyen por gyur pa ste/

/bsam gtan pa de srid pa'i pha rol 'gro/ / rkyen gyis rdzi ba med pa'i chos drug ni/ /bstod smad sgra la brag car shes pa dang*/ /gzhan gyi chags sdang 'dun ma byed pa dang*/ /rang gi byed spyod chos las mi 'gal dang*/ /yo byad sbyin 'bras gsog brun mi bya dang*/ /nad gdon dge bskul spang lo mi bya dang*/ /dag snang mos gus rgyun chad med pa ste/ /mi mthun rkyen rnams bsgyur ba'i dpa' bo yin/ /dri ma'i bsam ngan spang ba'i chos drug ni/ /snyan grags che ba bsgrub pa'i bsam ngan dang*/ /rnyed dang longs spyod bsgrub pa'i bsam ngan dang*/ /yul snang bden par 'dzin pa'i bsam pa dang*/ /lus ngag 'dod pas bskol ba'i bsam pa dang*/ /tshe 'di'i 'tsho ba bsgrub pa'i bsam pa dang*/ /rang nyid gcig pu thar 'dod bsam pa ste/ /bdud kyi byin rlabs las byung mkhas pas spang*/ /dbang po yul phyir ma 'brangs chos drug ni/ /rang yul chags sdang dug gis ma thebs dang*/ /'dod yon rang dga'i gdung bas ma zin dang*/ /'jig rten chos brgyad mtshon gyis ma btab dang*/ /spyod lam g.yo sgyu'i dri mas ma gos dang*/ /sna tshogs 'du 'dzi'i rlung gis ma bskyod dang*/ /nyin mtshan chos spyod bzang pos 'da' ba ste/ /dam pa rnams kyi tshul la 'jug par bya/ /dad pas khams gso thub pa'i chos drug ni/ /mos pa'i dad pas gsol 'debs bla ma sgom/ /gus pa'i dad pas dkon mchog mchod la brtson/ /yid ches dad pas yi dam sgom sgrub byed/ /dang ba'i dad pas chos nyid don la gzhol/ /mi ldog dad pas rkyen ngan grogs su bsgyur/ /mthar 'dzin dad pas rang rgyud chos dang bsre/ /de phyir thar lam sgrub pa shin tu gces/ /srung sdom ngo lkog med pa'i chos drug ni/ / bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims shes pa dang*/ /ngan song sna khrid sdig par shes pa dang*/ /srung sdom med na chos rtsa rul ba dang*/ /yon tan kun gyi rten tu shes pa dang*/

/mtho ris 'dzeg pa'i skas su shes pa dang*/ /thar ba bgrod pa'i bzhon par shes pa dang (1) / /khrims gtsang bsrung la gces spras nan tan bya/ /gnyen pos rkyen ngan thub pa'i chos drug ni/ /nyan thos bzhin du dgra ltas spong ba dang*/ /pha rol phyin ltar yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ /sngags ltar thabs kyis lam du bsgyur ba dang*/ /yang zab gnad kyis rang sar grol ba dang*/ /mtha' bral ngang du rang zhir btang ba dang*/ /bya btsal med par yongs la la bzla ste/ /blo rigs bstun nas gang ltar sgom byed kyang*/ /'gag la nyon mongs rang dgrar ma shor gces/ /snod ldan slob ma bzang po'i chos drug ni/ /mi gzhi legs shing ngo tsha khrel yod ldan/ /gsung bzhin sgrub cing dad mos phun sum tshogs/ /lus srog dor nas sgrub la snying rus che/ /grogs la brtse zhing snying rjes rang rgyud brlan/ /skyo dub med pas bzod ldan phan bde byed/ /sgo gsum zhi zhing dam tshig sdom la gnas/ /de ni skal bzang chos kyi bdud rtsi'i snod/ /khom ldan rnyed dka' bsam pa'i chos drug ni/ /mi lus thob dka' da res 'bad pa thon/ /bla ma rnyed dka' yon tan 'bras bu long*/ /chos dang phrad dka' brtson pas nyams su long*/ /zab don thos dka' snyan brgyud snying po bsgrub/ /'khrul snang bcad dka' gnyis med don la sbyang*/ /mthun skyen tshogs dka' 'dzom dus nyams len 'bungs/ /'dir bde phyi mar bde ba'i 'dun gros yin/ chos la zhugs pa'i gal che rnam drug ni/ /phyi ma rgyun ring sbyin pa gal re che/ /bde 'gro'i them skas tshul khrims gal re che/ /bzod pa'i go mtshon bsran tshugs gal re che/ /yon tan 'byung gnas brtson 'grus gal re che/ /dmigs pas mi g.yo bsam gtan gal re che/ /don sgrub lhun grub shes rab gal re che/ /gal chen bsgrubs la thar lam myur du bgrod/ /de dang mi ldan skyon drug bstan pa ni/ /sbyin pa ma btang yi dwags mdun na sgugs/

/tshul khrims ma bsrungs dud 'gro mdun na sgugs/ /bzod pa ma bsgoms dmyal ba mdun na sgugs/ /brtson 'grus mi rtsom mi khom g.yang sa sgugs/ /bsam gtan mi sgom bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs sgugs/ /shes rab ma bsgoms gtan du srid pa sgugs/ /dgra rnams mdun sgugs de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /zab mo rgyud sbyor mi dgos rnam drug ni/ /gang 'dug dge ba 'phel na dgon pa bsten mi dgos/ /rnam rtog rang sar grol na 'khor ba spang mi dgos/ /rang gi bag med bsrungs na gzhan sems bsrung mi dgos/ /ma bcos sems nyid rtogs na dpe cha klog mi dgos/ /ci snang sgyu mar rtogs na zhen pa bzlog mi dgos/ / gnas lugs rang ngo shes na sangs rgyas btsal mi dgos/ /'di dag dang ldan skyes chen 'gro mchog lags/ /chos bsgrub grogs su mchog drug bstan pa ni/ /mchod gnas mchog tu bla ma dkon mchog bkur/ /gtong ba'i mchog tu tshe 'di'i bya ba gtong*/ /nor gyi mchog tu thos bsam dad pa bsten/ /bshes kyi mchog tu sems nyid rang ngo shes/ /sems bskyed mchog tu rang 'dod 'khri ba spong*/ /

grub rtags mchog tu bla ma sangs rgyas mthong*/ /de dag 'byor na don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur/ /bya ba ma yin rnam drug spang ba ni/ /rgyud tshod mi shes gang zag gshe skur spang*/ /log 'tsho'i rnyed pas dad ldan sun ma 'don/ /bag med tho co'i smyon spyod shugs ma drags/ /gzhan la khyad gsod mtho dgos (1) brnyas ma byed/ /lto rgyab ched du dam pa'i chos ma 'dor/ /rgyu 'bras zab mo'i rten 'brel khyad ma bsad/ /'di dag spangs na skyes bu dam par 'gyur/ /chos byed rnams kyi bya ba rnam drug ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gtsug gis 'khur/ /sgo gsum dge ba byang chub lam du bsgyur/ /ngar 'dzin bden zhen rtag 'dzin lings kyis bskyur/ /tshe 'di'i blo sna skyes tshad 'bur 'joms gyis/ /nyon mongs dug lnga gnyen pos yul nas phyung*/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i nor rdzas rgyud la bsten/ /de yis rang gzhan 'byor pa nye bar skye/ /nyams su len dus dgos pa'i chos drug ni/ /myur du 'chi nges chos min 'dor dgos shing*/ /btang snyoms 'byung nye snyoms las med pa dgos/ /brtson 'grus 'chor rkyen gnyen po bsten dgos shing*/ /dad gus log sla go 'dris ma khyer dgos/ /'khrul snang bcad dka' bden med shes dgos shing*/ /log spyod 'go sla mi dang mi 'grogs dgos/ /nang pa'i khongs chud skyabs 'gro rnam drug ni/ /sangs rgyas sku gsum bsgrub byar skyabs 'gro zhing*/ /theg gsum chos la lam du skyabs su 'gro/ /nyan rang byang sems grogs su skyabs 'gro zhing*/ / mkhas grub bla ma bsten par skyabs su 'gro/ /yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub skyabs 'gro zhing*/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro byin rlabs skyabs 'gro ba/ /'di dag dang por (1) sngon 'gro'i chos la gces/ /dad can rnams kyi ngo shes rnam drug ni/ /'gro ngo shes pas rang don chos su chug /'bor ngo shes pas 'khrul snang zhen chags skyungs/

/nyan ngo shes pas bla ma'i gdams ngag nyon/ /spong ngo shes pas sgo gsum sdig pa spongs/ /spyod ngo shes pas zab don chos la spyod/ /lta ngo shes pas sems nyid don la ltos/ /de ltar byas na yang dag don la nye/ /skal bzang rnams kyi goms pa'i gnad drug ni/ /gnas lugs byar med yin gyis spros med gnad/ /sgom pa 'od gsal yin gyis yeng med gnad/ /spyod pa sgyu ma yin gyis bden med gnad/ /'bras bu lhun grub yin gyis rang chas gnad/ /rkyen ngan rang grol yin gyis 'dzin med gnad/ /bde sdug rang sems yin gyis rtsal sbyong gnad/ /de dang ldan na ma byas don kun 'grub/ /rigs pa drug gis rang la gros 'debs ni/ /tshe la nges med brtson 'grus brtsam par rigs/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyo ba skye bar rigs/ /'gro drug tshad med snying rjes skyong bar rigs/ /bla ma'i mos gus rgyun chad med par rigs/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag nyams su blangs par rigs/ /rang ngo shes dus dben pa bsten par rigs/ /rigs pa'i rjes 'gro skyes bu'i mchog rab yin/ /theg pa'i don 'dus shes pa'i chos drug ni/ /nyon mongs rang ga tha mal skyon shes dgos/ / nyon mongs spong ba nyan rang lam shes dgos/ /nyon mongs sbyong ba rgyal sras lam shes dgos/ /nyon mongs bsgyur ba gsang sngags lam shes dgos/ /rang bzhin yongs shes rang byung ye shes dgos/ /blang dor grol bya btsal med shes pa dgos/ /de dag ldan na nyon mongs gos pa med/ /chos byed rnams kyi blo sna rnam drug ni/ /'khor ba'i mtshang rtogs ngan pa'i skyon 'tshol 'dra/ /de las 'bros blo dmag mi ru log 'dra/ /phyir mi bzlog blo wa mo gal thar 'dra/ /'khor ba spang blo rje ngan 'khor g.yog 'dra/ /'khyams kyis dogs blo lam ngan sa 'tshol 'dra/ /'khor ba grol blo chab rom chur zhu 'dra/ /rgyud la chos sbyor blo sna rnam drug ni/ /'dzin blo sbrang ma sbrang rtsir 'byar ba 'dra/

/bsam blo sa rdo'i nang nas gser 'tshol 'dra/ /rtogs blo gser sbram lag tu thob pa 'dra/ /'dris par bsgom blo phyi dor byed 'dra dang*/ /yon tan 'phel blo de la rgyan du byed/ /mngon du gyur blo 'dod dgu 'byung 'dra'o/ /theg chen chos la 'brel ba drug ldan ni/ /dngos 'dzin 'jig la lta ba nyams myong 'brel/ / snyoms las sel la dad pa brtson 'grus 'brel/ /theg dman skyob la thabs dang shes rab 'brel/ /khong khro 'byin la rang skyon gzhan bden 'brel/ / 'phags lam bgrod la mos gus snying rus 'brel/ /gol sa gcod la thos bsam nyams len 'brel/ /legs par dgos te shin tu dkon par snang*/ / gong na med pa'i gdams pa rnam drug ni/ /gnas lugs go na thos pa gong na med/ /rtsa ba chod na bsam pa gong na med/ /ye shes skyes na thabs lam gong na med/ /chos la bkol btub byin rlabs gong na med/ /skye shi med rtogs dngos grub gong na med/ /thob rgyu med rtogs gdeng tshad gong na med/ /de dag sbyor na sangs rgyas rang las 'byung*/ /mthar phyin bsgrub la ma shor rnam drug ni/ /zlar dga' grogs kyi dbang du ma shor dang*/ /ngor bstod zas kyi dbang du ma shor dang*/ /'brel 'dris rnam g.yeng dbang du ma shor dang*/ /brtse gdung gnyen gyi dbang du ma shor dang*/ /bzo rigs bshes gnyen dbang du ma shor dang*/ / gsog brun nor rdzas dbang du ma shor dang*/ /de ltar drug ldan chos lam mthar phyin 'gyur/ /mi gzhi'i skyon drug brtags te 'dor ba ni/ /rang 'khrug gzhan smod dug lnga rags pa dang*/ /col chung 'do med blo sna rags pa dang*/ /don med bya byed 'brel 'dris dga' ba dang*/ /gyong po chig tshugs bskul tu mi btub dang*/ /mtho 'grogs gsar ngas phyi shol che ba dang*/ /ngan g.yo gya gyus zhe bzhag che ba rnams/ /dam chos bsgrub la skyon yon brtags te spang*/ /kun spyod skal ba ngan pa'i skyon drug ni/

/byas pa mi gzo drin lan nyes kyis 'jal/ /rang la mi 'jal gzhan la phod kham che/ /'gyur ldog mang zhing mi rtag khams 'dus che/ /gdong lcang ngor dga' kha zhe gnyis pa can/ /don ldan mi shes blo mang gtam la dga'/ /byas pa med par re ba che ba rnams/ /skal ngan dam chos phyogs min ring du spang*/ /mthar phyin skyon las grol ba'i chos drug ni/ /blo brtan rang rgyud dge zhing bya ba nyung*/ /snying rus zhe bcad che zhing bzod dang ldan/ /gzhan gyis mi brdzi rkyen gyis 'phrog pa med/ /phyi thag rgyun ring dad gus ngo lkog med/ /blo bzang gros 'dun che zhing thabs la mkhas/ /gzhan skyon mi brjod rang skyon mtshang nas 'don/ /de 'dra'i skyes mchog byang chub gtan gyi grogs/ /chos byed rnams kyi phrag dog skyon drug ni/ /gzhan las rnyed mang longs spyod 'byor 'dod dang*/ /'khor mang bu slob rgyas par 'dod pa dang*/ / bsod nams ci che 'du ba mang 'dod dang*/ /snyan grags ba dan rgyal khams khyab 'dod dang*/ /kun las rab 'phags che khyad 'dod pa dang*/ /rang las gzhan min gcig kyang mi 'dod pa/ /'di dag 'dod lha'i me tog mda' yis bcom/ /de las rtags drug 'char ba'i myu gu ni/ /bsod nams 'du 'dzi can la yid smon 'ding*/ /chos mdzad gong ma rnams la ngan skyon brjod/ /gzhan gyi phun tshogs mthong la khong khro 'khrug /byams sems gzhan don can la zur za gtong*/ /sgom sgrub dngos grub can la gshe skur 'debs/ /ma rig log par lta ba'i kha 'dzin byed/ /de 'dra'i skal ngan bsten pa'i skyon drug ni/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nges 'byung dad pa 'grib/ /thos pa tsam gyis thar pa'i lam dang ring*/ / dran pa tsam gyis 'khor ba'i sa bon 'debs/ /reg pa tsam gyis byin rlabs dngos grub yal/ /gtam 'dres tsam gyis dag snang mos gus 'grib/ /chos kyis 'brel tshad bdud kyis byin brlabs pa/ /shi ba'i 'og tu mnar med gnas su 'gro/

/de bas de 'dra'i skal ngan spang bar gyis/ /ngan pa'i rtags drug rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /chos la lta ci tha mal bas kyang dman/ /bstan zhugs lta ci ma rabs bas kyang dman/ /theg chen lta ci mu stegs byed las dman/ /gsang sngags lta ci log sred can las dman/ /nyams len lta ci sdig can rnams las dman/ /lta sgom lta ci chos dang gnam sa bzhin/ /bstan pa'i chom rkun chos ltar bcos pa ste/ /dad ldan log lam ngan 'gror khrid pas spang*/ /ya bral drug gis mi 'grub bstan pa ni/ /sems bskyed yod kyang smon lam ma btab na/ /gzugs sku'i sgrib sbyong sa bon thebs mi 'gyur/ /snying rje yod kyang rang 'dod ma zad na/ /theg chen gzhan don spyod pa'i gral mi tshud/ /mthun 'jug byas kyang dus la ma babs na/ /gzhan don mi 'grub slar la 'phyar ka'i rgyu/ /ri khrod bsten kyang blo sna ma log na/ /chags sdang mthun 'jug 'khri ba chod par dka'/ /dad gus med pa'i gsol ba stong btab kyang*/ /byin rlabs rang bzhin char thigs gcig mi 'bab/ /mkhyen pa che yang spros las ma grol na/ /'khor 'das mi phyed grub mtha'i gzeb tu bcings/ /de phyir man ngag zung du 'brel ba gces/ /chos byed rnams kyi dgos pa rnam drug ni/ /'khor bas skrag pas gshed mas ded 'dra dang*/ /dge sbyor brtson pas so nam byed 'dra dang*/ /gnyen por 'gro ba nad pa sman bzhin dang*/ /gzhan phan lhur len bu chung skyong 'dra dang*/ /rang rgyud 'dul mkhas ko ba nyed 'dra dang*/ / ngar 'dzin dgra gsod mi sha 'don 'dra ste/ /'di rnams dgos pa rtag tu rgyud la bsten/ /mthar thug drug gis rang rgyud gdul ba ni/ /btson bu'i mthar thug yul la chags zhen spangs/ /so nam mthar thug dge la brtson pa bsten/ / gtan yul mthar thug gnas lugs sa 'dzin mdzod/ /bsrung ba'i mthar thug ngar 'dzin gces 'dzin bor/ /dgra yi mthar thug dug lnga rang rgyud thul/

/ nyams len mthar thug dran pa yeng med skyongs/ /'di dang ldan na dgos 'dod yid bzhin 'grub/ /chos byed rnams kyi 'chor ba'i nyen drug ni/ /dad pa yod kyang khe grags ma spangs na/ /mthar thug mi chos 'chor ba'i nyen yod gzabs/ /dgon pa bsten yang zhe bcad mi ldan na/ /mthar thug yeng bar 'chor ba'i nyen yod gzabs/ /grub rtags thon yang rlom sems ma spangs na/ /mthar thug bdud kyis 'khyer ba'i nyen yod gzabs/ /dam can 'du yang snying rje mi ldan na/ /mthar thug las mtha' log pa'i nyen yod gzabs/ / dgongs pa mtho yang zhen pa ma log na/ /mthar thug dred por 'chor ba'i nyen yod gzabs/ /'gro don brtson yang rang 'dod 'khris zhugs na/ /mthar thug zog por song ba'i nyen yod gzabs/ /sgrib pa drug po spong ba'i dgos pa ni/ /dam chos mi 'dzin spangs pa'i sgrib pa yin/ /bdud las gang yin mi shes sgrib pa yin/ /bla ma'i mos gus med pa sgrib pa yin/ /mched grogs dag snang med pa sgrib pa yin/ /theg mchog zhugs la smod pa sgrib pa yin/ /sgo gsum nyes spyod g.yo sgyu sgrib pa yin/ /de dag spangs nas thar lam bsgrub pa gces/ /sgrib bral rin thang mtha' yas chos drug ni/ /lan la mi re sbyin pa phyogs med gtong*/ /srid pa mi gnyer tshul khrims rnam dag bsrung*/ /sems can mi gtong byams dang snying rje skye/ /dam chos shes pas nam yang ngoms pa med/ /rnyed bkur mi gnyer 'gro la chos rab ston/ /phyogs ris mi byed kun la sems bzang snyoms/ /rab dge 'di 'dra'i spyod pa dam pa lags/ /theg chen bstan pa'i yon tan rnam drug ni/ /bshes gnyen bsten la g.yel ba med pa dang*/ /sems can don byed skyo dub med pa dang*/ /gnas lugs rtogs kyang nga rgyal med pa dang*/ /don du mi 'gyur rnyed pa spong ba dang*/ /zab mo'i don la skrag pa med pa dang*/ /dge tshogs sgrub la chog shes med pa'o/

/nyon mongs dgra chen gzhom pa'i chos drug ni/ /nyin 'ga'i dge sbyor nyon mongs mi phyed pas/ /sgrub pa rgyun bsring ngang thung med pa gces/ / thog med nyon mongs shin tu gdul dka' bas/ /gnyen po rab zab thabs bcas bsten pa gces/ /bdag 'dzin gzhig dka' gzung 'dzin rlabs che bas/ /tshogs gnyis dpung bskyed dge la 'bad pa gces/ /'khor ba'i gcong nad yun ring sbyang dka' bas/ /'tsho byed bla ma rtag tu bsten pa gces/ /dug lnga'i me dpung rab tu gzhil dka' bas/ /byang chub sems bskyed rgya mtsho bsten pa gces/ /las ngan bsags pa'i bgrod lam mthur byed pas/ /thar ba'i skas la yar la 'dzeg pa gces/ /sde snod bslab gsum khyad par chos drug ni/ /nyan thos sde snod ston las sgra'i rjes 'brang*/ /rang rgyal rang rtogs rten 'brel nang nas 'char/ /byang sems rang gzhan ye shes mtha' yas ldan/ /nyan thos bslab pa phyogs gcig rang rgyud tsam/ /rang rgyal bar ma rang don lhur len zhing*/ /byang sems snying rje nges par 'byung ba yin/ /'jig rten skyon du lta ba'i chos drug ni/ /snyan grags 'brug sgra 'dra bas dga' ba spang*/ /longs spyod sprin dang 'dra bas zhen pa spang*/ /nye 'khor rgan 'khogs bu 'dra re ba spang*/ /yul khyim mgron khang 'dra bas ri khrod 'grim/ /bde skyid rmi lam 'dra bas bden ma 'dzin/ /thams cad bor nas 'gro bas chags zhen skyungs/ /de ltar byas na je bder 'gyur ba yin/ /chos byed rnams kyi byar dgos rnam drug ni/ /gang du skyes kyang gzhan don 'grub dgos pas/ /sems bskyed smon lam rgya chen sbyang bar bya/ /skyid na chos kyi byin rlabs shes dgos pas/ /phan yon bsams la nan tan brtson par bya/ /sdug na sngon gyi las su shes dgos pas/ /rgyu 'bras bsams la blo sbyong snying por bya/ /na na dge sbyor rtsal sbyong shes dgos pas/ /ma na ba la rig pa gcun par bya/

/rgas na blo sems bde ba cig dgos pas/ /gzhon dus bsags sbyong las la 'bad par bya/ /shi na bya ba rdzogs pa cig dgos pas/ /ma shi bar la 'brel thag gcad par bya/ /'di dag snying nas bslab pa'i chos su snang*/ /gdams ngag drug gis gnad du brdeg pa ni/ /bza' mi tshong dus 'gron po tshogs pa 'dra/ /nam 'bral mi shes mthar thug don la sbyangs/ / gnyen 'dun lcang kha'i byi'u chung 'dus pa 'dra/ /nam gyes mi shes gdung sems 'khri ba chod/ /tshe srog mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra/ /sgom sgrub chos la rtsol ba drag tu skyed/ /smra mang 'khrul pa'i dgrar ldang ne tso 'dra/ / ngag 'khyal bre mo'i gtam 'dra smra bcad gyis/ /chos sgrub mtsho gling nor bu len 'dra bas/ /snyan brgyud gdams ngag lhug par spel mi bya/ /'grogs yun ring na sangs rgyas skyon mthong bas/ /mi gzhan rnams dang gnas mal gcig mi bya/ /'di dag snying gtam mchog yin gus pas nyon/ /chos byed rnams kyi dus tshod rnam drug ni/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rnams dang phrad pa'i tshe/ /spros pa gcod pa'i dus yin the tshom dris/ /rkyen ngan yul dang rig pa phrad pa'i tshe/ /nyams len bsre ba'i dus yin rtsal sbyong gyis/ /zab mo'i snyan brgyud man ngag rnyed pa'i tshe/ / 'khrul pa 'jig pa'i dus yin thog tu khol/ /brtson 'grus drag pos sgrub la 'bad pa'i tshe/ /bar chad 'ong ba'i dus yin bdud la brtag

/sgrub pa'i (1) mthar phyin dngos grub 'ong ba'i tshe/ /bdud kyi bar chad 'ong bas shin tu gzabs/ /gnas lugs don la lta ba'i rtsal sbyong tshe/ /gol sgrib 'ong ba'i dus yin bla ma bsten/ /'di dag zab mo'i gnad yin yid la zungs/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i bya dgos rnam drug ni/ /ngan spyod 'go can mi dang 'grogs mi bya/ /bzang spyod bslab dka' bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ / snang ba 'brid mkhas yul la ma yengs bya/ /rig pa col chung 'khrul phyir ma song bya/ /chags sdang gdos drags phyogs ris ma song bya/ /'khrul snang 'dris sla zhen chags rtsad gcod bya/ /tha ma 'gyod pa med pa'i chos drug ni/ /ngo tsha khrel 'dzem ldan pas shi yang 'gyod pa med/ /mi dge sdig pa ma byas shi yang 'gyod pa med/ /chos phyogs zas nor btang bas shi yang 'gyod pa med/ /bslab gsum gtsang ma bsrungs pas shi yang 'gyod pa med/ /dge la rtag tu brtson pas shi yang 'gyod pa med/ /rang sems gnong 'gyod med pas shi yang 'gyod pa med/ /'di dag rnams dang ldan par bya ba gces/ /'bring gi brod pa drug dang ldan pa ni/ /dkon mchog bsten pas 'khor ba skyob re brod/ /tshogs gnyis bsags pas 'di bas bde ste brod/ /dam tshig bsrungs pas mkha' 'gros bsu ste brod/ /yi dam bar dor lam sna 'dren te brod/ /bla ma mchog dang 'du 'bral med de brod/ /sems nyid goms pas 'od gsal 'char te brod/ / 'da' dka' 'chi brod gdams pa zab mo yin/ /rnal 'byor rab kyi 'chi rgyu med drug ni/ /rang rig dgongs pa ye nas 'chi rgyu med/ /rang byung ye shes ye nas 'chi rgyu med/ /'od gsal chos nyid ye nas 'chi rgyu med/ /ngar 'dzin rig bral ye nas 'chi rgyu med/ /rgyu 'bras la dor ye grol 'chi rgyu med/ /re dogs gnyis med nam mkha' 'chi rgyu med/ /de ltar rtogs na 'chi bdag bdud dang bral/ /ma rtogs dngos por gzung ba'i skyon drug ni/

/rang la yod pa bzhag nas gzhan du btsal/ /sgom chen gnas lugs ma shes mtshan mas bcings/ /yul snang brdzun par ma shes bden par 'dzin/ /dbyings gcig gnas lugs ma rtogs so sor 'dzin/ /rang rig ngo bo ma shes mtho dman bgrod/ /'khrul ba'i mngon zhen ma chod bdud kyis bslus/ /ma rtogs log pa'i skyon rnams brtags te spang*/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i gdams ngag rnam drug ni/ /bla ma bsten pas mi chos phyir mi ldog /yul gyi nyes bsams mi chos phyir mi ldog /bde sdug bsams pas mi chos phyir mi ldog /'jig rten nyes bsams mi chos phyir mi ldog / 'khrul par bltas pas mi chos phyir mi ldog /sdug bsngal 'dam bsams mi chos phyir mi ldog /de ltar bsams na 'jig rten chos las grol/ /gnyen po'i mel tshe drug gis bskor ba ni/ /nyin mtshan tshe rku gnyen po'i mel tshe gyis/ / dug lngas rgyud sreg gnyen po'i mel tshe gyis/ /'dod pas mi ngoms gnyen po'i mel tshe gyis/ /drag po'i las la gnyen po'i mel tshe gyis/ /don med las la gnyen po'i mel tshe gyis/ /sgo gsum ci spyod gnyen po'i mel tshe gyis/ /nyon mongs dgra rkun glags skabs rnyed mi 'gyur/ /nyams len mi 'grub 'chor sa rnam drug ni/ /mkhos chung gang zag mi tshe don med 'chor/ /grags 'dod can de mi tshe lo 'dod 'chor/ /zas sred can de zas phyir mug ltor 'chor/ /mi rgod nor can khe spogs tshong la 'chor/ /dad med thos bsam chos dred rgyus can 'chor/ /thos chung blun sgom log pa'i lam du 'chor/ /'chor ba drug por ma song shin tu gces/ /skyon rnams byung na bsal thabs chos drug ni/ /mos gus shor na yon tan dka' bas soms/ /g.yeng bas khyer na rnam rtog grogs su slong*/ / bsgoms kyang skyed med sna tshogs thabs kyis chun/ /'byung 'khrugs na tsha rgyu rkyen 'bras bur rtogs/ /'du ba yal na tshogs dang gtor ma rem/

/sems bskyed shor na gnyen po'i bskyar la blang*/ /de yis gegs rnams gang byung sel ba yin/ /rgyud la sbyor ba phyi nang gnad drug ni/ /nang du bdag 'dzin 'khri ba gcad pa gnad/ /phyi ru yul snang chos skur 'khyer ba gnad/ /bar du 'dzin rtog grogs su blang ba gnad/ /yar la lta dgongs zad par byed pa gnad/ / mar la chos spyod gzhung bzhin bsrang ba gnad/ /bar du yeng med shes bzhin bsrung ba gnad/ /de dag 'dzom na thar lam myur du bgrod/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la gces pa rnam drug ni/ /sgyu mar rtogs kyang rgyu 'bras 'dzem pa gces/ /nges shes thob kyang khyad gsod med pa gces/ /grogs su 'char yang dben par gnas pa gces/ /sgom med go yang rnam rtog 'dul ba gces/ /mnyam rjes med kyang tha mal ma shor gces/ /gnas lugs rtogs kyang lung rigs zhun thar gces/ /mthon por phyin yang 'di drug ma bral gces/ /mthar 'dzin 'ching bar bstan pa'i chos drug ni/ /chags na yi dam yin yang 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /bzung na mthon po'i grub mtha' 'ang 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /'dzin na snying rje yin yang 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /rlom na dgongs pa zab kyang 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /zhen na nyams rtogs yin yang 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /myong 'dzin gnyis med yin yang 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /tha mal ngar 'dzin nor rdzas smos ci dgos/ /des na gang la'ang zhen chags med pa gces/ /'ching ba'i sgrog drug bcad pa'i man ngag ni/ /nor rdzas mngon zhen spel srung sgrog gis 'ching*/ /rigs rgyud mngon zhen khe grags sgrog gis 'ching*/ /rnam g.yeng chags zhen 'du 'dzi'i sgrog gis 'ching*/ /tha snyad tshig zhen nga rgyal sgrog gis 'ching*/ /nyams rtogs mngon zhen rlom sems sgrog gis 'ching*/ /chos spyod mngon zhen gnyen po'i sgrog gis 'ching*/ /sgrog dang bral ba'i chos pa dka' bar snang*/ /chos byed rnams kyi 'ong ba'i chos drug ni/ /chags sdang skye ba'i yul nas phyir bros dang*/

/ chos spyod dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel bar 'ong*/ /ko long sdom pa'i zur mgo ma rno dang*/ /'grogs pa rgyun ring 'thab rtsod nyung bar 'ong*/ /bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin gus bsgrub dang*/ /thugs la 'dogs shing byin rlabs dngos grub 'ong*/ /rang gi sna thag gzhan la ma gtad dang*/ /shin tu skyid cing sgrub pa mthar phyin 'ong*/ /spyod rtsing bor la zhi dul ldan gyis dang*/ /kun dang mthun zhing yid du 'thad par 'ong*/ /phyogs 'dzin bor la bzang po'i sems gzung dang*/ /tshad mar 'dzin cing kun gyis bstod par 'ong*/ /ngan pa'i re ba rnam drug spong ba ni/ /byas pa med par phan 'dogs 'ong du re/ /dka' ba ma spyad skyid pa 'ong du re/ /sgrub pa med par dngos grub thob tu re/ /mi chos ma bor lha chos 'ong du re/ /nyams su ma blangs bshad rings gzhan phan re/ /cung zad bsgrubs la bsnyen bkur 'ong du re/ /thar pa'i lam dang rgya mtsho'i shar nub bzhin/ /rang bzhin ngan pa'i kun spyod rnam drug ni/ /bza' btung bgo na rang bzhin che bar 'dod/ /nyo tshong byed na rgyal kha rang la 'dod/ /gos gon tshe na rang dro 'jam pa 'dod/ /rang 'chang bzang la gzhan gtong ngan par 'dod/ /zhag gcig gnas la'ang rang skyid sa phyogs 'dod/ /chos dang bla mas nye 'brel gces par 'dod/ /de 'dra'i mi la thar pa'i myu gu skam/ /ma nor lam du 'jug pa'i chos drug ni/ /dgon pa'i sa bzung nga dang bdag ma 'dzin/ /'tsho ba'i rkyen bzung nga dang bdag ma 'dzin/ /mkhas btsun tshul bzung mthon po'i cha ma 'dzin/ /ma dad spyod spangs gzhan gyi ngo ma bsrung*/ /snying rjes phan thogs khyim thab nor ma bsrel/ /phyogs med sbyin thong yus dang lan ma re/ /nyams len rang rkya thub pa'i chos drug ni/ /ngo lkog med pa'i tshul khrims rkyen ngan thub/ /gdams ngag khong khrol gang yang nyams len shes/ /bar chad bgegs sel nad gdon 'don la mkhas/ /thos bsam mtha' chod gzhan la dri rgyu med/

/gol sgrib mtha' chod theg pa mtho dman shes/ /bdud kyis mi tshugs go cha ldan pa'o/ /ngo tsha rnam drug spang bar gdams pa ni/ /nor rdzas yo byad sog na ngo tsha'i gnas/ /gos bzang phyi 'chor che na ngo tsha'i gnas/ /rgyan dang sgeg chos byed pa ngo tsha'i gnas/ /zang zing g.yeng ba bsgrubs na ngo tsha'i gnas/ /chos min bya ba mang po ngo tsha'i gnas/ /che khyad nga rgyal dregs pa ngo tsha'i gnas/ /snying nas chos mdzad rnams kyis spang bar 'tshal/ /gong ma'i rnam thar bsten pa'i chos drug ni/ /yeng med mi rtag 'chi bas bskul ma btab/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal shes pas rgyab tu bor/ /rgyal srid longs spyod mchil ma bzhin du bor/ /dad brtson rnam dag bstan pa'i chos sgor zhugs/ /dge ba'i bshes btsal thos bsam spros pa bcad/ /dka' thub cher spyad lus srog 'ben du btsugs/ /de ltar mdzad pas grub pa brnyes  pa dang (1) / /de la tshad btsugs sgrub la 'bad par bya/ /de las gzhan don chos drug 'byung ba ni/ /thugs rje 'byongs pas nye ring med par brtse/ /rtogs pa tshad phyin bdag 'dzin 'khrul ba zhig /rgyud tshod shes pas rten 'brel thabs la mkhas/ /chos nyid grol bas ci snang grogs su 'char/ /byin rlabs zhugs pas gzhan snang bsgyur nus shing*/ /gdul bya dus bab dad ldan 'gro ba 'du/ /phyi nang rten 'brel gcig tu 'grigs pa yin/ /dge sbyor rgyud la ma khel skyon drug ni/ /nyams len med na shes kyang 'khor bar 'khyam/ /'ben drung bzhag nas gzhan du rgyang mda' 'phen/ /jag pa shar ri nub rir ram mdar rgyug /rkun ma nags bros rkang rjes bye rir bcad/ /chus khyer ram mda' skam la rgyug pa ste/ /gyer ba'i smrang yod mdos gtong sa mi shes/ /de 'dra'i gang zag bde chen sa dang ring*/ /dka' ba'i skyon drug 'byung bar bstan pa ni/ / 'khor bar 'dun la yang dag dad pa dka'/ /khrel 'dzem med pa'i bslab gsum bsrung ba dka'/

/mtshan ldan ma mjal thar lam tshud pa dka'/ /thabs lam ma chun ye shes 'char ba dka'/ /mthar 'dzin ma grol lta ba rtogs par dka'/ /mngon shes med pa'i gzhan don 'byung ba dka'/ /dka' ba lags pas kun gyis 'grub pa dkon/ /nyams len yeng thub goms pa rnam drug ni/ /dal 'byor dran pas don med bya ba spang*/ /mi rtog yeng med le lo'i dgra dang bral/ /dngos grub rnyed pas brtson pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /nyams rtogs 'phel bas sgom sgrub brod pa skye/ /rig pa dbang thob yeng rkyen chos nyid 'char/ /mdo rgyud chos dang rang rgyud 'dres pa'o/ /mthar phyin bar du bsten pa'i chos drug ni/ /nye 'brel bor la chos ldan grogs bzang bsten/ /sdig grogs bor la mkhas btsun bla ma bsten/ /'dun gros bor la gtan gyi skyid 'dun chos/ /thos bsam bsten la rgyud la ci 'dris gyis/ /grong yul spangs la ri ngogs dben pa bsten/ / gdams pa tshol la brtson pas sgrub pa gyis/ /de ltar byas na dngos grub myur du thob/ /phan gnod 'dres mar song ba rnam drug ni/ /yon tan mi skye bla ma bsten pa dang*/ /srol du mi tshud slob ma bsten pa dang*/ /chos brgyad ma bral sgrub pa byed pa dang*/ /log 'tshos rnyed 'tshol gzhan don byed pa dang*/ /bsrung sems med pa'i sdom khrims nod pa dang*/ /dge sdig 'chol ba'i gsang sngags spyod pa rnams/ /phan gnod 'dres pas chos kyi gzugs brnyan yin/ /log gnon gzer bu lta bu'i chos drug ni/ /gnod byed dgra sdang btul zhing slar mang bas/ /log gnon bdag 'dzin gdug pa 'dul ba gnad/ /'dod yon spyad cing zhen pa slar 'phel bas/ /log gnon btsan thabs zhen pa gcod pa gnad/ /dal tshogs long gtam smras shing slar mang bas/ /log gnon mi smra gcig pur 'dug pa gnad/ /gzhan sems gzung 'dzin byar dgos slar mang bas/ /log gnon gar babs ngang la skyur ba gnad/ /rang sems sgrims shing 'jur bu slar mang bas/

/log gnon rang babs ngang der glod pa gnad/ /bya byed spros pa byas sh-ing slar mang bas/ /log gnon cog gzhag rang babs gtong ba gnad/ /'di rnams ldan na re dogs gnyis 'dzin 'jig /rang rgyud chos la 'byor ba'i rtags drug ni/ /'dod yon bdud shes 'khor bar zhen log rtags/ /ci byas lam 'gyur byin rlabs zhugs pa'i rtags/ /rig pa dbang bsgyur dngos grub mchog thob rtags/ /gzhan gyis mi 'gyur lta dgongs skyes pa'i rtags/ /bla ma mjal spro mos gus zhugs pa'i rtags/ /tshe 'di blos thongs chos kyis phan thogs rtags/ /rtags chen drug ldan skyes bu dam pa yin/ /mi 'jigs rnam drug dgos par bstan pa ni/ /zab don nyams blangs ngan rtog dgras mi 'jigs/ /sems nyid don bltas chos brgyad dgras mi 'jigs/ / chos sku rtsal 'byongs gzung 'dzin dgras mi 'jigs/ /gzhi med lam blangs sgrib gnyis dgras mi 'jigs/ /bde chen nyams blangs sdug bsngal dgras mi 'jigs/ /phyogs bral nyams blangs re dogs dgras mi 'jigs/ /de dag gang ldan byas pa don chen 'grub/ /chos la zhugs pa'i spang blang chos drug ni/ /shes bzhin ma bsten spyod lam chos (1) mi 'byor/ /mthun 'jug ma spangs dge sbyor srang mi tshud/ /gnad kyis ma gcun nyams myong drod mi skye/ /dus la ma babs gzhan don phan mi thogs/ /nus mthu ma grub bar chad rkyen mi sol/ /zung 'jug ma bslangs tshe gcig sangs rgyas med/ /de bas dge sbyor gnad du 'gro ba gces/ /ngan pa'i 'du shes rnam drug spang ba ni/ /bla ma mir mthong byin rlabs stor bas ngan/ / grogs la dgrar shes dam tshig ral bas ngan/ /rang nyid che phyir chos lam ring bas ngan/ /gdams ngag zong tshong log 'tsho 'dres pas ngan/ /yi dam rkyen bzlog lam sna stor bas ngan/ /chos spyod nor 'tshol thar lam stor bas ngan/ /ngan pa drug bral sgrub pa shin tu gces/ /thar lam rang bzhin ma dran chos drug ni/

/yul la yengs pas mos gus ma dran dang*/ /mu lto zas 'tshol dkon mchog ma dran dang*/ /gshis ngan sbubs thung dam tshig ma dran dang*/ /mig 'gribs snying med sdug bsngal ma dran dang*/ /rdzas sred rnyed 'tshol dge ba ma dran dang*/ /zhe sdang dug sems sems bskyed ma dran dang*/ /don med 'phyal bas ngan song ma dran dang*/ /'di drug ldan pas yun ring 'khyams pa yin/ /gdams ngag rnam drug bskul ma gdab pa ni/ /dam pa rnams kyi rnal 'byor pha nor yin/ /sgrub pa snyom las phyi bshol mi bzhag 'tshal/ /rnam rtog 'char sgom shes rab bud shing yin/ /dmigs gtad sems 'dzin mchog tu mi 'dzin 'tshal/ /sdug bsngal rkyen ngan dge ba'i bskul ma yin/ /mya ngan smre sngags spong blo mi bgyid 'tshal/ /dug lngar snang ba ye shes gsang lam yin/ /dgra sdang tshogs ltas log par mi gzung 'tshal/ /bar chad sna tshogs dngos grub snga ltas yin/ /'khu 'phrig ngan rtog zhe sdang mi bgyid 'tshal/ /'khor bar snang ba rgyal ba'i zhing khams yin/ /'khrul snang gnyis 'dzin bden zhen mi 'cha' 'tshal/ /bslad pa drug gis chos nyid gol ba ni/ /gnas lugs rgya yan phyogs med yin pa la/ /zhe 'dod blo yi rtog pa byung bas bslad/ /chos nyid smra bsam brjod las 'das pa la/ /yod med mthar 'dzin sgro skur btab pas bslad/ /sems nyid gnyis med skye 'gag med pa la/ /skye shir 'dzin pa'i 'du shes bskyed pas bslad/ /yul snang sems nyid stong pa'i me long la/ /chags sdang gnyis 'dzin bden zhen zhugs pas bslad/ /don dam spros pa'i mtshan mas dben pa la/ /bden 'dzin don gyi the tshom byas pas bslad/ /gnas lugs kun gzhi phyogs med rten 'brel la/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags 'gos pas bslad/ /log pa'i 'tsho ba rnam drug spang ba ni/ /tshul 'chos bslu brid rnyed pa log 'tsho yin/ kha gsag mgo skor rnyed pa log 'tsho yin/ / zhen 'dod gzhogs slong byed pa log 'tsho yin/

/chos dpag ngan khram byed pa log 'tsho yin/ /thos bsam rnyed pa 'tshol ba log 'tsho yin/ /nor rdzas tha mal spyod pa log 'tsho yin/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pas de dag spangs na legs/ /chos spyi'i gdams ngag rnam drug bstan pa ni/ /mas 'dzeg kun spyod gtsang ba gdams ngag yin/ /sems bskyed tshad med bzhis sbyangs gdams ngag yin/ /gang yang zung 'jug nyams len gdams ngag yin/ /sa lam zab mo'i gnad btsal gdams ngag yin/ /lta ba sems nyid mtha' grol gdams ngag yin/ /phyogs med thos bsam byed pa gdams ngag yin/ /re thag chod pa'i gdams ngag rnam drug ni/ /khrel med mi la srung sdom re thag chod/ /snying rus med la sgrub pa re thag chod/ /dad gus med la byin rlabs re thag chod/ /shes rab med la rtogs pa re thag chod/ /snyom las can la grub rtags re thag chod/ /bsam ngan mi la phan sems re thag chod/ /bslab pa'i go rim rnam drug bstan pa ni/ /'jug sgo dang po 'bri klog sgra tshad bslab/ /gnyis par khrims bsrung sde snod thos bsam bya/ /gsum par lam 'jug bla ma dam pa bsten/ /bzhi par mnyes bya snyan brgyud dam pa nyon/ /lnga par bsgrub bya mthar phyin brtson 'grus brtsam/ /drug par gzhan don skyo ngal med par bya/ /de rnams rjes 'jug skyes bu dam pa'i srol/ /skal bzang slob ma skyong ba'i chos drug ni/ /dad can gang mos rjes su 'dzin shes dang*/ /brtson 'grus bya byed mi gzhug lam dgod shes/ /thos bsam tshig 'byams mi gzhug sgrub la 'dzud/ /

rnyed 'tshol yon tan mi slob dge sbyor 'dzud/ /gsog brun nor sog mi slob chog shes bslab/ /tshe 'di'i gros 'dun mi sbyor chos mgo 'don/ /de dag thabs mkhas bshes gnyen bzang po'i lugs/ /dran pa'i bya ra btang ba'i chos drug ni/ /tshe 'dir shor ram dran pa'i bya ra btang*/ /le los g.yengs sam dran pa'i bya ra btang*/ /gol sgrib byung ngam dran pa'i bya ra btang*/ /'khrul rtog shor ram dran pa'i bya ra btang*/ /'chal gtam shor ram dran pa'i bya ra btang*/ /tha mal lus sam dran pa'i bya ra btang*/ /chos mdzad rnams kyi bya ba rnam drug ni/ / tshe la long med myur du 'gro rtsis bya/ /las 'bras che phra dge sdig blang dor bya/ / gzhan don 'grub dka' rang don ma shor bya/ /shes bya thug med tshig 'byams ma shor bya/ /mi shes blun sgom rmongs par ma shor bya/ /mkhas btsun bzang 'dod nga rgyal ma song bya/ /sgrub 'dod legs par bsam pa'i chos drug ni/ /tshe 'di ma bral pha yul blos mi thongs/ /'dod zhen ma log dben par sdod mi tshugs/ /grub mtha' ma grol rang rgyud chos kyis 'ching*/ /bsam gtan ma skyes stan la 'dug mi tshugs/ /gnyen po bral bas rnam g.yeng rkyen mi thub/ /brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gnyen po dug tu 'gro/ /de bas 'di dag legs par bsam pa gces/ /phyi nang rtags drug legs par bstan pa ni/ /dpyod ldan mi dpes gang brtsams mthar phyin dang*/ /rtogs ldan mi dpes gtam la bskyar thub dang*/ /go rig ldan pas gang yang shes pa dang*/ /nges shes skyes te dka' spyad nus pa dang*/ /chos dang 'dres te rang rgyud dul ba dang*/ /shes rab can de thos pas mi ngoms dang*/ /nang gi rtags kyis phyi rol shar ba yin/ /gzung 'dzin mdud pa dgrol ba'i chos drug ni/ /chags sdang skyes dus sems la bltas te dgrol/ /dug lnga skyes dus rang ngo bltas te dgrol/ /zug rngu byung dus bde chen bsgoms te dgrol/

/rnam rtog 'thor dus rang bzhin bcad de dgrol/ /ngal dub skyes dus lhod de glod de dgrol/ /'thibs shing lteng tshe gsal dag ngar bcas dgrol/ /bsgrub pa'i chos la bcas pa rnam drug ni/ / gdams ngag zab mo ngo sprod bcas pa dgos/ /ngo sprod gong ma'i phyag bzhes bcas pa dgos/ /phyag bzhes de yang nyams myong bcas pa dgos/ / nyams myong drod tshad rtags dang bcas pa dgos/ /drod rtags thob bya'i 'bras bur bcas pa dgos/ /'bras bu gzhan don mdzad par bcas pa dgos/ /ya bral lam de gol ba'i gnas su 'khyog /gces pa'i gdams ngag rnam drug bstan pa ni/ /dge sbyor gang byed thun las mi 'da' gces/ /bka' lung chos dang rang rgyud 'dres pa gces/ /bsam gtan rkyen thub rang rgyud mi 'khrugs gces/ /lta ba mtha' grol phyogs 'dzin med pa gces/ /chos nyid ngang dang 'du 'bral med pa gces/ /cir snang thabs la ye shes skye ba gces/ /yang dag chos la gyis pa rnam drug ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes ltos zhen pa log pa gyis/ / bden med rtsal sbyangs sgyu mar shes pa gyis/ /byang chub sems bskyed gzhan don ltos med gyis/ /dgongs pa blo 'das 'khor 'das phyed pa gyis/ /rnam rtog gang shar rang grol ye shes gyis/ /byin rlabs rang 'bar gzhan snang bsgyur ba gyis/ /bsgom pa'i gol sa bcad pa'i chos drug ni/ /'phro rgod ma song spros med don la gnas/ /ltengs por ma song rig pa'i gsal ngar gdags/ /phyal bar ma song dran pa'i rtsi yis gzung*/ /had por ma song bde gsal nyams dang ldan/ /re dogs ma song lhun grub 'od gsal ngang*/ /sgor tshe ma song rgya bskyed dpangs gtod sgom/ /de ltar byas na ma nor lam gyi mchog / lam zhugs rnams kyi ma song rnam drug ni/ /'gyur med dad pa gzung 'dzin ma song dang*/ /'khor ba'i skyo shas sdug bsngal ma song dang*/ /thos bsam mkhyen rgya tha snyad ma song dang*/ /snying rus sgrub pa skyid 'dod ma song dang*/

/gzhan don sems bskyed mtshan mar ma song dang*/ /mthon po'i lta ba rlom sems ma song dang*/ /shin tu gces te rab tu nyung bar gda'/ /yang zab gnad du 'gro ba'i chos drug ni/ /nga sod rtag tu rang pham 'ba' zhig long*/ /kho phyung khong par bden pa'i yus ma bzhag /go chod don med g.yeng ba'i smra ba bor/ /kun mthong spros bral sems nyid ngang la ltos/ /'brel chod yul drug gzung 'dzin rjes ma snyegs/ /stug spongs chos nyid don gyis gtan yul zungs*/ /de ltar byas na rang don myur du 'grub/ /yin pa drug gis legs par bstan pa ni/ /gros phug bla ma la gtod 'khrul ba mi 'byung yin/ /dge sbyor phyi dus ma bzhag shi yang mi 'gyod yin/ /dgra gnyen phyogs ris ma 'dzin kun snang mthun pa yin/ /bzang byas drin lan lon dang gar yang drin pa yin/ /phrag dog gnod 'dzugs spongs dang rang rgyud dul ba yin/ /dam pa'i rnam thar skyongs dang ci bsam 'grub pa yin/ /yang zab shes rgyud grol ba'i chos drug ni/ /lta ba sems nyid yin gyis rang ngo shes par gyis/ /sgom pa 'od gsal yin gyis ngang dngas phyin par gyis/ /spyod pa sgyu ma yin gyis cir snang lam du slong*/ /nyams myong chos nyid 'char gyis zhen 'dzin rtsad nas chod/ /'bras bu rang chas yin gyis re dogs 'dzin pa shol/ /'phrin las gzhan don yin gyis thugs rjes 'gro ba drongs/ /chos mdzad rnams kyi rang bzhin rnam drug ni/ /gzhan don sems bskyed yod na 'gro ba byams/ /sdang ba 'byung srid bzod pa'i grogs shes dgos/ /byams pa'i gtong phod yod na 'khor tshogs 'du/ /ma 'dus dge sbyor 'phel ba'i grogs shes dgos/ / rtogs pa yod na dam can sprin bzhin 'du/ /ma 'dus dam tshig nyams pa'i rtags shes dgos/ /zhen pa snying nas log na nor rdzas 'du/ /ma 'dus srid na sngon gyi las shes dgos/ /dngos grub thob khar bar chad sna tshogs 'byung*/

/ma byung gong ma'i byin rlabs yin shes dgos/ /sgrub pa brtson 'grus can la bdud rnams 'jug /ma zhugs dge sbyor gnad du tshud shes dgos/ /de ltar ma shes log par ltas nyen che/ /mthar thug don gyi gdams pa rnam drug ni/ /lta ba rtogs par 'dod na rtogs mkhan tshol/ /de nyid ma rnyed mtha' bzhi'i rgya las grol/ /ting 'dzin bsgom par 'dod na bsgom mkhan tshol/ /de nyid ma rnyed 'gyu ba dngos med bsam/ /spyod pa spyad par 'dod na spyod mkhan tshol/ /de nyid ma rnyed dbyer med rang sar grol/ /'bras bu bsgrub par 'dod na bsgrub mkhan tshol/ /de nyid ma rnyed sku gsum rang la rdzogs/ /'phrin las bsgrub par 'dod na bsgrub mkhan tshol/ /de nyid ma rnyed ma btsal lhun gyis grub/ /sa lam bgrod par 'dod na bgrod mkhan tshol/ /de nyid ma rnyed gnas lugs rang sar skyol/ /de nyid mthar thug snying po'i gdams pa ste/ /thams cad rig pa'i cho 'phrul shes par mdzod/ /rang sems mchog tu 'dul ba'i chos drug ni/ /rang gi nga rgyal rlom sems ri bo bsgyel/ /gzhan la phrag dog yi dam lha ru khur/ /gzhan don chags zhen shes rab mtshon gyis chod/ /rgyu 'bras khyad gsod dge sdig shan thang phyed/ /skur 'debs sgro skur bag yod zhi dul bsten/ /gzhan skyon sems 'khrug snang ba ma dag soms/ /de ltar byas na rang rgyud chos dang 'dres/ /ngo sprod drug gis shan thang dbye ba ni/ /rig pa gsal dag grub mtha' kun las grol/ /lta ba'i ngo sprod yin no phu thag chod/ /rang dngas bde chen dmigs gtad gnyis 'dzin grol/ /sgom pa'i ngo sprod yin no ngang la skyongs/ / thabs shes zung 'brel byang chub lam du slong*/ /spyod pa'i ngo sprod yin no sgyu mar sbyongs/ /snang srid zhing khams tha mal zhen rtog log /dam tshig ngo sprod yin no rnam dag gyis/ /cir snang rang byung ye shes bde ba'i ngang*/ /dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod yin no sa lam bgrod/

/de ltar gang byas gsang sngags rnal 'byor che/ /chos bzhin spyod la rab drug tshang ba ni/ /chags zhen med pas sbyin pa'i rab tu gda'/ /rang rgyud dri med tshul khrims rab tu gda'/ /khong khros mi 'khrugs bzod pa'i rab tu gda'/ /nges 'byung skyo shas brtson 'grus rab tu gda'/ / dgongs pa'i ngang gnas bsam gtan rab tu gda'/ /sems nyid don rtogs shes rab rab tu gda'/ /theg chen spyi yi gdams ngag rnam drug ni/ /rtag tu 'chi bsam brtson 'grus lcag gis brab/ /ci byed goms gtso chos kyi phyogs su bslab/ /bsags pa bgrang zhing dge sdig gso sbyong bya/ /dam pa gsum mchod tshogs gnyis bsag la 'bad/ /dge sbyor srang gzhug snang ba chos la bsgyur/ / ci byed gzhan don bdag med don dang sprad/ /de ltar su byed theg mchog snying por zhugs/ /ya bral nyes pa rnam drug spang ba ni/ /bsten pa mtshan ldan bla ma ma bral dgos/ /de dang bral na thar pa'i lam mi tshud/ /rang rgyud brtan pa'i dad pa ma bral dgos/ /de dang bral na chos nyid yul mi phyin/ /nyams len zab mo'i gdams ngag ma bral dgos/ /de dang bral na byang chub myu gu med/ / spros spyod thos bsam shes rab ma bral dgos/ /de dang bral na the tshom sgrog mi khrol/ /'dug sa ri ngogs dben pa ma bral dgos/ /de dang bral na rnam g.yengs 'du 'dzis 'khyer/ /brtson 'grus snying rus dam bca' ma bral dgos/ /de dang bral na yon tan thob dus med/ /de yi phyir na ya bral ma song gces/ /'bral med bsten la bdud drug spang ba ni/ /bla ma bsten la go dred bdud ma zhugs/ /dkon mchog bsten la ma gus bdud ma zhugs/ /dgon pa bsten la btang snyoms bdud ma zhugs/ /thos bsam bsten la sna dred bdud ma zhugs/ /bsam gtan bsten la 'phel med bdud ma zhugs/ /gzhan don bsten la rnam g.yeng bdud ma zhugs/ /dgos par snang ste nyin mo'i skar tshogs bzhin/

/bslab pa'i mtha' drug 'grogs par bstan pa ni/ /phu thag 'khrus pa'i lta ba mchog dang 'grogs/ /de med chos nyid gnam 'phang chod mi nus/ /gzhi rten bslab gsum dam tshig gtsang dang 'grogs/ /de med 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob mi nus/ /dus tshod shes pa'i spyod pa mchog dang 'grogs/ /de med 'khor ba'i pha rol sgrol mi nus/ /nyams len rang byung ye shes gdeng dang 'grogs/ /de med gzung 'dzin nyon mongs gdos mi chod/ / nyams myong gong 'phel bogs 'byin rtsal sbyong 'grogs/ /de med nyon mongs g.yul ngo bzlog mi 'gyur/ /zab mo'i man ngag phyogs med kun dang 'grogs/ /de med gang dgos 'dod pa'i don mi 'grub/ /de phyir yang dag snying po'i don 'dir bslab/ /gtso bo rnam drug gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ /'dug sa'i gtso bor ri ngogs dben pa bsten/ /de las gzhan du yul 'khor sdug bsngal rgyu/ /lam gyi gtso bor bla ma sangs rgyas khur/ /de las gzhan du lam rtags rten 'brel 'chugs/ /dam tshig gtso bor gang yang zung 'jug gces/ / de las gzhan du ya bral don mi 'grub/ /nyams rtogs gtso bor rnam rtog ye shes bsgyur/ /de las gzhan du spang bya'i dpung mi chom/ /'du shes gtso bor 'khor ba'i zhen pa bzlog /de las gzhan du tshe 'di'i dbang du 'chor/ /lta ba'i gtso bor rtogs mkhan rang ngo grol/ /de las gzhan du rtag chad mtha' mi grol/ /'di dag gces pa'i mdzod yin gus par zungs/ /shugs kyis 'grub pa'i chos drug bstan pa ni/ /bya ba btang na dge sbyor shugs kyis 'grub/ / bslab gsum gtsang na dam can shugs kyis 'du/ /snying rje 'byongs na 'gro don shugs kyis 'byung*/ /bsnyen sgrub them na 'phrin las shugs kyis 'byung*/ /lhug par glod na chos nyid shugs kyis mthong*/ /mchog nyid bsgrubs na thun mongs shugs kyis 'grub/ /mang ba drug tu ma song chos drug ni/ /zhen pa ma log 'di bar 'khyog pa mang*/

/shes bya mi sgrub tha mal shi ba mang*/ /gnyen po ma bsten bslab gsum ral ba mang*/ /thos bsam ma byas sgom pa gol ba mang*/ /rgyu 'bras khyad gsod ngan song ltung ba mang*/ /'du 'dzi bdud kyis sgrub pa bslus pa mang*/ /mang po'i gseb der bdag nyid ma song 'tshal/ /yin pa drug gis bdud las rgyal ba ni/ /bskul 'debs yeng med yin no le lo'i bdud ma bskur/ /blo sbyong gzhan gces yin no rang 'dod bdud ma bskur/ /gnas lugs thag chod yin no the tshom bdud ma bskur/ /nyams len mtha' bral yin no phyogs ris bdud ma bskur/ /sgrub pa gnad snun yin no kha 'byams bdud ma bskur/ /dgongs pa mtha' grol yin no grub mtha'i bdud ma bskur/ /tshad drug legs par gtan la dbab pa ni/ /rgyu 'bras phra spyad dad pa che ba'i tshad/ /gtam la 'jigs pa khrel 'dzem che ba'i tshad/ /yon tan 'go ba grogs po bzang ba'i tshad/ /sems nyid yul bral sgom pa bzang ba'i tshad/ / skyon yon mi 'phrogs nyams len rdzogs pa'i tshad/ /sku gsum lam slong zad sar skyol ba'i tshad/ /tshad rnams ldan pa'i skyes bu mchog rab yin/ /nyes pa drug ldan mi bya bstan pa ni/ /sdom gsum blangs nas nyes ltung 'khur mi bya/ /snying po'i don bor tshig phyir 'brang mi bya/ /byang chub mi sgrub chos brgyad lhur mi bya/ /mi lus thob nas stong par log mi bya/ /zab don rnyed nas dman par 'jug mi bya/ /sde snod 'chad mkhas nyams len med mi bya/ /sgrub la nyes pa bsam pa'i chos drug ni/ /bar chod mang na mthun 'jug rtsig pa bsgyel/ /'dun pa ma log long med rgyud la bsten/ /snying rje ma skyes rang la dpe long ltos/ /byin rlabs yal na mos gus brtson 'grus bskyed/ /gnod byed mang na zhun 'thar mang du sbyongs/ /gzhan don 'dod na sems bskyed smon lam thob/ /de ltar byas na nyes pa'i skyon las grol/ /sgrub pa'i dam chos tshad ma drug ldan ni/

/mdo rgyud lung zin bka' yi tshad ma dang*/ /brgyud pa ma chad gdams ngag tshad ma dang*/ /nyams sel ma zhugs byin rlabs tshad ma dang*/ /'dra min ma bslad yang dag tshad ma dang*/ /rang rgyud khel ba nyams myong tshad ma dang*/ /mngon sum rjes dpag gtan tshigs tshad ma dang*/ /rnam pa drug ldan shin tu gces pa yin/ / rang skyon mtshang nas 'bru ba'i chos drug ni/ /ngan g.yo'i khrims kyis rang mgo ma bskor cig /mi dge'i sdig pas rang phung ma bsgrubs shig /zhen 'dzin phung 'dres rang bdud ma 'bebs shig khong khro'i sems kyis rang sems ma dkrugs shig /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzis rang don ma slu cig /'khor ba'i g.yang sar rang nyid ma 'dor cig /gros de nyan na 'dun ma legs par 'ong*/ /mtho dman dril nas bstan pa'i chos drug ni/ /yar la bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod/ /mar la snod bcud longs spyod 'brel thag chod/ /bar du snang stong zung 'jug don la sbyongs/ /phar la dge ba sems can don la bsngos/ /tshur la dkon mchog yon tan rgyud la sbyor/ /bar du bdag gzhan dge sbyor dmigs med skyol/ /de yis lam zab snying po'i dam chos 'grub/ /chos dang 'dzol ba ya cha rnam drug ni/ /mi lus thob nas sdig spyod ya re cha/ /chos dang phrad nas mi bsgrub ya re cha/ /tshul khrims thob nas ral pa ya re cha/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i sgrub pa ya re cha/ /chos kyis rnyed 'tshol log 'tsho ya re cha/ /rang don phyal ba'i gzhan don ya re cha/ /bsams shing yi mug gang zag mang bar gda'/ /chos la 'dred pa'i rgyu drug bstan pa ni/ /grogs ngan bsten na dge sbyor 'dred pa'i rgyu/ /

bla ma'i skyon rtog mos gus 'dred pa'i rgyu/ /rtsol bas mi sgom nyams myong 'dred pa'i rgyu/ /yeng ba'i lam sdod dam chos 'dred pa'i rgyu/ /gzhan gyi skyon rtogs dag snang 'dred pa'i rgyu/ /lang can rig pa 'khrul par 'dred pa'i rgyu/ /rgyu drug spangs la dam chos bsgrub par bya/ /dgra drug spang bar gdams pa'i chos drug ni/ /dal 'byor mi lus lto rgyab dgrar ma bskur/ /gzhan don sems bskyed theg dman dgrar ma bskur/ /sems nyid nor bu 'khrul ba'i dgrar ma bskur/ /tshogs gnyis yid bzhin tshe 'di'i dgrar ma bskur/ /snying po'i sgrub pa le lo'i dgrar ma bskur/ /mos gus gdung sems log lta'i dgrar ma bskur/ /'dod yon rang gar spyod pa'i nyes drug ni/ /gzugs kyis mig bslus phye leb mar me bzhin/ /sgra yis rna ba gling bu ri dwags bzhin/ /dri yis sna bslus bung ba tsan+dan bzhin/ /ro yis lce bslus nya mo lcags kyu bzhin/ /reg gis lus bslus glang chen 'dam tshud bzhin/ /chos kyis yid bslus rnga mo bu shi bzhin/ /tshogs drug yul la rang gar ma song 'tshal/ /'gal ba lam du slong ba'i chos drug ni/ /tshe 'di'i blo skyes zhen pa nang nas log /nad gdon ci byung sdig sgrib phyags mar ltos/ /rkyen ngan bar chad dge ba'i bskul mar ltos/ / dgra sdang gnod 'tshe bzod pa'i bskul mar ltos/ /rnam rtog gang shar ye shes gsal 'debs ltos/ /snod bcud snang ba rgyal ba'i zhing du ltos/ /rkyen rnams byang chub lam du 'gro ba yin/ /de ltar ma shes ma go rnam drug ni/ /skyon yon gnyis la blang dor byed pa dang*/ /'gro drug zhing la mtho dman byed pa dang*/ / rig pa'i dngos la skye 'gag 'dzin pa dang*/ /zang ka'i shes pa spang gnyen byed pa dang*/ /rig pa'i don la sbyang bgrod 'dod pa dang*/ /'bras bu logs nas bsgrub byar 'dod pa dang*/ /mthon po'i don gyi rang bzhin ma go bas/

/blo dman byis pa grong pa'i chos la sbyor/ /chos bsgrub rnams la ngo tsha rnam drug ni/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs sdig spyod ngo re tsha/ /tha snyad tshig zhen mi bsgrub ngo re tsha/ /sems bskyed khas blangs bdag 'dzin ngo re tsha/ /chos dang 'jig rten bsre ba ngo re tsha/ /chags sdang 'thab rtsod byed pa ngo re tsha/ /chos dang gang zag gshe ba ngo re tsha/ /ngo tsha tshul bzhin spong ba shin tu dkon/ /yang dag don gyi gdams pa rnam drug ni/ /'du 'dzi bdud las yin gyis 'khri ba chod/ /bsod nams bar chod yin gyis dga' brod bor/ /che grags bdud las yin gyis dman sa zungs/ /phyogs 'dzin rtag chad yin gyis dbyings gcig dril/ /gnad med sdug sgur yin gyis gdams pa tshol/ /nyams med kha lta yin gyis rgyud dang sbyor/ /de ltar byas na legs pa'i yon tan 'grub/ /ran pa'i tshod zin drug gis gdams pa ni/ /skye shi bar do 'dir 'khyams grangs mang bas/ /da res 'gyur med btsan sa bzung re ran/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'dir tshud grangs mang bas/ /da res bde chen sa la 'gro re ran/ /skye shi'i phung po 'dor len grangs mang bas/ /da res 'gyur med chos sku thob re ran/ /ma rig mun khrod 'thoms pa grangs mang bas/ /da res ye shes sgron ma spor re ran/ /bdud bzhi'i dmag dpung 'dis bcom grangs mang bas/ /da res 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog re ran/ /'dod pa'i khol po 'di byas grangs mang bas/ /da res gtan gyi so nam zin re ran/ /ran pa bas kyang thal bar gyur 'di som/ /'gro ba drug gi don la brtag pa ni/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin bde bar ma shes na/ / bde ba 'dod pa sdug bsngal nad du che/ /chags sdang rang rig mnyam nyid ma shes na/ /'dor len byed pa spang blang nad du che/ /rkyen ngan rang bzhin grogs su ma shes na/ /thabs shes gzhan brten 'ching ba'i gzeb tu che/ /ltas ngan rang bzhin g.yang du ma lon na/

/dngos grub nyid kyang bdud dang gol bar 'gro /rang gi sems rgyud chos kyis ma btul na/ /tshig tshogs che yang ne tso'i 'don par 'gro/ /dge ba gang byed sems bskyed mi ldan na/ /nyan rang nyid dam bsod nams cha mthun 'gro/ /de bas yang dag gnad du 'gro ba gces/ / chos byed rnams kyi 'ong ba'i chos drug ni/ /dben pa bsten na dge sbyor 'phel bar 'ong*/ /gzhan la bstod na shugs kyis dad par 'ong*/ /rang rgyud btul na dge ba 'phel bar 'ong*/ /nor bdun bsags na dbul 'phongs sel bar 'ong*/ /yon tan spel na rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin 'ong*/ /'gro drug bskyangs na rgyal sras spyod par 'ong*/ /'ong ba bzhin du mdzad pa'i skye bo nyung*/ /gal che drug gi spro ba bskyed pa ni/ /mos gus dad pa gting nas skye dka' bas/ /bcos shing blos bsgyur 'bad pa gal re che/ /rnam rtog sna tshogs grogs su 'char dka' bas/ /ci skyes dran pa grol ba gal re che/ /snod bcud snang ba zhing khams 'char dka' bas/ /sgyu ma rmi lam shes pa gal re che/ /dgongs pa rtogs grol dus mnyam 'byung dka' bas/ /nan tan sgom pa skyed pa gal re che/ /dngos su gzhan la phan pa 'byung dka' bas/ /smon pa sems bskyed bslab pa gal re che/ /chags zhen 'dzin pa med 'di rab dka' bas/ /bags kyis 'dod chung chog shes gal re che/ /de dag bslabs pas myur du mchog la reg /chos byed ru brgyangs bcad pa rnam drug ni/ /yar gyi ru brgyangs lta ba'i gros thag bcad/ /mar gyi ru brgyangs spyod pa'i dus tshod shes/ /phar gyi ru brgyangs yul snang sgyu mar shes/ /tshul gyi ru brgyangs gzung 'dzin zhen pa dor/ /phyi ru ru brgyangs thos bsam phyogs med bya/ /nang gi ru brgyangs rang rgyud dug lnga 'dul/ /de ltar mdzad na 'khor ba'i dmag dpung log /nyon mongs re ba ngan pa'i chos drug ni/ /rang rgyud ma btul gzhan rgyud thul du re/

/go yul rtogs pas gnas lugs shes su re/ /dmigs bcas bsgoms pas nyon mongs 'dag tu re/ / phyogs 'dzin chos kyis thar lam bgrod du re/ /dge ba ma bsgrub mtho ris thob tu re/ /sdig pa ma spangs ngan 'gror mi ltung re/ /re ba'i mi la dgos pa bslus par mchi/ /ma tshor dran pa stor ba'i chos drug ni/ /mi tshe nyon mongs dug lngas 'da' byas nas/ /ngan song 'gro ba ma tshor dran pa stor/ /khyim thab bu tshas 'brel ba'i sgrog zhugs nas/ /sdug bsngal mtshor bying ma tshor dran pa stor/ /dgra gnyen ris bcad chags sdang 'da' byas nas/ /mar 'gro'i las song ma tshor dran pa stor/ /sgo gsum bya byed gang yang ma spangs par/ /sems nyid gnas su re bas dran pa stor/ /tshe 'di'i 'jig rten bya ba ma spangs par/ /thar lam snyogs su re bas (1) dran pa stor/ /stong lta'i tshig la zhen nas rtsol ba stor/ /nyams rtogs drod rtags re bas dran pa stor/ /ma tshor dran pa stor ba'i mi re mang*/ bdag gzhan thun mong dgos pa'i chos drug ni/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam ste chos la bskul/ /dad gus rgyun du bsgoms te rang rgyud 'dul/ /gso sbyong 'bad pas rang gzhan sgrib pa sbyong*/ /sems bskyed bzang pos rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub/ /smin grol ldan pas rang gzhan dge la sbyor/ /nyams len brtson pas rang gzhan 'khrul pa gzhom/ /gces pa'i gnad drug legs par bstan pa ni/ /'di phyi'i 'dun 'gros (2) ngan par ma song gces/ /tha mal rnams dang spyod lam ma 'dres gces/ /sngon las rags pas rgyu 'bras zhib mo gces/ /shes rab snying rje zung du 'brel ba gces/ / thabs kyi 'dod yon lam du slong ba gces/ /dbyer med rtogs pas btsan sa 'dzin pa gces/ /'di dang su ldan rnal 'byor yang rab yin/ /yengs med lam du bslang ba'i chos drug ni/ /dang po'i las can 'du byed ma yengs bya/ /mnyam rjes slob rnams chos nyid ma yengs bya/

/goms pas dran snang ye shes ma yengs bya/ /klong gyur dus su yeng med yeng mkhan med/ /brtan pa mthar phyin yeng yul chos nyid nges/ /chos zad dus na mtshon brjod yul las 'das/ /de 'dra'i tshad du skyol bar mdzad par zhu/ /nor ra re gnyis brtag pa'i chos drug ni/ /mos shing skyo bas shes pa ma bde dang*/ /rkyen ngan dbang gis mi dga' nor ra re/ /tshad med mos gus gting nas skyes pa dang*/ /bcos ma'i dad pa kha nas skyes pa ni/ /yud tsam bltas na phan tshun nor ra re/ /gnyen bshes snang sems 'khri thag chod pa dang*/ /brtse med sems thag ring ba nor ra re/ /yi dam dngos grub mchog rab ster ba dang*/ /bdud kyi bar chad cho 'phrul nor ra re/ /thugs rjes ma lus 'gro ba 'dren pa dang*/ /chos brgyad gzhan don gzugs brnyan nor ra re/ /'od gsal chos nyid ngang la 'byams pa dang*/ /stong pa had por shor ba nor ra re/ /de dag rang bzhin brtag pa'i chos drug ni/ /skyo bas ma bde yul mchog phrad na sangs/ /rkyen ngan gang la dga' ba med pa'o/ /gting nas mos gus lus sems 'gyur ba ste/ /kha nas dad pa dbang po mdangs mi 'gyur/ / 'khri ba chod pas cis kyang dgos med shes/ /sems thag ring ba gnas skabs bye brag 'ong*/ /dngos grub mchog ster nyams dga' byin 'thibs la/ /bdud kyi bar chad skyi zing shes pa 'tshub/ /'gro ba 'dren pa rang 'dod 'khris med la/ / chos brgyad gzhan phan rang 'dod rnyed bkur 'dod/ /chos nyid ngang 'byams dbang po dwangs shing gsal/ /stong pa had po mun 'thoms lta bu ste/ / de phyir ma nor bye brag shes pa gces/ /gcig chog drug gi gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ /skye ba gcig chog da res 'brel thag chod/ /tshogs gsog gcig chog bla ma sangs rgyas khur/ /bya ba gcig chog bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrub/ /bslab pa gcig chog chos min bya ba bor/ /ngo sprod gcig chog 'gyu ba chos nyid sprod/
