/ nyams len gcig chog de nyid ngang la skyongs/ /de la mnyam na myur du bde chen 'grub/ /zab mo gnad kyi gdams pa rnam drug ni/ /chos kyis phan 'dod sems la gang phan bsten/ /rang rgyud 'dul 'dod rang gros rang la thob/ / chos sku thob 'dod thol byung 'gyu ngos gzung*/ /nyams skyong sems nyid yeng bor nang du ltos/ /'gyu dran gcod 'dod rlung sems gcud la bor/ /mthar thug skyel 'dod ma bcos rnal du zhog /'di ni yang zab snying po'i gdams pa yin/ /phyi nang rten 'brel rtags drug man ngag ni/ /dad pa skyes rtags 'jig rten bya ba gtong*/ /byin rlabs zhugs rtags dman pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ /gzhan phan sems rtags ci byas gzhan la phan/ /mngon zhen log rtags chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa'o/ /don dam 'byor rtags gnyis 'dzin ngang gis chung*/ /rang gros thebs rtags dge la rtag par brtson/ /rtags rnams ldan de srid pa'i pha rol 'gro/ /rdzogs pa chen po rdo rje'i tshig drug ni/ /gzhi yi rdzogs chen sems nyid gtan la dbab/ /lam gyi rdzogs chen mtha' grol gnad du bsnun/ /'bras bu'i rdzogs chen re dogs zad sar skyol/ /yul gyi rdzogs chen snang ba 'dzin med grol/ /sems kyi rdzogs chen rnam rtog grogs su 'char/ /don gyi rdzogs chen 'gyu ba rang yal dngas/ /de ltar sus shes rnal 'byor rgyal po che/ /gdeng du tshud pa'i rtags drug 'char ba ni/ /bar do rang zhi skyel ma bzang po 'dra/ /sgrib pa rang dag nor bu rang dngas 'dra/ /nyams myong rang 'bar chang gi glum langs 'dra/ /bde chen rang 'bar gar chang 'thungs pa 'dra/ /sems nyid rang zin sbrang ma rtsi 'byar 'dra/ /byin rlabs shugs 'byung lo thog legs pa 'dra/ /de ltar 'char dus rnal 'byor chen po yin/ /chos byed rnams kyi ma nye rnam drug ni/ /mchod gnas nye 'brel byed pas tshogs gnyis phyogs ma nye/ / sgrub pa dal khom byed pas dngos grub phyogs ma nye/

/dge sbyor rkyen zlog byed pas sangs rgyas phyogs ma nye/ /bzlas brjod long gtam byed pas nus mthu phyogs ma nye/ /yon tan nga rgyal byed pas gnas lugs phyogs ma nye/ /lag len mi chos byed pas lha chos phyogs ma nye/ /de ltar ma song shin tu gces pa lags/ /khe nyen che ba'i gdams pa rnam drug ni/ /dmu rgod dag dang 'brel 'dres byed pa dang*/ /rang rgyud ngan dang chos kyis 'brel pa dang*/ / gnyen po med pas bslab khrims len pa dang*/ /thos bsam med pas sgom pa byed pa dang*/ /dam tshig 'phyal ba'i gsang sngags bsgrub pa dang*/ /ded dpon rgya mtshor nor bu len pa rnams/ /khe nyen che bas legs par brtag pa gces/ /nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag rnam drug ni/ /snang ba ci shar rang ngo rang sangs btang*/ /rig pa ci rig rang byung rang dag bzhag /'gyu ba ci 'gyu bya lam rjes med khyer/ /dbyer med mtha' grol rgya yan ye grol thong*/ /grol mkhan bltas pas 'khor 'das phug stong ltos/ /gnyis 'dzin zhig pas gnas lugs gzhi la bskyal/ /de ltar shes na theg mchog don la mkhas/ /min pa drug gi la shan dbye ba ni/ /bsod nams grags 'dod bla ma bzang po min/ /nor rdzas cher 'dzin chos sgrub bzang po min/ /mi chos gtsor 'dzin rab byung bzang po min/ /bdag lta phyogs 'dzin rnal 'byor bzang po min/ / bskal par rim bgrod gsang sngags bzang po min/ /phyogs lhung rgya chad rdzogs chen bzang po min/ /kun mnyam yangs pa chen por mkhyen 'tshal lo/ / chos nyid don la gzhag pa'i chos drug ni/ /gzung ba'i yul la sgo lngas rten ma byed/ /'dzin pa'i sems la spro bsdus bzo ma byed/ /bde gsal zhen med rnam rtog 'phro ma gzhug /rang byung lhug pa spros pa'i gos ma gon/ /chos nyid rgya yan sems 'dzin sgrog ma gzhug /yangs grol blo yangs 'du shes gzeb ma bcings/ /de ltar sus shes yang dag don la nye/ /theg chen chos don ma go chos drug ni/

/'gro kun rgyal ba'i sras po dam pa la/ /dman pa khyad gsod theg chen don ma go /slong ba thams cad dge bskul drin can la/ /ser sna'i 'jur gegs theg chen don ma ga ོ /gnod byed dgra 'dre bzod pa'i yul mchog la/ /zhe sdang khong khro theg chen don ma go /nyes skyon ngan smras skyon sel gdams ngag la/ /ngar 'dzin ko long theg chen don ma go /rnyed bkur snyan grags phung 'dre'i nang dbyen la/ /chos brgyad rlom sems theg chen don ma go /byin rlabs nus mthu bdud kyi sna 'dren la/ /nga rgyal rlom sems theg chen don ma go /de dag mang bas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ /spangs nas bsdad par bya ba'i chos drug ni/ /'du 'dzi g.yeng ba'i yul spangs dben par sdod/ /sde tshan phyogs ris spangs la 'dris med sdod/ /'jig rten so nam 'brel spangs bde bar sdod/ /mang po'i tshogs spangs gcig tu dben par sdod/ /don dang bya ba mang spangs dben par sdod/ /mi dge lung ma bstan spangs dge bar sdod/ /de ltar bsdad dus bya ba rnam drug ni/ /rig pa gcer bu rang ngo zin par bya/ /sems kyi gnas lugs gtan la dbab par bya/ /shes pa snyam byed 'dun ma bral bar bya/ / dngos 'dzin gza' gtad ched du gzung mi bya/ /brtson 'grus 'dod blo rang sar chod par bya/ /byed mkhan ngo bo zad sar skyol bar bya/ /rig pa bsam gtan gnas pa'i chos drug ni/ /snang tshul ma 'gags bkra yal sing nge ba/ /shes pa ma rmugs ye re sing nge ba/ /'phro rgod ma snyogs rang dngas sing nge ba/ /'phro rgod ma shor mnyam par lhan ne ba/ /rmugs 'thibs med par rang sang lhag ge ba/ /mtha' bzhir ma bskyod rang babs phyal le ba/ /mtshan nyid drug ldan gol sa med pa yin/ /lta sgom nyams su blang ba'i chos drug ni/ /cir snang lta bar shes pas grub mtha'i 'dzin pa grol/ /cir sems sgom par shes pas thun mtshams ris las grol/ /ci byas 'dzin med spyod pas ched 'dzin zhen pa grol/

/cir snang dgongs par shar bas nyams su myong ba grol/ /cir bgrod chos nyid chod pas sa lam tshad mar grol/ /ci bsgrub sku lngar grub pas 'bras bu'i zhen pa grol/ /de 'dra'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' lta bu yin/ /skyon drug brtags te spang bar bya ba ni/ /dad brtson ldan yang bla ma 'bral sngas na/ /lam mthar ma phyin bye'u phrug ma bral 'dra/ /rgyu 'bras go yang 'dod blo ma zhig na/ /rkyen dbang 'chor ba g.yo sgyu khram pa 'dra/ /shes rab che yang nyams su

 ma lon (1) na/ /dgos dus mi bstongs g.yul ngor mtshon stor 'dra/ /rang ngo 'phrod kyang goms 'dris ma byas na/ /rnam rtog dgras khyer g.yul ngo'i bu chung 'dra/ /sgom yun ring yang zhen blo ma zhig na/ /ngal ba don med rabs chad khe grags 'dra/ /yin min shes kyang phyogs ris ma phyed na/ /nyon mongs ro ldang mde'u sha'u 'dra/ /de bas skyon dbang ma song shin tu gces/ /gnas lugs rtogs na mi dgos rnam drug ni/ /rang lus ri bor dri med sems gnas na/ /ri ngogs dben pa'i dgon pa bsten mi dgos/ /gang byung chos nyid ngang las mi 'da' na/ /dus tshod nges gzung sdug rgur mtshams mi dgos/ /snang grags ye shes rol par 'char ba na/ /thun mtshams bar bcad ched du bsgom mi dgos/ /spang thob mtshan ma gzhi la rang dag na/ /mtshan bcas bsags snang 'dun ma btang mi dgos/ /cir snang sku gsum zhing du 'char ba na/ /sgom sgrub yul la gnyen po bsten mi dgos/ /dgongs pa phyogs med rgya yan 'char ba na/ /re dang dogs pa'i 'du shes bskyed mi dgos/ /de dang su ldan ye shes don dang mjal/ /'gro ba drug gi man ngag bstan pa ni/ /mi dge thub pa'i mi de rang bzhin dpa' bor 'gro/ /dug lnga khong gsod mi de skyes bu mthu can 'gro /dmigs 'dzin med pa'i mi de dge sbyor can du 'gro/ /shes bzhin bag yod 'chang de mkhas shing mdzangs par 'gro/ /gnod 'dzugs spong ba'i mi de go mtshon can du 'gro/ /dam can bskor ba'i mi de 'khor 'bangs can du 'gro/ /de ltar ci 'gro bya ba gdams pa'i mchog /bslu bas spang bar bya ba'i chos drug ni/ /rang rig ma bslangs gzhan rig rdzun pos bslu/ /'od gsal ma yin zhi gnas lteng pos bslu/ /chig chod ma yin btang snyoms 'byams pas bslu/ /rang dag ma yin rnam rtog nying 'khrul bslu/ /zung 'jug ma yin byar med kha 'byams bslu/ /rang gnas ma yin rtse gcig sems 'dzin bslu/

/'dra gnyis bslu bas don med ma btang cig /'gro ba drug gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /dmigs med rang bzhin ma rtogs dge bcu 'ching bar 'gro/ /rang la zhen log ma skyes spros med blang dor 'gro/ /chos 'das dbyings su ma byas bsgoms kyang blo byas 'gro/ /thug phrad rang ngo ma rtogs bsgoms kyang bcos mar 'gro/ /ngang dngas gnas lugs ma shes bsgoms kyang rtog par 'gro/ /ye grol 'dzin med ma shes bsgoms kyang mtshan mar 'gro/ /'gro ba'i gnas las log pa shin tu gces/ /gsod pa drug gi gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ /'dre gdon zhi bar 'dod na lus srog gces 'dzin sod/ /mthun 'jug bya bar 'dod na nga rgyal khengs sems sod/ /sdug bsngal zhi bar 'dod na gnyis 'dzin mtshan ma sod/ / gnas lugs dgongs pa 'dod na gnyen po mchog 'dzin sod/ /gnyis med ye shes 'dod na sgom blo'i gnyen po sod/ /tshe gcig byang chub 'dod na phyi shol le lo sod/ /de dag ldan na gang yin bdud bzhi'i dgra las rgyal/ /med pa drug gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /sems can ci mgu byas na rgyal mchod logs na med/ /gzhan don dang len byas na thar lam logs na med/ /dbye bsal gnyis med rtogs na mnyam nyid logs na med/ /yul sems gnyis med rtogs na chos nyid logs na med/ /'khor ba bden med shes na myang 'das logs na med/ /bsgrub mkhan ngo bo stor na gol sgrib bsal du med/ /de ltar rtogs rnams chos sku rang chas 'grub/ /dka' ba drug gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /chos la zhugs dka' de bas mi ldog dka'/ /sde snod shes dka' de bas rgyud sbyor dka'/ /dam tshig thob dka' de bas legs bsrung dka'/ /zab don phrad dka' de bas nyams len dka'/ /dgongs pa skye dka' de bas skyong ba dka'/ /gzhan don byed dka' de bas skyo bzod dka'/ /sangs rgyas 'dod na dka' yang bsgrub 'tshal lo/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i gdams ngag rnam drug ni/

/dad brtson yod na chos kyi sbyin pa la/ /dgos su spyod (1) rgyu yod pa ngo mtshar che/ / mos gus yod na bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /gdams ngag mnyan du yod pa ngo mtshar che/ /zab mo'i thabs kyis zin na 'dod yon lnga/ /ma spangs spyod (2) pas grol ba ngo mtshar che/ /brtson pas nyams su blangs na sems can gyis/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa ngo mtshar che/ /rtogs pa'i ngang la ma yengs bsgoms byas na/ /gting gsal chos nyid mngon gyur ngo mtshar che/ /dkyil 'khor gsum la rtag tu 'dris byas na/ /sku gsum ye shes 'char ba ngo mtshar che/ /chos byed rnams kyi skyon drug bstan pa ni/ /bye brag mi shes lta ba'i mig dang bral/ /gtan du dgos pa dge sbyor grogs dang bral/ /thar par khrid byed bshes gnyen long khrid med/ /thogs par byed pa thos bsam 'khar ba chag /mi 'dod nyon mongs gzung 'dzin gdon gyis brlabs/ /thar med srid las ngan song g.yang 'phyong (3) ba/ /nyes pa drug ldan 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /snying rjes bzod dka' mchi ma 'khrug na'ang/ /las ngan ma zad drang ba'i thabs dang bral/ /log par ma song drug gi gdams pa ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la zhabs tog ma grub kyang*/ /sdig pa ma sog ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa soms/ /bla ma mchog la mos gus ma grub kyang*/ /sgro skur ma 'debs log lta'i nyes dmigs soms/ /mched grogs rnams la brtse gdung ma 'grub kyang*/ /phrag dog ma byed dam nyams nyes dmigs soms/ /rang gi pha chos gzhung bzhin ma grub kyang*/ /chos mdzad ma smad las ngan nyes dmigs soms/ /'khrul snang dngos la bden 'dzin ma zhig kyang*/ /rtag par ma 'dzin phyi nang 'gyur ba soms/ /dngos su gzhan la phan 'dogs ma 'grub kyang*/ /gnod pa ma skyel las 'bras rten 'brel soms/ / nyan na rigs pa drug gi gdams ngag ni/ /cung zad bya ba chag pa'i sdug bsngal ltos/ /dge sbyor chag la sdug bsngal bya bar rigs/

/dngos po'i bde 'gyur chag pa'i sdug bsngal ltos/ /nyams myong 'phel chag sdug bsngal bya bar larigs/ /zhag gcig zas skom chag pa'i sdug bsngal ltos/ /thun bzhi'i dge sbyor chag la sdug bsngal rigs/ /tshe 'di'i dgra mgo ma thul sdug bsngal ltos/ /nyon mongs dgra mgo shor la sdug bsngal rigs/ /'khrul ba'i bza' tsho shi ba'i sdug bsngal ltos/ /gtan grogs chos dang bral la sdug bsngal rigs/ /bya byed cung zad chag pa'i sdug bsngal ltos/ /dal 'byor chos spyod chag la sdug bsngal rigs/ /rigs pa'i don la bsams na shin tu dge /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i bor ba rnam drug ni/ /'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab 'jig rten bya ba bor/ /byur gyi gdos thag khyim thab bu tsha bor/ /byis pa'i rtsed mo 'khrul snang bden zhen bor/ /mgo bskor slu brid 'dod yon longs spyod bor/ /bdud kyi zhags pa gzhan gyi bkur gnas bor/ /pha mes phung sri ma rig gzung 'dzin bor/ /de ltar byas na 'khor ba'i gnas las thar/ /gdams pa'i gnas drug chings su bstan pa ni/ /thug phrad kun grol ma shes snang ba'i rtog mi choms/ /cer mthong cer grol ma shes gnyis 'dzin rtsad mi chod/ /nyams myong gting gsal ma shes mi rtog ltengs por 'chor/ /gnyis snang 'khrul par ma go zhen chags 'khris mi chod/ /tshe la long med ma shes dge sbyor thang lhod 'chor/ /rig pa'i rtsal kha ma 'byongs 'gro drug g.yang mi chod/ /de dag gnad la legs par bslab pa gces/ /mthar thug drug gis gnad 'gag bsdam pa ni/ /sdug pa'i mthar thug yin gyis gzhan gyi mgo dpon bor/ /skyid pa'i mthar thug yin gyis bya ba thengs par gyis/ /phung ba'i mthar thug yin gyis mi dge'i spyod pa spangs/ / 'tshengs pa'i mthar thug yin gyis dge la spyod pa bsgrubs/ /bzang po'i mthar thug yin gyis 'jig rten rgyab tu bor/ /ngan pa'i mthar thug yin gyis chos las ldog pa zhog

/de ltar byas na yang rab dam pa'i rtse/ /spang ba drug gis rang rgyud gdul ba ni/ /mi gtsang gcin rtug yin gyis zas kyi sred pa chod/ /snyan grags brag cha yin gyis 'jig rten grags pa spangs/ /'khrul snang dgra ru ldang gis chags sdang 'dun ma spangs/ /dug lnga'i mtshon cha 'dzugs kyis gzung 'dzin nga bdag spangs/ /che btsan lha chos 'chor gyis mi chen lab mo spangs/ / sdig 'phel dge sbyor chag gis nor rdzas gsog brun spangs/ /de ltar byas na sgrub pa 'phel bar mchi/ /chos nyid don dang mjal ba'i chos drug ni/ /cer mthong ngo shes nyams myong gting nas sad/ /nyams zhen rang log snang ba rjes med sangs/ /'jig rten rtog bral ye shes zang thal shar/ /'di drug su ldan chos nyid nyams su myong/ /'du shes drug gi gdams pa bstan pa ni/ /dus gsum thun phye mi rtag 'du shes sgoms/ /gnyen dang mdza' bshes 'gron po'i 'du shes sgoms/ /gar 'dug gnas la 'gron khang 'du shes sgoms/ /zas nor longs spyod rtsed mo'i 'du shes sgoms/ /bya ba gang byed rmi lam 'du shes sgoms/ /nye ring gar 'gro 'chi ba'i 'du shes sgoms/ /de dag ldan na 'khor ba'i gnas las thar/ /gces pa drug gi gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ /sems nyid don mthong rtogs pa'i rang nyams gces/ /gdams ngag mtshang shes go ba'i shes rab gces/ /dka' ba'i gnad khrol grub mtha'i don mthong gces/ /go cha thub pa'i tshul khrims rnam dag gces/ /'khrul ba chod pa'i shes rab dri med gces/ / ched 'dzin grol ba'i spyod pa gtad med gces/ /lam du slong ba spyi yi chos drug ni/ /mar gyi zag chu bsdams pa'i rgyu 'bras phra mo spyad/ /yar gyi phu thag bsrings pa mthon po'i rtse mo snyegs/ /bar gyi 'phred kha bcad pa chos spyod srang du gzhug /sbyor ba theg dman las ldog byang chub sems bskyed bya/ / dngos gzhi bden zhen dgag pa rang bzhin med shes dang*/

/rjes la lam du bsgyur ba 'khor gsum dag par bsngo/ /de drug ldan na dge sbyor lam du 'gro/ / 'khrol chags yangs pa chen po'i chos drug ni/ /blo rgya chung bas mi 'ong sde snod 'khrol shes dgos/ /shes nas 'byams pas mi 'ong gdams ngag 'khrol shes dgos/ /zab mos skrag pas mi 'ong rgyud sde'i 'khrol shes dgos/ /tshig phyir 'brengs pas mi 'ong bsgrub pa'i 'khrol shes dgos/ /phyogs cha'i grub mthas mi 'ong gang la 'khrol shes dgos/ /the tshom som nyis mi 'ong nges shes 'khrol shes dgos/ /de ltar sus shes chos kun gcig tu 'dus/ /yang dag don la sbyar ba'i chos drug ni/ /ci bslab gzhan gyi don du sbyar ba dang*/ /snying rjes sdug bsngal rang nyams sbyar ba dang*/ /longs spyod ci byung tshogs su gtang ba dang*/ / sdom gsum dam tshig gtsang ma bsrung ba dang*/ /spyod lam chos nyid dag dang ma bral dang*/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba gdab pa rnams/ /dam pa'i rnam thar yin no rjes su bsgrub/ /na ba lam du bslang ba'i chos drug ni/ /na bas 'khor ba'i las ngan zad par byed/ /na bas nyon mongs dri ma 'khru bar byed/ / na bas mos gus gdung ba'i gsol 'debs byed/ /na bas brtson 'grus dge sbyor bskul ma byed/ /na bas thar ba'i lam dang sprod par byed/ /na bas rtsal sbyong bogs 'don gsal 'debs byed/ /de phyir na ba mkhas pas lam du bslang*/ /shes pa drug gi gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ /gnod byed dgra 'dre phan 'dogs lhar shes dang*/ /nye 'brel brtse gdung mar 'dren gnod skyel dang*/ / rang rgyud nyon mongs dgra sdang tsher ma dang*/ /ngar 'dzin srung skyob gnod byed 'gong po dang*/ /mi mthun rkyen ngan thar lam bogs 'byin dang*/ /snyan grags bstod pa skyon gyi ngan tshang du/ /shes par bya ba shin tu rnam drug gces/ /nges don snying po'i gdams ngag rnam drug ni/ /skye med ngang las 'khrul gzhi ngos gzung zhing*/

/'gag med 'char dus 'khrul pa rtsad nas chod/ /gnyis med rtogs pas 'khor ba ru bzlog cing*/ /blo dngos rang grol mtha' bzhi'i gegs rnams bsal/ /lta bas phu bcad 'khor 'das khog dgrol zhing*/ /spyod pas mda' khrol spyod lam lam du slong*/ /'di dag zab don snying po mthar thug yin/ /bya ba drug gis gnad du brdeg pa ni/ /mi gzhi 'gyur med chos las mi bzlog bya/ /sems la g.yo med gzhan gyis ma khrel bya/ /dad gus 'grib med res 'gar ma song bya/ /bslab gsum gces spras nyes ltung ma gos bya/ /rtag tu 'chi bsam snyom las ma lus bya/ /thug phrad nyon mongs gnyen pos rang grol bya/ /de drug ldan na dgos pa thams cad 'grub/ /ye shes sbar ba'i gdams pa rnam drug ni/ /'dzin med ngang du snang ba sa le ba/ /gnyis med ngang du mnyam par lhan ne ba/ /gsal dag ngang du rang dngas sang nge ba/ /'od gsal ngang du rang gsal sal le ba/ /chos nyid ngang du dga' 'dzum shig ge ba/ /blo 'das dbyings su yangs pa phyal le ba/ /ma bcos rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen por 'grub/ /rang bzhin gnad dang bsre ba'i chos drug ni/ /rang rig blo 'das gnyug ma'i ye shes la/ /rang babs sgom pa 'od gsal chen po ni/ /grims par bsgrims la lhod par glod pa ste/ /phyal bar ma shor ma yengs dran pas zin/ /'phro gnas ris med mnyam pa'i ngang gcig la (1) / /phyogs bral nam mkha' 'dra ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /chos sku phyag rgya chen por lhun gyis grub/ /mi gnas 'pho 'gyur med pa'i chos drug ni/ /rig pa stong gsal spros dang bral ba la/ /gzung 'dzin re dogs dri mas ma bslad par/ /rang babs so ma gcer bu rang ga'i ngang*/ /mi bsam mi spyod mi sgom mi rtog par/ /sal le seng nge ye re wal le ba/ /shar grol ris med tha mal shes pa ni/ /ma lus sdug bsngal spros kun zhi byed yin/ /chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i chos drug ni/ /mtha' grol rig pa nam mkha' lta bu la/

/'khor 'das ris med spang blang tha snyad bral/ /byar med chos sku gzhi grol lta ba'i ngang*/ /gang la'ang mi sems dmigs 'dzin bral ba ni/ /gnas lugs rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin/ /blo yi snyems bral zhen pa'i 'khris chod pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi spyod yul lhun gyis grub/ /rig pa chos nyid gnas pa'i tshad drug ni/ /dad pa'i ngang la khams sos yal le ba/ /gnas lugs ngang la lhun chags mer re ba/ /bsam gtan ngang la brjid chags lhan ne ba/ /nyams myong ngang la bkrag phyin sal le ba/ /chos nyid ngang la dngas chags sang nge ba/ /rang rig ngang la ngar chags hur re ba/ /de ltar bsgoms pas ye shes rig pa'i klong*/ /skal bzang snod dang ldan pa'i chos drug ni/ /mos gus tshud pas ci byas dad mi ldog /chos la dad pas dge sdig rgyu 'bras 'dzem/ /dam tshig gtsang bas mched la brtse gdung che/ /chos dang 'dres pas dge sbyor gces spras byed/ /gnyen po che bas rkyen ngan rang sar grol/ / brod pa rnyed pas sgom sgrub brtson pa ni/ /dam chos rin chen snod mchog lags par gsungs/ /snod ngan don chung chos drug bstan pa ni/ /yun ring bsgoms kyang rang rgyud ma grol na/ /dgon par gnas kyang don chung ri dwags 'dra/ /sde snod shes kyang gnyen por ma song na/ /thos bsam che yang don chung ne tso 'dra/ /

bla ma bsten yang gdams pa ma lon na/ /mdo stor rgya mtsho'i 'gram du skom rid lus/ /gdams ngag yod kyang rgyud la ma 'byor na/ /bcangs pa don chung sman dpyad yi ge 'dra/ /drod rtags thob kyang sems nyid ma rtogs na/ /sgom pa don chung mu stegs lam zhugs 'dra/ /dka' spyad che yang yon tan ma skyes na/ /'bad pa don chung spang phug phyi ba 'dra/ /de bas gnad du 'gro ba shin tu gces/ /bla ma mchog gi rtags drug bstan pa ni/ /bsten tshe bag dro chos la blo 'gro na/ /bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs sprin phung yod pa'i rtags/ /slob ma sgrub bcug yon tan sna mang na/ /zab mo'i snyan brgyud gdams pa che ba'i rtags/ / 'khor dang yo byad gzhan shor phrag dog med/ /'jig rten mngon zhen 'dod blo zad pa'i rtags/ /blo rig gang yang lam du 'jug shes na/ /'gro don thabs mkhas thugs rje yod pa'i rtags/ /sdug bsngal ba la phan 'dogs rgya che na/ /tshad med sems bskyed snying rje 'byongs pa'i rtags/ /khong yangs blo bde bya ba bral ba na/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i gdeng dang ldan pa'i rtags/ /de 'dra'i mtshan ldan bla ma btsal la bsten/ /chos sgrub rnams kyi rtags drug spang ba ni/ /mi chos kha 'dzin che na chags sdang yod pa'i rtags/ /ci byas sdang bar mthong na log lta skyes pa'i rtags/ /'khrul snang gces 'dzin mang na dge sbyor 'grib pa'i rtags/ /pha yul yo byad sog na chos las log pa'i rtags/ /tshe 'di don du gnyer na bar chad bdud kyi rtags/ / chos la nges shes med na thar lam stor ba'i rtags/ /nor ba drug gi rang bzhin spang ba ni/ /'di phyi'i skyabs gnas bla ma mi mchod par/ /mgu byed nye 'brel skyong ba shin tu nor/ /dngos grub rtsa ba bzlas brjod mi byed par/ /zad med long gtam gtong ba shin tu nor/ /dad sogs 'phags pa'i nor bdun mi gsog par/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba nor sog shin tu nor/

/sems nyid don gyi gnas lugs mi sgom par/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i bya ba bsgrub pa nor/ /nyes pa'i 'byung gnas ngar 'dzin mi 'dul bar/ / khe grags lo 'dod mngon rlom byed pa nor/ /ma rig mun sel thos bsam mi byed par/ /snyam byed mun pa'i blun sgom byed pa nor/ /nor ba spangs na thar lam nye bar 'gyur/ /gdams ngag drug gis gnad du bsnun pa ni/ /rkang (1) med yur bar mi 'bab mkhas pa'i bla ma bsten/ /'khrul bar 'gro ba'i rten yin log dman bya ba dor/ /gzhan gyi ngan spyod 'go bas mi dang 'grogs mi bya/ /bsam gtan g.yeng ba'i tsher ma tha snyad tshig ma rtsod/ /brel do zin pa'i dus med bya byed 'phro la bor/ /dngos grub ring bar 'gyur bas yi dam gzhan ma spel/ /bza' btung sred pa 'phel bas gang byung 'tsho ba bsten/ /de ltar byas na kun spyod dge ba 'phel/ /slob dpon ngan pa'i skyon drug 'go ba ni/ / bshes gnyen ngan pa bsten pa'i slob ma dag /grub mtha' ngan pas rtag chad mthar 'dzin 'go /spyod pa ngan pas mi dge log par 'khrid/ /grub rtags ngan pas khong khro gdug rtsub 'phel/ /sgom pa ngan pas 'khrul snang bag chags sbyor/ /nyams len ngan pas 'jig rten chos la 'chel/ /'bras bu ngan pas 'khor ba ngan song ltung*/ /de phyir dad ldan thar lam gnyer rnams kyis/ /bar chad bdud du slob dpon ngan pa che/ /de bas brtags te rab tu spang bar bya/ /grogs ngan spyod pa 'go ba'i chos drug ni/ /bsam med byis dang 'grogs na don chung spyod pa 'go /na phrad gzhon dang 'grogs na rtse rgod spyod pa 'ag ོ khyim pa rnams dang 'grogs na so nam khe grags 'go tshong pa dag dang 'grogs na khe spogs gsog brun 'go /zhe sdang can dang 'grogs na gdug rtsub spyod pa 'go /gnyen bshes skyong dang 'grogs na lto gos bza' 'tshol 'go /de bas grogs ngan spangs la grogs bzang chos ldan bsten/ /byur ngan khyim thab bsten pa'i nyes drug ni/

/mi rtag rgyud la skyes kyang sgrub pa le los 'khyer/ /dad pa shes rab 'dzom yang bya ba'i skabs mi rnyed/ /tshe 'di dgos med shes kyang 'jig rten blos mi thongs (1) / /zab mo'i gdams pa yod kyang nyams len yid smon lus/ /thos bsam shes rgya che yang rang gzhan phan mi thogs/ /gnas lugs lta ba go yang tha mal ngang du 'chi/ /de 'dra'i dbang du ma song shin tu gzab par bya/ /bslu brid bdud kyi chos drug bstan pa ni/ /nor sred can rnams rdzas kyis bslus pa'i bdud/ /mkhyen rgya can rnams yon tan bslus pa'i bdud/ /mthon po'i rigs rnams skyes pas bslus pa'i bdud/ /'du ba can rnams bsod nams bslus pa'i bdud/ /las ngan can rnams rkyen ngan bslus pa'i bdud/ /grags 'dod can rnams gtam gyis bslus pa'i bdud/ /shin tu mang bas de dbang ma song bya/ /bslab nyes dred por song ba'i skyon drug ni/ /tha mal bsam blo bya byed long gtam mang*/ /'khrul ba'i nyes spyod gcig phyir gcig mthud 'byung*/ /lta bar bdag 'dzin chags sdang sna tshogs spyod/ /sgom par ngan sems log lta rgyun mi 'chad/ /spyod par mi dge chos min sna tshogs spyod/ / chos la blo 'dred tshe 'di'i dbang song ba/ /de dag thar pa'i lam stor dred po ste/ /bslab nyes ngan lang che bas ring du spang*/ /dge sdig 'dres ma spang ba'i chos drug ni/ /bcud med chags sdang 'phel ba'i slob dpon ma bsten cig / snod med nyes skyon rtogs pa'i slob ma ma bsten cig /mi dge sdig pa bsags pa'i dge ba ma byed cig /bkur sti kha lan re ba'i sbyin pa ma btang cig /zas nor nye 'brel gso ba'i mchod pa ma byed cig /g.yo sgyus rnyed pa 'tshol ba'i chos bshad ma btang cig /'di la nyan na chos dang mthun par 'ong*/ /lo 'dod don dang 'gal ba'i chos drug ni/ /tha mal blo ma log pa'i chos pa yin lo dang*/ /dad gus bsnyen bkur med pa'i bla ma bsten lo dang*/

/ chos dang rang rgyud ma 'dres ston chen yin lo dang*/ /'du 'dzi snyom las ma spangs dgon pa bsten lo dang*/ /yon tan gong du mi 'phel bsam gtan sgom lo dang*/ /sgrub pa gnad du ma bsnun gzhan don byed lo dang*/ /'di drug 'dra min 'chol bas mkhas pas ring du spang*/ /zol ma drug gis bslu ba'i chos drug ni/ /lta ba zol ma gdeng du ma tshud pa'i/ /g.yom rgyug spros bral 'dis kyang rang sems slu/ /sgom pa zol ma gnad du ma thebs pa'i/ /blun sgom yid dpyod 'dis kyang rang sems slu/ /spyod pa zol ma bag dang mi ldan pa'i/ /smyo spyod rtsing po 'dis kyang rang sems slu/ /dam tshig zol ma nyes ltung mi 'dzem pa'i/ /srung sdom ngo lkog 'dis kyang rang sems slu/ /thos bsam zol ma sangs rgyas mi 'dod pa'i/ /nga mkhas grags 'dod 'dis kyang rang sems slu/ /'bras bu zol ma sems nyid ma rtogs pa'i/ /phyi dus yid smon 'dis kyang rang sems slu/ /slu brid dbang du ma song shin tu gces/ /mi rigs bya ba spang ba'i chos drug ni/ /pha mes bla 'tshong chos dpag khram ma byed/ /spun grogs dme shor mched grogs rtsod ma byed/ /spyi yul khrims 'jigs chos min las ma byed/ /ngan skyugs dug 'thor gzhan gyi rngan ma 'dren/ /tshod med zhal btse gang zag chos ma gshe /ma bcol gnyer ba mi chos 'dun ma zhog /bcol zhing dbang ba chos kyis sangs rgyas bsgrub/ /tshul bzhin chos la bsgrub par zhugs rnams kyis/ /grong yul phyin pa'i nyes pa rnam drug ni/ /nyams grib phog pas nyams dang byin rlabs yal/ /nyon mongs ldang bas bslab gsum srung sdom shor/ / dam bca' 'chag pas rkyen dang bar chad mang*/ /'khrul snang 'gos pas lta sgom rtsal gsum shor/ /tha mal 'gos pas rang rgyud chos las 'dred/ /las ngan dbang gis tha mal khyim thab 'gro/ /de phyir grong yul mi 'grim dben pa bsten/ /rgya lam 'gro yang btson ra'i 'du shes kyis/

/dbang po yul la ma yengs shin tu gzab/ /bsgrub pa'i gnas drug chings su bcing ba ni/ /lta ba'i gnas lugs sangs rgyas dgongs par skyol/ /nyams len man ngag thabs kyis gnad du gzir/ /rig pa'i ye shes gtan tshigs 'gag tu gtems/ /skye tshul gnad rnams yul snang thug phrad grol/ /thams cad sems nyid 'gyur med ngang du bsdam/ /chos spyi rdzogs pa chen por bcing ba ste/ /'di dag gnad bsnun tshe 'dis byang chub 'grub/ /gzhi drug 'dings pa'i gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ / shes rab gzhi 'dings thos bsam sbyor ba dang*/ /theg chen gzhi 'dings sems bskyed bslab pa dang*/ /byin rlabs gzhi 'dings brgyud pa bzang ba dang*/ rtogs pa'i gzhi 'dings sems nyid rtogs pa dang*/ /yon tan gzhi 'dings dad brtson 'brel ba dang*/ /bde skyid gzhi 'dings 'khor ba spang ba ste/ /dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa'i rjes su slob/ /zang zing nor rdzas bsags pa'i skyon drug ni/ /dug lnga'i rten yin chags sdang zag pa 'phel/ /ser sna'i 'ching byed yi dwags las ngan sog /'jig rten chos song byang chub lam dang bral/ /skyed 'phel bskyang srung (1) mi tshe sdug bsngal zad/ /nyams len chos 'dzol lha mi'i ngan smras 'du/ /bar chad bdud yin tha mal srog la rgol/ /de bas nor rdzas gsog brun skyed 'phel kun/ /dam chos sgrub pas ring du spang bar bya/ /bza' tshang legs par btsal ba'i chos drug ni/ /pha yi dam par chos dbyings 'gyur med tshol/ /ma yi dam par rang byung ye shes tshol/ /bu yi dam par rang byung khye'u chung tshol/ /grogs kyi dam par gnyis med zung 'jug tshol/ /nor gyi dam par sems nyid nor bu tshol/ /gnas kyi dam par sku gsum zhing khams tshol/ /de dag 'dzom na rig pa'i gtan yul zin/ /nyams len srol du 'jug pa'i chos drug ni/ /'khor ba'i skyel mar skyabs 'gro nyams su blang*/ /so nam las su chos spyod nyams su blang*/

/myur mgyogs rta phor thabs lam nyams su blang*/ / nor gyi dbyig tu tshogs gnyis nyams su blang*/ khe spogs 'phel du yon tan nyams su blang*/ /zas skom bcud du gdams ngag nyams su blang*/ /de ltar sus byas gong ma'i brgyud pa zin/ /rig pa lam gzhug gdams ngag rnam drug ni/ / skabs su rang snang mthun pa'i rkyen grogs ltos/ /rang snang shes pas nyams myong grogs su 'char/ /skabs su mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen snang ltos/ /'khrul pa zhen log gnad du che ba yin/ /skabs su grogs dang gzhan gyi bla ma ltos/ / bzang ngan shes na nyams len bskul ma yin/ /skabs su mkha' la 'byung bzhi'i cho 'phrul ltos/ /sems nyid ngang du 'bad rtsol zhig pa shes/ /skabs su rang gi yul mkhar longs spyod ltos/ /sgyu mar shes pas 'khrul snang zhen pa log /skabs su gzhan gyi mi nor longs spyod ltos/ /snying rjer shes pas 'khor ba'i 'dod pa spong*/ /mdor na sna tshogs snang ba'i chos rnams la/ /rang bzhin brtags pas bden zhen 'khrul pa 'jig /bltas pas legs par mthong ba'i chos drug ni/ /phyi rol snang ba dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog ltos/ /mi rtag skyo shas blo sna thung ba 'char/ /phan btags lan du gnod pa byed pa ltos/ /snying nas zhen log thun mong ma yin 'char/ /don med gzhan gyis chags sdang byed pa ltos/ / nges 'byung drag pos gang la'ang dgos med 'char/ /bskyangs pa'i bu tshas pha mar mi bstongs ltos/ /gzhan la blo ltos re ba chung ba 'char/ /'byor ldan shi nas sgren mor song ba ltos/ /yo byad gnyen 'dun zhen pa log pa 'char/ /thar lam ded dpon bla ma'i sku drin ltos/ /snying nas mos gus mchi ma g.yo ba 'char/ /de ltar bde sdug 'khrul ba'i rkyen rnams la/ /legs par bsams te nges 'byung skyo shas bskyed/ /skabs su legs par lta ba'i chos drug ni/ /skabs su rang gzhan lus kyi byed spyod ltos/ /gar mkhan rtsed mo 'drar mthong bden med 'char/

/skabs su ngag gi smra brjod sgra la ltos/ /grags stong brag ca 'drar mthong brjod med 'char/ /skabs su yid kyi bde sdug ci shar ltos/ /rig pa'i rol par mthong bas gnas lugs 'char/ /skabs su 'gyu dran rtog pa'i rang ngo ltos/ /rang yal shes pa chos sku cer mthong 'char/ /skabs su sems nyid ma g.yos ngang la ltos/ /'phro 'du med mthong zad pa'i dgongs pa 'char/ /skabs su cog gzhag bya btsal bral la ltos/ /byar med mthong bas blo bde khong nas 'char/ /de ltar sus shes zab mo'i don la mkhas/ /rang bzhin legs par bsam pa'i chos drug ni/ /skye rga na 'chi'i dmag la bag zon bskyed/ /sngar bsags las kyi bu lon da res sbyangs/ /gzung 'dzin 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las da res bros/ /rnam smin sdig pa'i khur po rgyab tu bor/ /'dzad nges tshe yi thar lam byang chub sgrubs/ /'chi ba'i la chen rgal la bsam blo thong*/ /de ltar byas na thar ba'i skam sar snyegs/ /gcud la bor ba'i dam chos rnam drug ni/ /skyug log bsam pas 'khor ba gcud la bor/ /brtson 'grus bsten nas nyams len gcud la bor/ /mos gus gsol bas bla ma gcud la bor/ /dam tshig bsnyen sgrub yi dam gcud la bor/ /gtor tshogs brtson pas mkha' 'gro gcud la bor/ /yang zab gdams pas lta sgom gcud la bor/ /de ltar sus byas dngos grub myur du thob/ /mnyam pa drug dgos legs par bstan pa ni/ /'gro drug pha mar shes pas dgra dang bu mnyam dgos/ /nor rdzas 'khrul snang shes pas gser dang bong mnyam dgos/ /gshis la las 'bras med pas dge sdig mnyam shes dgos/ /tshogs drug chos nyid shes pas mnyam rjes med shes dgos/ /nyon mongs ye shes gsal bas spang blang med shes dgos/ /gnas lugs gdod nas dag pas 'khor 'das mnyam shes dgos/ /de ltar mnyam shes chen po'i rnal 'byor yin/ /mi 'jug drug gi gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ /cir snang bden med rtogs pas 'khrul snang yid mi 'jug

/ci byas don med rtogs pas 'jig rten yid mi 'jug /rang don gol sar rtogs pas theg dman yid mi 'jug /gzhi la skye med rtogs pas skye 'gag yid mi 'jug / sems nyid dmigs med rtogs pas mtshan 'dzin yid mi 'jug /chos nyid bya bral rtogs pas rtsol sgrub yid mi 'jug /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags su shugs la 'char/ /ma song drug gi gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ /lam khyer g.yom rgyug ma song phra rags rnam rtog 'joms/ /sa lam g.yom rgyug ma song sgrib gnyis spang bya zhing*/ /rgyu 'bras g.yom rgyug ma song dge sdig blang dor byed/ / sgom pa g.yom rgyug ma song rang gsal 'dzin pa med/ /spyod pa g.yom rgyug ma song bya byed chos la spyod/ /mdzad spyod g.yom rgyug ma song dam pa'i rnam thar skyong*/ /de dang gang ldan dam chos snying por 'grub/ /skyon drug spong bar gdams pa'i chos drug ni/ /lta ba rtogs chog de nas bya rgyu med/ /nyams len kha 'byams skyon de ngos zin dgos/ /bsam gtan rang gsal ngang du gnas pa btsal/ /sgom pa snyems byed don de ngos zin dgos/ /dngas gsal ma phyed bying 'thibs 'khyim pa tsam/ /sems 'dzin gol ba'i skyon de ngos zin dgos/ /gcig la a 'thas drod rtags skyes na yang*/ /kor tser bcings pa'i skyon de ngos zin dgos/ gcig la bltas pas gnyis su byung tshor 'phro//rnam rtog rkun bu'i skyon de ngos zin dgos/ /mnyam gzhag dus na dug lnga mgo non yang*/ /rjes la rags skye rtsa ba ma chod skyon/ /da rung sems nyid ma rtogs ngos zin dgos/ /ngos zin byas te gnyen pos grol ba gces/ /la bzla drug gis 'khor ba bsgral ba ni/ /gnas lugs rang bzhin blo yi yul las 'das/ /gzhi yi dus su sems kyi chos la rtog

/myong 'dzin zhen rtog 'khor ba'i chos yin pas/ /lam gyi dus su nyams myong chos mi sgom/ /rnam dag spyod yul 'khor 'das gnyis med pas/ /'bras bu'i dus na sems can don mi byed/ /rang rig blo yis ma bslad gnas lugs gzhi/ /shes bya'i yul dang bral bas spros dang bral/ /spyir yang mi shes mi 'dzin yang dag lam/ /dran bsam 'tshol 'phro'i dmigs gtad kun dang bral/ /mtshan mar mi dmigs mthar thug 'bras bu'i mchog /sgrib med zang ka rang gsal phyogs lhung bral/ /de ltar sus shes yangs pa'i rnal 'byor che/ /rtogs pa drug gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /gzhan gyis sgras rtogs bla ma'i man ngag dang*/ /snang ba'i yul rtogs bden med sgyu ma dang*/ /'dzin pa'i sems rtogs rtsa bral nam mkha' dang*/ / rig pa'i ngo rtogs sgrib med gcer bu dang*/ /mthong ba'i don rtogs blo yi mtha' 'das dang*/ /sgom pa'i gdeng rtogs gzhi ma'i zad sa ste/ /gang gis de rtogs dgongs pa nam mkha'i ngang*/ /bya byed med par ye babs lhun gyis grub/ /bdud kyi bar du gcod pa'i chos drug ni/ /bla ma bor nas sdig grogs bsten pa dang*/ /byang chub bor nas 'khor ba'i lam zhugs dang*/ /rang don bor nas gzhan don ltar snang byed/ /dgos med bor nas 'jig rten chos brgyad gnyer/ /dben pa bor nas 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng zhugs/ /gnyis med bor nas mtshan ma tshig phyir 'breng*/ /de 'dra'i mi la bdud kyis byin brlabs pas/ /'di phyir sdug bsngal gtan gyi 'dun ma 'phyugs/ /yeng med bya ra btang ba'i chos drug ni/ /spyod pa'i rang bzhin glang chen yan 'dra 'di/ /nyam nga'i 'dam du tshud dam bya ra btang*/ /lta ba'i rang bzhin snang stong dbyer med 'di/ /bdag 'dzin 'dre yis khyer ram bya ra btang*/ /rig pa'i ngang dngas 'od gsal khye'u chung 'di/ /'khrul pa'i rjes phyir 'brangs sam bya ra btang*/ /byin rlabs rtsa ba mos gus lo thog 'di/

/log lta'i sad kyis khyer ram bya ra btang*/ /byang chub thar lam bgrod pa'i sgron me 'di/ /'dod pa'i rlung gis g.yos sam bya ra btang*/ /'chi med bdud rtsi bla ma'i gdams ngag 'di/ /the tshom dug dang 'dres sam bya ra btang*/ /de phyir yeng med bya ra gces pa yin/ / yang dag don la mi rtogs chos drug ni/ /skye blos skye med mi rtogs blo 'das phyir/ /dngos blos stong nyid mi rtogs yul 'das phyir/ /bya blos byar med mi rtogs bya bral phyir/ /snyam blos gnyis med mi rtogs bsam bral phyir/ /zhen blos mtha' bral mi rtogs phyogs bral phyir/ /spyod blos spros med mi rtogs spros 'das phyir/ /dngos po mtshan mar ma 'dzin gnas lugs don/ /ma bsams zang ka tha mal dmigs rtog bral/ / gnas lugs rang ngo brtag pa'i chos drug ni/ /rang rig zang ka bcos bslad med pa ni/ /tha mal ma yin lung ma bstan las log /kun rtog ma yin gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral/ /gnyen po sems min spang gnyen kun las 'das/ /gzhan gyis mi mthong so sor rang rig ste/ /rang zhes mi dmigs dmigs myong kun las 'das/ /rtag tu yod kyang gsang 'di shes dka' bas/ /rtogs dang mi rtogs kun 'das kun khyab yin/ /gang gis 'di shes gnas lugs don la mkhas/ /rang bzhin mngon du phyung ba'i chos drug ni/ /rtogs pa'i dus na rang gsal sang nge ba/ /mi rtog dus na ma 'gags wal le ba/ /cir snang dus na rang gsal lhag ge ba/ /gzung 'dzin dus na kun gsal sal le ba/ /mnyam gzhag dus na mtha' grol sang nge ba/ /'phro gnas mnyam dus bar med ha re ba/ /'di 'dra'i gnad shes rnal 'byor rtse mor phyin/ /khyad du bsad nas bsgrub pa rnam drug ni/ /ngal dub bkres skom sdug bsngal khyad bsad dgos/ /mi yul 'brel 'dris so nam khyad bsad dgos/ /dgra gnyen chags sdang khe grags khyad bsad dgos/ /sgo lnga'i yul la chags zhen khyad bsad dgos/

/bstod smad tshig la dgag sgrub khyad bsad dgos/ /dran rtog rang yal spang gnyen khyad bsad dgos/ /de ltar ldan na thar lam byang chub 'grub/ /pha rol phyin drug ma bral bsgrub pa ni/ /sbyin pa ser sna'i dgra la ma bskur cig /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i jag pas ma 'joms shig /bzod pa khong khro'i mtshon gyis ma dbug cig /brtson 'grus le lo'i sgrog tu ma 'chings shig /bsam gtan g.yeng ba'i dug dang ma bsre zhig /shes rab rmongs pa'i mun pas ma bsgribs shig /de ltar mi mthun drug po spangs la sgrubs/ /'brel med drug gi rang bzhin bshad pa ni/ /sdug bsngal rgyan mthong mi la thar pa'i las 'brel med/ /spyod pa ngo srung mi la 'khrul zhig las 'brel med/ /thos bsam khe grags mi la nyams len las 'brel med/ /mi dge sdig spyod mi la mtho ris las 'brel med/ /snyom las le lo'i mi la nyams myong las 'brel med/ /bdag lta chags sdang mi la bsgrub pa'i las 'brel med/ /de 'dra'i 'brel med dbang du rang nyid ma song gces/ /bsgom dus sems la blta thabs rnam drug ni/ /res 'ga' sems de gnas shing brtan la blta/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral bar sus shes pa/ /sems nyid rang dbang thob par goms pa'i gnad/ /res 'ga' de dus nyams myong rang ngo blta/ /mi gnas chags yul med par sus shes pa/ / dga' brod rang snang skye med rtogs pa'i gnad/ /res 'ga' yon tan gong 'phel rnams la blta/ /ma 'gag cho 'phrul rang grol sus shes pa/ /skye med yon tan 'byung ba spyod pa'i gnad/ /res 'ga' mnyam gzhag chos nyid don la blta/ /rang byung bde chen ye dag sus shes pa/ /chos kun mnyam nyid lam du slong ba'i gnad/ /res 'ga' phyi nang rig pa rang babs blta/ /'khor ba gzung 'dzin bral ba sus shes pa/ /don dam nyag gcig rtsad nas chod pa'i gnad/ /res 'ga' ma bsgom rig pa rang babs blta/ /lta sgom byar med zang ka sus shes pa/

/chos sku rang ngo cer mthong sprod pa'i gnad/ /gnad drug ldan pa'i skal bzang rnal 'byor pa/ /chos zad ngang du blo zad nyams re dga'/ /ngan pa'i rang bzhin rnam drug spang ba ni/ /ser sna sdug 'khums mi yi phyi ma'i rgyags mi sog /dad med bla ma mi bsten gdams pa'i nor mi sog /gang shes nyams len mi brtson byang chub lam mi rnyed/ mdza' bshes nye 'brel chags pas bar dor zla mi rnyed/ /bdag lta ngar 'dzin chos kyis bdud bzhi'i dpung mi bzlog /'dod pa'i khol po byed pas gtan yul tshugs mi zin/ /ngan pa'i las drug bsags pa'i nyes pa rang la 'khor/ /de bas bzang po'i las la bslab pa gces/ /dgos pa drug gi rang bzhin bshad pa ni/ /dang por yid pham nges 'byung skye dgos te/ /yul la mi 'jug chos la dmigs pa dgos/ /de nas shes pa ngal gso shes dgos te/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su glod shes dgos/ /de nas sems la dbugs chen 'byin dgos te/ /rtogs pa'i gdeng gis nyam nga med pa dgos/ /de nas blo mchog bde chen thob dgos te/ /ka dag sa la mngon du gyur pa dgos/ /de nas bde ba gzhan la spel dgos te/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dren pa dgos/ /de nas mi ldog sa la gnas dgos te/ /lhun grub phyag rgya mngon du gyur pa dgos/ /dgos pa drug gis mthar phyin bya ba gces/ /ma skyol lam du bslang ba'i chos drug ni/ /ma bsgoms sna tshogs 'gyu dran rang ngo ltos/ /gang byung rang sar rang ngo shes pa des/ /cir snang skye med zhing du grol bar nges/ /sgom la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba'i shes pa ltos/ /bde sdug rgyu mthun mnyam par shes pa des/ /blang dor mnyam nyid dbyer med grol bar nges/ /dngos gzhi zag med ma skyes bar la ltos/ /sems nyid kun snang rang bzhin shes pa des/ /rim gyis sems 'jug skye med tshud par nges/ /mnyam gzhag las langs rjes shes ngo la ltos/ /sems nyid don dang gnyis med 'dres shes des/

/mnyam rjes dbyer med ngang du tshud par nges/ /de rjes gang 'gyus rnam rtog rang ngo ltos/ nyon mongs gang skyes rang zhir shes pa des/ /snang shes thog ma'i gzhi la sbyor bar nges/ /sbyor dngos rjes gsum gcig tu dril la ltos/ /gsum ga rjes med bya lam shes pa des/ /dus gsum rang bzhin gnad cig rtogs par nges/ /de ltar shes na rjes shes chos nyid 'char/ /yon tan drug tshang rang bzhin bshad pa ni/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bred nas skyabs 'tshol dang*/ /dad pas rgyud 'dul rgyal ba'i rjes su slob/ /bsod nams che mthong gtong phod tshogs gnyis 'bad/ /brtson pa'i lcag 'debs nyin mtshan dge la 'bad/ /ngo tsha khrel yod chos phyogs srog gtong phod/ /shes rab don dpyod snang shes chos nyid 'khyer/ /de dag tshang rnams 'khor ba'i pha rol 'gro/ /cis kyang dgos pa'i bsgrub bya rnam drug ni/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba mi gtsang 'dam rdzab bor/ /mtha' grol ye shes khri gdugs ci 'char gyis/ /ma rig mun pa'i smag rum ci sangs gyis/ /nyams rtogs sgro btags myu gu ci skyes gyis/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul snang rmi lam ci sangs gyis/ /'bras bu sku gsum nor bu ci lon gyis/ /dam pa'i gdams ngag yin no sems la zhog /rang bzhin mchog la bslab pa'i chos drug ni/ /'khrul ba'i lus kyi bya byed spangs pa dang*/ /don med ngag gi smra brjod spangs pa dang*/ /rnam rtog yid kyi 'phro 'du spangs pa dang*/ /'dod yon rang ga'i zhen 'dzin spangs pa dang*/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i 'brel 'dris spangs pa dang*/ /gzhan sems 'dzin pa'i ngo srung spangs pa ste/ /'di dang su ldan dam chos tshul bzhin 'ong*/ /'dod pa'i gzeb tu bcing ba'i chos drug ni/ /spros pa'i blo dang bral bar 'dod pa dang*/ /bde stong dbyer med zung 'jug 'dod pa dang*/ /dmigs med mkha' ltar rnam dag 'dod pa dang*/ /stong pa ye shes snying po can 'dod dang*/

/rig pa 'od kyi khang bu can 'dod dang*/ /gdod nas ye grol rang byung ye shes 'dod/ /phyogs re'i don mthong glang chen myos pa bzhin/ / bdag lta'i dngos po mtshan ma zhen pa yin/ /de bas phyogs 'dzin bdag lta'i gzeb bor la/ /yin min med pa'i rang rig phyogs bral ni/ /mtha' grol yangs pa chen por thag chod cig /nyams su len pa'i rang 'gag rnam drug ni/ /phyi rol gzung ba'i shes pa rang 'gags dang*/ /nang gi 'dzin rtog shes pa rang 'gags dang*/ /gsang ba snang ngo dmigs pa rang 'gags dang*/ /kho na nyid dran chad chod rang 'gags dang*/ /mthar thug nyams snang rang ngo rang 'gags dang*/ /mnyam rjes res 'jog rig pa rang 'gags te/ /'di drug mthar phyin dgongs pa zad sar skyol/ /ma 'das drug gis nyams su blang ba ni/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma 'das dang*/ /ngag brjod gsung gi 'gro don ma 'das dang*/ /yid ni chos sku'i dgongs pa ma 'das dang*/ /bza' btung bdud rtsi'i mchod las ma 'das dang*/ /'gro 'dug sgyu ma'i 'phrin las ma 'das dang*/ /nyams len chos nyid don las ma 'das dang*/ /rnam pa drug la gang gis bslabs gyur pa/ /gsang mchog rgyal po'i mdzod la spyod pa yin/ / 'khor ba'i rang bzhin dpe drug bstan pa ni/ /gang yang bden med sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'dra/ /de bzhin 'khrul snang sna tshogs rmi lam 'dra/ /snang dus rang bzhin med pa chu zla 'dra/ /bzang ngan bde sdug 'gyur bas sprin dang 'dra/ /tshor dang ma tshor mi rtag zil pa 'dra/ /rang byung rang zhig chu yi chu bur 'dra/ /de ltar rgyud la sbyar te bsgom pa gces/ /myang 'das rang bzhin dpe drug bstan pa ni/ /sna tshogs sems nyid 'dus pa nyi zer snying po 'dra/ /sems nyid skyon gyis ma gos 'dam gyi pad+ma 'dra/ /yon tan lhun gyis grub pa yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /rang gsal rtog pas ma bsgribs nyi zla sprin bral 'dra/ /kun khyab phyogs lhung med pa stong gsal nam mkha' 'dra/

/kun rdzob 'phel 'grib med pas rgya mtsho chen po 'dra/ /de ltar sus shes 'khor 'das gnyis med grol/ /gces pa drug gis rang la bskul ba ni/ /rang mdun (1) rang gis bcad de chos la 'jug pa gces/ /rang bskul rang la btab ste dge sbyor bskul ba gces/ /rang gros rang la btab ste gnyen po bsten pa gces/ /rang las rang gis byas te dka' ba spyad pa gces/ /rang mgo rang gis bton te sgrub pa mthar phyin gces/ / rang gnyen rang gis bskyangs te 'gro drug bsgral ba gces/ /spyi yi gdams ngag yin pas sems la zhog /rgyud dang dge sbyor bsre ba'i chos drug ni/ /dge sdig ci byas yang yang brtag par bya/ /tha mal rang ga'i rnam rtog gdul bar bya/ /rtag tu gus pas gsol ba yeng med gdab/ /bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung bzhin nan tan bya/ /rtogs pa'i gdeng gis rang snang bslang bar bya/ /ci byed phyogs bral dgongs pas zin par bya/ /de ltar byas na thar lam byang chub 'grub/ /chos byed rnams kyi ma song rnam drug ni/ /dad pa'i zhing sa med na bde ba'i 'bras mi 'byung*/ /mkhas btsun bla ma med na rig pa'i mun mi sel/ /skyid bde'i dam chos ma spyad sdug bsngal mtsho mo rdol/ /dge bcus lam sna ma drangs chos kyi rtsa ba shor/ /da lta'i yul nas ma phyin snyoms las sgrog gis bcings/ /shes rab mig dang ma ldan 'khor ba'i g.yang sar lhung*/ /de ltar ma song 'bad pas bsgrub pa gces/ /ma byas re ba drug gi rang bzhin ni/ /sdig spyad ngan song sdug bsngal mi myong re/ /dge ba ma byas bde 'gro thob tu re/ /nyon mongs ma spangs 'khrul ba 'dag tu re/ /tshogs gnyis ma 'bad sangs rgyas thob tu re/ /ci byed tshe 'di byas pas phyi ma bde ru re/ /thar lam chos la ma spyad 'khor bar mi 'khyam re/ /re ba 'dod kyang thog tu mi 'bab mchi/ /bde 'gro mtho ris thob pa'i chos drug ni/ /sngon bsags legs par spyad pa'i las 'phro yod/

/da lta sgo gsum g.yo med drang por gnas/ /sems can rigs la rnam par 'tshe ba med/ /las 'bras dad pas dge sdig shan thang phyed/ /yang dag nges don lta ba bzang la mos/ /dad gus ldan pas chos la brtson pa ste/ /mtho ris dga' bde lag pa'i mthil na yod/ /ngan song 'gro ba dag gi chos drug ni/ /rang gar khro zhing ngang rgyud rtsub pa dang*/ /dge la smod cing sdig pa'i las la bstod/ /thabs kyis gzhan bslu g.yo dang sgyur ldan zhing*/ /gzhan dag phun tshogs mthong la phrag dog byed/ /nor rdzas zhen chags ser sna gtong sems med/ /gzhan la khyad gsod nga rgyal rlom sems che/ /'di dag su ldan ngan song mdun nas bsu/ /sdug bsngal tshad med thar ba'i dus med myong*/ /thar lam bsgrub pa'i dam chos rnam drug ni/ /mos gus drag pos bla ma mkhas bsten la/ /thos bsam rgya skyed rtsa ba chod pa yin/ /byin rlabs mgon skyabs med na bar ma dor/ /bar chod bdud kyis bslu bas dkon mchog khur/ /dgra gnyen yid 'byung ma skye nyon mongs kyi/ /'dam las mi thon chags sdang bdud las khrol/ /shes bzhin bya ras ma zin ngan song gi /g.yang sar skyur pas bag yod rgyun du bsten/ /chos spyod dpung dang mi ldan 'khor ba yi/ /g.yul ngo mi bzlog gso sbyong las la 'bad/ /dmigs med rtsis ma zin na 'dus byas kyi/ /dge bas byang chub mi 'grub shes rab sbrel/ /de ltar brtson na byang chub myur du 'grub/ /tshogs bsag dge la 'bad pa'i chos drug ni/ /yar la gong ma'i bkur sti tshogs che bas/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod pa gces/ /mar la 'og ma'i phan 'dogs tshogs che bas/ /tshad med snying rjes sdug phongs bskyang ba gces/ /nang du phyogs med dam chos tshogs che bas/ /thos pa bsam pa sgom pa brtson par gyis/ /phar la gzhan la phan 'dogs tshogs che bas/ /sems bskyed chos bshad mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mdzod/ /tshur la mtshan ma'i dmigs med tshogs che bas/
/ngar 'dzin rlom sems mtshan mar 'dzin pa spangs/ /bar du gnas lugs bsgrub pa tshogs che bas/ /mthar thug don gyi dkon mchog gsum po bsgrub/ /de ltar spyad na myur du sangs rgyas 'grub/ /

rang phung rang gis bsgrub pa'i chos drug ni/ /byams pas smra ba'i gdams ngag mi nyan te/ /rus sbal kha nas shing shor 'dra bas phung*/ /las ngan byas nas skyid par 'dod pa de/ /khong du dug zos bde bar 'dod 'dras phung*/ /bla ma bor nas sdig grogs bsten pa de/ /skyel ma bzhag nas dgra gseb phyin 'dras phung*/ /lha chos babs nas mi chos spyod pa de/ /rgyal srid babs nas phyugs rta 'tsho 'dras phung*/ /de ltar ma song shin tu gces pa yin/ /ma song drug gis rang gros btab pa ni/ /grong par ma song ri khrod dben pa bsten/ /gdos chos ma song sgo gsum zhi dul ldan/ /blo rgod ma song blo sna chos la khug khrel med ma song khas blangs dam bca' bsgrub/ /dam med ma song bla ma mched grogs bkur/ /sdug 'khums ma song yangs pa khrol le ba/ /blo bde'i mal du nyal ba shin tu gces/ /phongs pa drug gis legs par bsam pa ni/ /pha rgan drin can bla ma bka' drin can/ /brjed du phongs pas bsnyen bkur gsol ba thob/ /ma rgan drin can 'gro drug sems can rnams/ /sdug du phongs pas bde chen lam sna drongs/ /rang nyid dal 'byor rnyed dka'i sgo gsum 'di/ /dal du phongs pas gzhan don dge la bkol/ /grogs mchog rnams dang dngos grub yi dam lha/ /'bral du phongs pas rtag tu gus pas 'grogs/ /bu mchog rang byung khye'u chung mdzes pa 'di/ /'khrul du phongs pas chos nyid btsan sa zung*/ /pha nor sems nyid nor bu rin chen 'di/ /shor du phongs pas ma yengs gces spras kyis/ /gtan srid 'dzin na gdams pa de drug gces/ /chos mthar ma phyin nyes pa rnam drug ni/ /srid par skye ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*/ /chu 'bur sas mi non pa lta bu 'byung*/ /rgas shing 'khogs pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*/ /me tog sad kyis rnying ba bzhin du 'ong*/ /na ba'i sdug bsngal drag po mi 'dod kyang*/ /gser mig nya mo bye tshan bsgres bzhin 'ong*/

/rang gzhan 'bral ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*/ /rnga mo rang gi bu stor bzhin du 'ong*/ /dgra 'dres gnod pa'i sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang*/ /bye'u chung khra yis 'ded pa lta bu 'ong*/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal drag po mi 'dod kyang*/ /mar me rlung gis btab bzhin 'ong ba ste/ /'di dag bsams nas chos la brtson par mdzod/ /'dod kyang mi 'ong gdams pa rnam drug ni/ /bza' tshang nye 'brel 'di dang dus rtag tu*/ /mi 'bral 'grogs par 'dod kyang 'bral bar nges/ /bzang po'i gnas mal 'di ru dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral 'dug par 'dod kyang 'gro bar nges/ / bde skyid longs spyod 'di dang dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral spyod par 'dod kyang 'bor bar nges/ /dal 'byor mi lus mchog 'di dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral rtag par 'dod kyang 'chi bar nges/ /bzang po'i bla ma 'di dang dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral chos nyan 'dod kyang 'bral bar nges/ /dam pa'i grogs bzang rnams dang dus rtag tu/ /mi 'bral 'grogs par 'dod kyang 'bral nges pas/ /de ring nyid nas brtson pa'i go bgos te/ /'bral med bde chen gling du bgrod re ran/ /skyo shas gting nas skye ba'i grogs rnams la/ /chos med sprang po bdag gis de skad bskul/ /mi 'dod ngang gis 'ong ba'i chos drug ni/ /'khor ba'i chos la dgos med rgyab tu bor/ /myang 'das bde ba mi 'dod ngang gis 'ong*/ /dkar po'i chos la dad brtson phyogs med kyis/ /bde skyid dam chos mi 'dod ngang gis 'ong*/ /ci spyod bla ma dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrubs/ /zab mo'i gdams pa mi 'dod ngang gis 'ong*/ /tshad med bzhi la rang gi sems sbyongs dang*/ /gzhan don 'gro don mi 'dod ngang gis 'ong*/ /'dod blo bor la ci yod tshogs su thongs/ /longs spyod 'byor pa mi 'dod ngang gis 'ong*/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa 'du 'bral med pa sgoms/ /'khrul snang bdag 'dzin ngang gis stongs par 'ong*/

/gzhung bzhin bsgrubs na de ltar 'ong bar nges/ /dgos pa'i chos drug legs par bsam pa ni/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'di la skyug log pa/ /ro myags 'dam mthong lta bu'i zhen log dgos/ /mi dge las ngan rnams la 'dzem pa ni/ /bag ma yong ma thag 'dra bag yod dgos/ /chos min las la 'gyod pa'i blo skyes pas/ /skyes bus dug 'thungs sdug bsngal dran 'dra dgos/ /nyon mongs spang bya zil gyis gnon nus pa/ /ri dwags rgyal po 'dra ba'i gnyen po dgos/ /rnam rtog ci skyes rang sar grol nus pa/ /lan tshwa chu thigs 'dra ba'i thug phrad dgos/ /chos dang chos min legs par 'byed shes pa/ /ngang pa'i mchu dang 'dra ba'i shes rab dgos/ /de drug ldan na dam chos kun dang mthun/ /rnal 'byor rab la dgos pa'i chos drug ni/ /lta ba rgyal po 'dra bas sa zin dgos/ /spyod pa blon po 'dra bas dus shes dgos/ /srung sdom sgo srungs 'dra bas rkyen thub dgos/ /shes rab bran dang 'dra bas kun khyab dgos/ /rnam rtog sprin dang 'dra bas rang yal dgos/ /yon tan mdzod khang 'dra bas gang yang dgos/ /de dang ldan na don gnyis lhun gyis grub/ /bzang por bsgrub pa'i dam chos rnam drug ni/ /rje dpon rgyal por 'dod na rang nyid chos la bskul/ /dpa' bo'i rgyal por 'dod na nyon mongs dgra dpung choms/ /gtso bo'i rgyal por 'dod na bka' lung 'dun gros chos/ /mthu stobs rgyal por 'dod na bdag lta'i 'gong po thul/ /phyug po'i rgyal por 'dod na tshogs gnyis longs spyod sgrubs/ /sman pa'i rgyal por 'dod na rang skyon gcong nad thon/ /de ltar shes na lha mi'i gtso bor 'gyur/ /dgra la bag zon bya ba'i chos drug ni/ /chos la nges 'byung dad pa skyes pa'i tshe/ /gnyen 'dun gros 'debs brtse gdung dgra ru ldang*/ /'khor ba'i bya ba thams cad spang ba'i tshe/ / chags zhen 'khri ba rang gi dgra ru ldang*/

/chos spyod zas nor sbyin gtong byas pa'i tshe/ /gzhan gyi khar 'dren rlom sems dgra ru ldang*/ /zab mo'i gdams ngag nyams su len pa'i tshe/ /yid gnyis som nyi the tshom dgra ru ldang*/ /gong 'phel nyams kyi drod rtags shar ba'i tshe/ /dga' brod zhen 'dzin dmigs bcas dgra ru ldang*/ /sna tshogs yon tan 'char sgo phyed pa'i tshe/ /nga rgyal rlom sems rang mthong dgra ru ldang*/ /ldang ba'i dgra la bag zon bya ba gces/ / byams sems bzod pa bsgom pa'i go cha mchog /chos byed mi la ming drug gdags (1) pa ni/ /rang mgo chos su thon na drag po yin/ /sgo gsum dge la 'dzud na dad ldan yin/ /g.yo sgyu zol khram med na bzang po yin/ /log pa'i lam log shes na blo ldan yin/ /mi tshe chos kyis skyel na mdo can yin/ /gzhan phan snying rje che na theg chen yin/ /dam pa rnams kyi spyod lam bslab par bya/ / sdug bsngal rgya las thar pa'i chos drug ni/ /rnyed dka'i mi lus thob nas chos dang 'phrad/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mjal nas mos gus thob/ /'khor ba'i bya ba spangs pas 'du 'dzi med/ /zab mo'i gdams pa 'chang bas gol sgrib med/ / spyod lam dge bas 'da' bas snyom las med/ /bde chen lhun gyis grub pas dmigs 'dzin bral/ /de drug ldan na zug rngu ldang mi nus/ /shes pa drug gi gdams pa bstan pa ni/ /dben par skyo bas gcig pur mi tshugs na/ /sems 'dzin la sogs nyams len med par shes/ /mang po'i mi dang 'grogs par mi shes na/ /thabs la mi mkhas rang rgyud ngan par shes/ /bla ma bsten yang chos min mi spong na/ /de yi byin rlabs yon tan ma 'gos shes/ /khengs shing ma dul nga rgyal che ba na/ /nyams myong rtsi med gnas lugs ma rtogs shes/ / gdams ngag chung la le lo che ba na/ /thar lam mi snyogs 'khor bar 'khyams par shes/ /rang don gtsor 'dzin snying rje med pa na/ /theg chen lam dang sems bskyed med par shes/

/rtags la brten nas nang gi tshul rig pas/ / chos min log par zhugs pa spang 'tshal lo/ /chud gzan drug gi rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /ngan song mi 'jigs sdig pa'i las ngan sog /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor mi lus chud re gzan/ /chos sgor zhugs nas phyogs ris chags sdang byed/ /yang dag don gyi dad pa chud re gzan/ /thos bsam tshig gi nga rgyal rdo 'jong 'chang*/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab chud re gzan/ /zab mo'i gsang sngags nyams len don bzhag nas/ /gnad med brtson 'grus dka' thub chud re gzan/ /zung 'jug gnyis med ye shes mchog bor nas/ /snang stong mthar 'dzin sgom pa chud re gzan/ /ri ngogs dben gnas chos 'grub gnas bzhag nas/ /sde dgon grong 'grim dngos grub chud re gzan/ /de bas de dag lam du ma song gces/ /gong ma'i rjes su snyegs pa'i chos drug ni/ / sdig sgrib bag chags rtsad nas gcod 'dod na/ /sems nyid rang bzhin gzhi rtsa bral ba ltos/ /dgos 'dod nor bu yid bzhin btsal 'dod na/ /zab mo'i lam la rtsol ba rgyun du bsrings/ /gnas lugs don gyi chos nyid rtogs 'dod na/ /btsal bas mi rnyed rang bzhin zhog la ltos/ /gdams ngag nyams len rgyud la sbyor 'dod na/ /rang rgyud thul la de nas nyams su long*/ /snying nas dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub 'dod na/ /tshe 'di blos thongs zhen thag 'khri ba chod/ / gong ma'i rjes su myur du snyegs 'dod na/ /mdzad spyod ltos la sgrub pa snying por gyis/ /'di dag gnad kyi man ngag snying po yin/ /spyi yi tshul dang mi mthun chos drug ni/ /rang gi ngan spyod sna dgu tshang byas nas/ /gzhan dag mgu re chos pa'i lugs ma yin/ /rang gi g.yo sgyu khram gsum tshang byas nas/ /dkon mchog mnyes re chos pa'i lugs ma yin/ /dben pa'i gnas su brtson pas mi bsgrub par/ /chos la re 'khang chos pa'i lugs ma yin/ /tshig tu snying rje lag len rang 'dod sgrub/

/gzhan don 'grub re chos pa'i lugs ma yin/ /sems la bdag 'dzin kha la stong pa nyid/ /thar lam snyogs re chos pa'i lugs ma yin/ / sems la rang lta kha la mtha' bral zer/ /gnas lugs rtogs re chos pa'i lugs ma yin/ /de bas bstan pa spyi yi srol nyams spang*/ /shin tu dge zhing legs pa'i chos drug ni/ /bstan pa gnas shing dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ / 'khor ba'i dong las myur du 'bros re ran/ /thos bsam snying po'i nyams su len dus 'dir/ /rang rgyud khengs pa'i chos dang bsre re ran/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal 'gal rkyen mang dus 'dir/ /sgrub pa'i chos la snying rus bskyed re ran/ /tshogs drug sgo la yul drug shar dus 'dir/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis snang rang sar grol re ran/ /lta sgom spyod pa'i don la bsgom dus 'dir/ /rig pa'i rtsal sbyong phyogs med byed re ran/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma da res bsgrub dus 'dir/ /brtse ba'i gdams ngag 'bad pas sgrub re ran/ /de ltar gnyen pos rang tshod ma zin na/ /'chi dus lus la 'chi bdag bzhad gad byed/ /mi 'grub 'gal ba glab col chos drug ni/ /rang gis rang la rang dbang ma thob par/ / gzhan dbang byed 'dod 'gal ba glab col zhig /rang phan ma bsgrubs phan 'dogs mi nus bzhin/ /gzhan phan sgrub 'dod 'gal ba glab col zhig /rang nyid slob ma'i mtshan nyid mi ldan par/ /slob dpon byed 'dod 'gal ba glab col zhig /rang nyid ko skam bzhin du ma dul bar/ /gzhan rgyud 'dul ba 'gal ba glab col zhig /rang la 'dir rgyag rtogs pa'i gdeng med par/ / gzhan la sgom 'bogs 'gal ba glab col zhig /rang nyid tha mal kun spyod ma log par/ /gzhan dag chos 'god 'gal ba glab col zhig /de 'dra'i rang bzhin skyon gyis ma gos gces/ /dam chos legs par bskul ba'i chos drug ni/ /don med 'jig rten bya ba spong 'dod na/ /dad pa skye dus bya byed 'phro la zhog /byas kyang chu gnyer 'dra ste zin dus med/

/dben pa'i gnas su phyin nas sgrub 'dod na/ /dran dus dran pa shol med de kar song*/ /de dus ma phyin 'gal rkyen shol 'debs mang*/ /bla ma bsten dus ci gsung bka' nyan dgos/ /ngas byas yus kyis thugs zin dus mi 'ong*/ /sems nyid blta dus ma bcos rang bzhag dgos/ /ma bzhag bcos mas rang ngo mthong dus med/ /yon tan 'tshol dus brtson 'grus gnyug bsring dgos/ /ngang thung res 'jog yon tan rdzogs dus med/ /zad sar skyel dus gnas lugs sa zin dgos/ /gzhan du btsal bas rnyed pa'i dus mi 'ong*/ /gnas lugs sgrub pa'i gnyen po rnam drug ni/ /che bzang mtho sa mi gzung dman pa'i 'dug sar bsdad/ /mang po'i mgo dpon mi bya bzang po'i 'og tu zhugs/ /bzang 'dod snyan grags mi sgrub ngar 'dzin ri bo sgyel/ /rang 'dod rgyal kha mi sgug chog shes pham kha blang*/ /mi ngo'i dkar nag mi lta rang rgyud dge sdig lta/ /tshogs drug yul la mi yeng sems kyi rang ngo ltos/ /de ltar rnam pa drug ldan sgrub pa gnad du phyin/ /nges pa rnam drug man ngag bstan pa ni/ /mos gus gdung sems bcas te gsol ba 'debs nus na/ /sems nyid rang ngo rtogs shing byin rlabs 'jug par nges/ /rang babs byar med ngang la lhug par glod shes na/ /rang rig gnyis med ye shes ji bzhin gsal bar nges/ /gnyis 'dzin mtshan ma'i rnam rtog rang ngo blta shes na/ /rang thog bcos bslad med par rang sa grol bar nges/ /'khrul snang gzung 'dzin rnam rtog rang sar 'jog shes na/ /rang dngas mi rtog ye shes rang bzhin 'char bar nges/ /thabs kyis rig pa gcun na gnas lugs gdod ma'i gzhi/ /mi g.yo spros dang bral ba'i lhun grub 'char bar nges/ /snyom las le lo med par brtson 'grus rgyun bsrings na/ /sa lam yon tan drod rtags nang nas 'char bar nges/ /yin pa drug gi rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /gzhan dag g.yo sgyus bslus na rang nyid bslus pa yin/

/gzhan la rgyal kha byin na rang la byin pa yin/ /gzhan la gdug rtsub gnod pa rang la bskyal ba yin/ /gzhan la ji ltar phan btags rang la btags pa yin/ /gzhan la phrag dog gshe skur rang la btab pa yin/ /gzhan don tshogs gnyis ci bsags rang la bsags pa yin/ /de 'dra go ba dkon te rgyud la 'gel ba dkon/ /de bas de nyid don la rang gi sems sbyang bya/ /'dzin pa med pa'i rnam grangs drug po ni/ /dad gus med pa'i mi la thugs rjes 'dzin pa med/ /shes rab med pa'i mi la thos bsam 'dzin pa med/ /dam tshig med pa'i mi la dngos grub 'dzin pa med/ / bslabs kyang mi nyan mi la kha tas 'dzin pa med/ /rang rgyud ngan pa'i mi la chos kyis 'dzin pa med/ /drin gzo med pa'i mi la phan thogs 'dzin pa med/ /chos kyis rdugs par bstan pa rnam drug ni/ /nang nas nyon mongs dgra ru ma mthong na/ /phyi nas bla ma'i gdams pa rdugs par gda'/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba rgyab tu ma bor na/ /nyams len 'grub pa'i dus shig rdugs par gda'/ /rgas ka'i phyi tshis sdug dogs ma spangs na/ /snying nas brtson pa'i dam chos rdugs par gda'/ /nang nas rang la nges shes ma skyes na/ /chos dang bla ma'i mos gus rdugs par gda'/ /'khor ba'i sdig spyod mi dge ma spangs na/ /'phags pa'i thugs rjes 'dren pa rdugs par gda'/ /gcig tu a 'thas bden zhen mi 'dor na/ /phyogs ris med pa'i gdams pa rdugs par gda'/ /yi chad dgod re bro ba'i chos drug ni/ /'dug dang mi 'dug rang dbang cha med pa'i/ /gnas kyi so tshis yi chad dgod re bro/ /spyod dang mi spyod rang dbang cha med pa'i/ /nor gyi gsog brun yi chad dgod re bro/ /gon dang mi gon rang dbang cha med

pa'i/ /gos kyi rtsol sgrub yi chad dgod re bro/ /za dang mi za rang dbang cha med pa'i/ /zas kyi bya byed yi chad dgod re bro/ /'grogs dang mi 'grogs rang dbang med pa yi/ /grogs kyi nyes kha yi chad dgod re bro/ /bstongs dang mi bstongs rang dbang med pa yi/ /bu tsha'i gces spras yi chad dgod re bro/ / 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i spyod pa mthong tsa na/ /yi chad dgod re bro ba shin tu mang*/ /dgos pa drug gi rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /'jig rten bya ba cis kyang 'bor dgos shing*/ /ma rig mun pa cis kyang sangs pa dgos/ /gzung 'dzin mkhar po cis kyang 'gyel dgos shing*/ /nyams rtogs yon tan cis kyang gong 'phel dgos/ /zung 'jug ye shes cis kyang 'char dgos shing*/ /sku gsum nor bu cis kyang lon pa dgos/ /ya cha'i rnam grangs drug po bstan pa ni/ /rab tu byung nas lo mang lon na yang*/ /srung sdom gnang bkag mi shes ya re cha/ / chos sgor zhugs nas lo mang lon na yang*/ /dge sdig da gzod bslab dgos ya re cha/ /theg chen zhugs nas lo mang lon na yang*/ /sems bskyed bslab phyogs mi nye ya re cha/ /thos bsam byas nas lo mang lon na yang*/ /nyams len blo kha ma phyogs ya re cha/ /sgom pa byas nas lo mang lon na yang*/ /drod rtags yon tan ma skyes ya re cha/ /lta ba rtogs nas lo mang lon na yang*/ /dngos zhen 'khrul pa ma zhig ya re cha/ /'di dag mkhar lan thog mar byas rjes su/ /rtsig rming gdod nas blang ba shin tu mtshar/ /brtags shing dgod bro bsams shing yi mug pas/ /dam pa bsten la thos bsam sgom pa sgrubs/ /chos nyid rang chas gnad drug bstan pa ni/ /ma brtag ma dpyad rang ngo rang gis mthong*/ /ma bsams ma phyis 'khor ba ka nas dag /ma bcad ma bkrol mtshan ma rang sar grol/ /ma btsal ma bsgrubs sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /ma spangs ma blangs skyon yon mtha' las 'das/ /ma byas ma 'bad 'phrin las lhun gyis grub/

/de ltar sus shes snying po'i gnad la mkhas/ /bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i gdams ngag rnam drug ni/ /dad med dad pa bskyed la mkhas pa dang*/ /blang dor gnas la slob par mkhas pa dang*/ /sgrub pas gnad du gtong la mkhas pa dang*/ /bar chad bgegs las skyob par mkhas pa dang*/ /zung 'brel snyan brgyud ston la mkhas pa dang*/ /rkyen ngan lam du bsgyur la mkhas pa'o/ /rigs pa drug gi rang bzhin bsten pa ni/ /tha mal nad la sman pa bsten tshod du/ /'khor ba'i nad 'byin bla ma bsten par rigs/ /'jigs pa'i 'phrang la skyel ma bsten tshod du/ /bar do'i skyabs la bla ma bsten par rigs/ /gros 'dun ched du rgan rabs bsten tshod du/ /gtan gyi gros 'dun bla ma bsten par rigs/ /kha nyen dbang gis rje dpon bsten tshod du/ /rkyen ngan zhi phyir bla ma bsten par rigs/ /gru pas thabs mkhas mnyan pa bsten tshod du/ /sdug bsngal mtsho sgrol bla ma bsten par rigs/ /tshong pas rgya mtsho'i ded dpon bsten tshod du/ /byang chub 'grub phyir bla ma bsten par rigs/ /ltos pa drug gi rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /da lta'i nad kyi sdug bsngal zug rngu ltos/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bzod dam soms/ /btson rar bzung rnams 'bros pa'i 'bad rtsol ltos/ / 'khor ba'i btson rar rang brlag byed dam soms/ /tshe 'di'i lto gos rtsol ba byed la ltos/ /gtan gyi so nam da res 'chor ba soms/ /yud tsam 'grogs pa'i grogs ngan skyon la ltos/ /bzod dka'i sems can 'grogs dka' bzod dam soms/ /tha mal g.yang sar bag zon byed la ltos/ /ngan song g.yang sar 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal soms/ /tshe 'di'i bza' tsho shi ba'i mya ngan ltos/ /gtan grogs chos dang bral ba'i rang bzhin soms/ /de ltar bsams na srid pa'i pha rol 'gro/ /nyams su len pa'i man ngag rnam drug ni/ /bar snang ngos la nyi ma shar ba ltar/ /rang byung ye shes gsal stong gnad la dbab/

/ri rab rtse nas ri phran kun mthong ltar/ /sems nyid don mthong dgongs pa'i rtse mor dpyad/ / gser gling phyin dus bong ba mi rnyed ltar/ /yeng rkyen yul rnams chos nyid rang ngo sprad/ /ser bu rdul bral mkha' la 'gyu ba ltar/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma rang sar dngas su gzhug /mtshon tshogs 'phangs pa me tog char gyur ltar/ /ci snang thams cad chos sku'i lam du blang*/ /seng ge rtsal gsum rang la rdzogs pa ltar/ /re dogs mtshan ma mnyam nyid zil gyis mnan/ /de ltar sus shes yang zab gnad la mkhas/ /theg pa'i lam khyer dril ba'i chos drug ni/ /snod bcud 'khrul snang ngo sprad dag snang lam du khyer/ /'khor ba sdug bsngal ngo sprad snying rje lam du khyer/ /'gro drug pha mar ngo sprad byams pa lam du khyer/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ngo sprad sdom gsum lam du khyer/ /dbang bzhi sgo gsum ngo sprad bskyed rdzogs lam du khyer/ /snang grags sems nyid ngo sprad chos nyid lam du khyer/ /de dang ldan na gol sa sgrib pa med/ /le lor mi 'jog gnad kyi chos drug ni/ / dben gnas bas mtha' btsal 'dod phyi thal 'gro /sems la gzung 'dzin dben par bya ba gnad/ /gdams ngag tshig las btsal 'dod phyi thal 'gro / thabs lam nyams len zab mo btsal ba gnad/ /'tsho ba gsog brun ltos pa phyi thal 'gro /gang byung chog shes bya 'tshol bslab pa gnad/ /sgom sgrub brel shom rjes byed phyi thal 'gro /bya byed rtsal 'phro bor nas byed pa gnad/ /nyams rtogs bsags sbyong bskyal (1) te phyi thal 'gro /zab mo gnad bsnun btsan thabs bskyed pa gnad/ /sa lam rim gyis 'tshol ba phyi thal 'gro /sems nyid sku gsum brtan zhing goms pa gnad/ /nyams su blangs na sangs rgyas byang chub 'grub/ /gnas drug don la bslab pa'i chos drug ni/ /nyams pa med pa'i byang chub sems la gnas/ /tshogs gnyis mi ngoms pha rol phyin la gnas/ /shes rab sbyang phyir chos kyi gtam la gnas/

/bsam gtan bsgrub phyir dgon pa dben la gnas/ /'du byed skyung phyir sbyangs pa'i don la gnas/ /sa mchog bsgrub phyir bla ma bkur la gnas/ /de ltar su gnas theg mchog lam chen zhugs/ /nyal na lam drug legs par bstan pa ni/ /lus sems g.yo ba spang phyir dgon pa'i lam/ /bdag gzhan gdung ba med phyir tshang (1) pa'i lam/ / rang bzhin 'gyod pa med phyir legs pa'i lam/ /yon tan bsgrub phyir yang dag 'jog pa'i lam/ /brtsams pa mthar phyin bya phyir grub pa'i lam/ /sngon nas legs par sbyang phyir lhun grub lam/ /mal drug su nyal bde zhing skyid pa yin/ /theg chen rnams kyi 'gro ba'i sa drug ni/ /sangs rgyas chos 'dod chos nyid ngang du 'gro/ /sems can don 'dod gang 'tshams chos ston 'gro/ /rang sems rtogs 'dod dug gsum med par 'gro/ /shes rab thob 'dod chos kyi rgyun du 'gro/ /gdul bya'i dbang gis skye ba kun tu 'gro/ /thar lam 'dod pas bla ma bsten du 'gro/ /de ltar su 'gro sangs rgyas chos bslab yin/ /yid gnas dgos pa'i rnam grangs rnam drug ni/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba rtsom la yid gnas dgos/ /chos la nan tan lhur blang yid gnas dgos/ /bla med byang chub yid zhugs yid gnas dgos/ /gzhan don byang chub sems la yid gnas dgos/ /nyin mtshan chos nyid don la yid gnas dgos/ /nges 'byung skyo shas bskyed la yid gnas dgos/ /de ltar gang byed rgyal sras lam bzang zhugs/ / ngag drug rnam grangs rab tu bstan pa ni/ /sems can spyod pa mi zad ston pa'i ngag /chos tshul rgya mtsho rab tu ston pa'i ngag /sangs rgyas yon tan bsngags pa brjod pa'i ngag /theg chen mi zad rab tu ston pa'i ngag /phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' chos sgras 'gengs pa'i ngag /'khor ba 'jig cing mya ngan 'da' ston ngag /de dag su ldan rgyal ba'i sras po che/ /lus drug rnam 'phrul rab tu bstan pa ni/ /mi rnams smin phyir mi yi lus dang ni/

/ngan song gdul phyir mi ma yin pa'i lus/ /lha dang lha min smin mdzad lus dang ni/ /chung ngu 'dul phyir nyan thos rang rgyal lus/ /theg chen 'god phyir sems dpa'i lus dang ni/ /dbang rdzogs bya phyir longs spyod rdzogs pa'i lus/ /mnga' dbang 'byor ba rnams la lhun gyis grub/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi mgo drug bstan pa ni/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'du ba'i phyir/ /yon tan mchog ldan bla ma 'dud pa'i mgo /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyud mi bcad phyir/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi tshul blangs bsdus pa'i mgo /stong gsum kun gyi bdag por 'gyur bya'i phyir/ /rnam dag zab mo mos pa blangs pa'i mgo /'gro kun byang chub lam la dgod bya'i phyir/ /sems can thams cad yongs su smin byed mgo /gong na med pa'i chos rab grub bya'i phyir/ /shes rab pha rol phyin la gnas pa'i mag khams gsum kun gyis mchod par bya ba'i phyir/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ba'i mgo /de ltar ldan rnams sa mchog dkyil 'khor 'grub/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi rna ba drug ldan ni/ /snyan min snyan thos dgag sgrub med pa dang*/ /nyan nas gtam thos mi 'dod smod mi byed/ /sems dpa' 'byung ba'i gtam thos spro ba skyed (1) / /mi khom skyes thos snying rje'i go cha gyon/ /sangs rgyas bsngags thos 'dod phyir brtson 'grus rtsom/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgra kun brag car shes/ /de ltar nyan pa'i rna ba drug ldan bya/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi lta ba'i mig drug ni/ /'jig rten gzugs rnams blta phyir sha yi mig/sems can rigs rnams blta phyir lha yi mig /sems can dbang po blta phyir shes rab mig /chos rnams ji bzhin blta phyir chos kyi mig /sgrib pa med par bya phyir chags med mig /chos dbyings blta phyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i mig /de dang ldan pas sems can don yongs 'grub/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi lag pa rnam drug ni/

/rgyal mos yid ches bya phyir dad pa'i lag /slong ba yid bzhin tshim byed (1) gtong ba'i lag / the tshom bcad phyir thos pa dam pa'i lag /sems can 'don phyir bde bar 'jog pa'i lag /'gro la chos ston ser sna med pa'i lag /tshogs sdud rgyal mchod rim gro byed pa'i lag /de dang ldan pas chos kyi snang ba ston/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi rkang pa drug ldan ni/ /smon lam rdzogs phyir tshul khrims rkang pa dang*/ /byang chub chos sdud brtson 'grus rkang pa dang*/ /brtsams pa mthar 'byin dam bca'i rkang pa dang*/ /bla ma'i bka' sgrub mthun pa'i rkang pa dang*/ /thos pas mi ngoms shes rab rkang pa dang/ /legs par spyod byed nan tan rkang pa dang*/ /drug ldan skyes bu rgyal ba'i sa rab bgrod/ /bdud kyis mi tshugs go cha rnam drug ni/ /'gro ba skyob pa byams pa'i go cha dang*/ /brtsams pa mthar phyin smon lam go cha dang*/ /'gro ba bsgral ba snying rjes go cha dang*/ /ma rig sel ba shes rab go cha dang*/ /theg chen sems ldan bzod pa'i go cha dang*/ /dge ba mngon sgrub thabs mkhas go cha dang*/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi sa mkhan spyod pa'i grogs/ /mtshon drug 'chang ba'i rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /gnyis 'dzin gcod pa mnyam nyid mtshon dang ni/ /nyon mongs gcod pa shes rab ye shes mtshon/ / log 'tsho gcod pa yang dag 'tsho mtshon dang*/ /'chal ba rgyun gcod tshul khrims rnam dag mtshon/ /ser sna'i gzeb gcod gtong ba'i mtshon dang ni/ / sems can smin byed yongs su mi skyo'i mtshon/ /de dag dang ldan srid pa'i 'khri shing gcod/ /phul du byung ba'i gdams ngag rnam drug ni/ /'gro kun ye nas sangs rgyas shes mod kyang*/ /sems can bsgral phyir tshogs gnyis rgya cher bsgrub/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams mkha' 'drar shes na yang*/ /zhing khams sbyangs la brtson 'grus dpe med rtsom/ /sems can smin la rab tu mi skyo zhing*/ / bdag med don gyi mtshan nyid ma spangs shig

/mngon par shes pas rnam par 'phrul bya zhing*/ /chos dbyings ngang las g.yo ba med par bya/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed mi gtong zhing*/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'byung bar gyis/ /chos kyi 'khor los thams cad tshim byed cing*/ /chos nyid ngang las yongs su 'da' mi bya/ /de dang ldan rnams bde gshegs go 'phang thob/ /bdud kyi las drug shes nas spang ba ni/ /gzhan don sems zhum bsam pa 'khrugs pa dang*/ /don rgya chung ngus mgu zhing gcig las mi bzod dang*/ /chos la the tshom za zhing dam pa'i chos spong dang*/ /sems can smin par mi byed gcig pu thar 'dod dang*/ /rang nyid 'khor bas skrag nas spyod pa rlabs chen 'dor/ /smon lam lhag par mi dmigs nyon mongs zhi bar 'dod/ /'di dag bdud kyi las te ring du spang*/ /gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rtags drug ni/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems mchog skye/ /bdud kyi las rnams shes nas rnam par bzlog /theg chen chos thos de la nan tan byed/ /'khor bar gzhan don sgrub la skyo ba med/ /nyan rang chos ston de la mchog 'dzin med/ /dgongs pa rtogs kyang spyod pa sgrub la brtson/ /rgyal sras chos mchog zhugs rnams mdzad spyod yin/ /chos ston 'dod pa dag gi bdud drug ni/ /mgon por med la dam chos mi ster bdud/ /snod ldan slob ma khyad du gsod pa bdud/ /zang zing ched du dam chos ston pa bdud/ /snod min rnams la zab mo ston pa bdud/ /theg mchog mos pa (1) theg dman ston pa bdud/ /gang mos mi ston phyogs 'byams ston pa bdud/ /'di dag rnams kyis ma bslus shin tu gces/ /slob mas log pa'i bdud drug spang ba ni/ /bshes gnyen bor nas sdig pa'i grogs po bsten/ /lam ston mgon bral bdud kyis zin pa yin/ /theg chen bor nas theg dman nyan pa ni/ /gol sa lam log bdud kyis zin pa yin/ /thar lam bor nas 'jig rten shes bya 'tshol/

/bya byed spyod log bdud kyis zin pa yin/ /skye bar mi dga' mya ngan 'da' don gnyer/ /sems bskyed go cha'i bdud kyis zin pa yin/ /rang gis ma thos dam pa'i chos la smod/ /blang dor 'khrul pa'i bdud kyis zin pa yin/ /dge sdig spang blang chos min mi shes pa/ /ma rig mun 'thibs bdud kyis zin pa yin/ /snod ldan rnams kyis de drug spang ba gces/ /bdud kyi las kyis mi tshugs chos drug ni/ /nga rgyal spangs nas bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur byed/ /khong khro spangs nas gzhan gyi bsngags pa brjod/ / snyom las spangs nas zab mo'i don la brtson/ /phyogs 'dzin spangs nas sangs rgyas chos kun 'tshol/ /phyogs ris spangs nas zung 'jug lam du zhugs/ /bya byed spangs nas sgrub pa snying por byed/ /de dang su ldan bdud dpung 'joms par nus/ /theg chen bslab pa 'chor ba'i chos drug ni/ /dkon mchog spong zhing mchod 'os bslu ba dang*/ /lhag pa'i bsam spangs g.yo sgyus spyod pa dang*/ /rgyal sras rnams la tshig ngan smra ba dang*/ /gzhan dge byed la 'gyod pa byed pa dang*/ / theg mchog zhugs la khong khro phrag dog byed/ /thabs shes ya bral lam la zhugs pa ste/ /'di drug spangs la rtag tu nan tan bya/ /gzhan don spyod tshe phrag dog gshe skur 'byung*/ /de la skyo ba log pa'i chos drug ni/ /rang gis gzhan la smad pa'i rnam smin dang*/ /nyon mongs las ngan 'dzad pa'i thabs chen dang*/ /

nyes kun mtshang nas 'byin pa'i kha ta dang*/ /mtho dman mi byed khyi sgra zugs (1) 'dra dang*/ /bzod pa'i yul 'gyur dge 'phel las yod dang*/ /ngos gzung rjes med stong pa'i cho 'phrul bsten/ /'di dag bsams la khong khro'i zug rngu dang*/ /mi dga' skyo ba spangs la gzhan don bya/ /'khor gyi log sgrub bzod pa'i chos drug ni/ /slar yang lhag pa'i snying rjes gzung ba dang*/ /'khor gzhan rnams la re ba bskyungs pa dang*/ /snga phyir byung ba'i rnam grangs bsam pa dang*/ / rang gi las dang rkyen la bsam pa dang*/ /su dang 'grogs kyang tshul de dpag pa dang*/ /thams cad rmi lam sgyu mar bsam pa ste/ /'khor ngan skyo la gnyen po de drug bsten/ /rtag tu gdab pa'i smon lam rnam drug ni/ /gang du skyes pa'i skye ba thams cad du/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun ldan thob par shog /skyes ma thag tu chos dang phrad gyur cing*/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i rang dbang yod par shog / der yang bla ma dam pa mnyes byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /chos rtogs nas ni snying po'i don bsgrubs te/ /tshe des srid pa'i rgya mtsho rgal bar shog /srid par dam pa'i chos rab ston byed cing*/ /gzhan phan sgrub la skyo ngal med par shog /rlabs chen gzhan don phyogs ris med pa yis/ / thams cad phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /smon lam rgyal po 'di dag rtag tu gdab/ /bsod nams phan yon tshad med nam mkha' bzhin/ /chos mdzod 'dzin pa'i gdams pa rnam drug ni/ /g.yo sgyu med pas dam chos tshol ba dang*/ /chos la nan tan gus pas bsgrub pa dang*/ /gzhan la bstod cing yon tan bsngags pa brjod/ /chos smra rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ /bkur sti rim gro sri zhus rtag bsten cing*/ /skyo ngal med pas chos mdzod 'dzin pa ste/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa rmad byung yin/ /tshad med drug gis 'gro ba drang ba ni/

/sdug bsngal bral 'dod snying rje lag tu blang*/ /bde la 'god 'dod byams pa lag tu blang*/ /bde thob mi 'bral dga' ba lag tu blang*/ /nye ring med pa'i btang snyoms lag tu blang*/ /'jug pa'i chos la dmigs pa lag tu blang*/ /'khor gsum mi rtog dmigs med lag tu blang*/ /sems bskyed spel ba'i don la bslab pa gces/ /sangs rgyas chos drug legs par bsgrub pa ni/ /sems can kun la brtse ba'i mig gis blta/ /bya dang mi bya'i 'du byed (1) ji bzhin shes/ /byang chub chen po'i ye shes ji ltar rtogs/ /sems can don du 'khor ba mi spong zhing*/ /rang bzhin mi rtog 'khor bas gos pa med/ / sangs rgyas 'dod na brtson pas bsgrub pa ste/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi phun tshogs spyod pa yin/ /bar chad drug gi rang bzhin spang ba ni/ /thos nyung grong la sogs par 'jug pa spang*/ /srung sdom mi ldan gzhan gyi bkur sti spang*/ /dbang po ma bsdams bud med lta ba spang*/ /mnyam par ma bzhag dbang po'i 'jug pa spang*/ /lus sems rtsub pas mi mthun gnas pa spong*/ /'tsho ba ma dag tshul 'chos bcos ma spang*/ /de dag ma spangs bdud kyis bslus par 'gyur/ /ngan pa'i grogs drug spang bar gdams pa ni/ /'jig rten rgyang phan mu stegs can mi 'grogs/ /so so skye bo 'di don gnyer mi 'grogs/ /brtse med rang don nyan thos rnams mi 'grogs/ /gzhan phan blo bral rang rgyal 'dod mi 'grogs/ / zang zing rnyed sdud g.yeng bar gyur mi 'grogs/ /rnyed bkur grags 'dod 'khor mang bsten mi 'grogs/ /ngan pa 'grogs na de bas ches ngan 'gyur/ / gces pa'i yon tan rnam drug bstan pa ni/ /bdag med rtogs la sems can snying rje gces/ /stong nyid mos la las 'bras yid ches gces/ /zhi bar gnas la srid par mi gnas gces/ /sbyin pa gtong la rnam smin mi re gces/ /tshul khrims srung la rlom sems spang ba gces/

/dgon par gnas la yo byad skyung ba gces/ /'di drug ldan na dam chos tshul bzhin 'grub/ /dam chos bsten pa'i dgos pa rnam drug ni/ /rang gzhan kun gyi shes rab sbyang ba dang*/ /'khor du 'dus pa'i the tshom bcad pa dang*/ /bstan pa skyong zhing dam chos 'dzin pa dang*/ /blang dor dmigs shes log pa'i lam ldog dang*/ /mtho dman khyad shes zab mo'i lam 'jug dang*/ /grub pa'i mtha' shes gol sgrib chod pa ste/ /chos smra rnams kyis brtson pa'i dgos pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang phrad pa'i chos drug ni/ /bslab gsum tshul khrims rnam dag bsrung ba de/ /rtse gcig ting 'dzin rgyal ba'i skur bsgom dang*/ /mos gus mchod bstod bzlas pa rtag brtson dang*/ /bya byed g.yeng bor sems nyid blta ba dang*/ /nyon mongs med kyang srid na skye ba len/ /g.yel med brtson par dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad/ / lhag bsam rnam dag bzang po'i smon lam 'debs/ /'di drug brtson na rgyal bas rjes su 'dzin/ /srog la babs kyang mi gtong rnam drug ni/ /gzhan don rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems mi gtong*/ /thub pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos mi gtong*/ /'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can blos mi gtong*/ /sgrib sbyong snying po dge ba'i rtsa mi gtong*/ /lam 'dren bla ma yi dam lha mi gtong*/ /'phags lam sa sbyong mthon po'i lam mi gtong*/ /gnyen po stobs su gyur pa'i chos drug ni/ /ji ltar phongs kyang dge sbyor mi 'dor dang*/ /ji ltar bzang yang ngan pa mi brnyas dang*/ /bskul mkhan med kyang gzhan gyi thar lam 'dren/ /phan pa btags kyang lan la re ba med/ /gnod pa bskyal yang gnod lan khong khro med/ /dran dang shes bzhin gnyen po spyod pa'o/ /byang chub chos 'grub thabs mkhas rnam drug ni/ /sems can kun la byams dang snying rje lta/ /'du byed thams cad ji ltar shes pa dang*/ /nyon mongs med kyang srid na skye ba len/

/de yang 'gro la phan pa mi 'dor dang/ /sangs rgyas ye shes 'dod la rab tu brtson/ /thams cad dmigs med mkha' ltar shes pa dang*/ /byang chub bsngo ba thabs mkhas spyod pa yin/ /thabs chen drug gi rim pa bstan pa ni/ /dge ba chung ngu chen por bsgyur ba'i thabs/ /cung zad bsngo dang rjes su yi rang byed/ / tshegs chung bsod nams chen po bsgrub pa'i thabs/ /'phags pa'i gnyen gnas gzhan dag lam du 'jug/ gzhan gyi zhe 'gras khong khro sel ba'i thabs/ /sems can mthun 'jug las bzhis phan 'dogs byed/ /tha mal 'gro ba bstan la drang ba'i thabs/ /mthun pa'i gtam smra zas gos longs spyod sbyin/ /lam zhugs skye bo smin par byed pa'i thabs/ /gang mos blo khrid theg chen bsngags pa brjod/ /smin pa de dag grol bar byed pa'i thabs/ /zab cing rgya chen gnad 'gro'i chos rab bstan/ /de dag dang ldan gzhan don dka' ba med/ / mi mthun lam du 'jug pa'i thabs drug ni/ /mthun par 'jug thabs rang spyod zhi dul gyis/ /gzhan bstod yi rang mthun pas de nas 'jug /bsgrag cing 'geng thabs tshul bzhin khyed bsgrubs na/ /mthun rkyen sgrub ces dam pa'i chos la 'jug /mi mthun 'khrug thabs re zhig khro tshul dang*/ /cung zad gnod bya dam pa'i chos la gzhug /sdig pa'i ngan (1) thabs phan sems sdigs mo yis/ / tshom (2) rngams bya zhing tshul bzhin lam du gzhug /len (3) 'dod thabs ni drin 'og btsud la gzhug /rnam dag thabs ni rnam 'phrul 'gro don te/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis thabs mkhas gzhan phan bya/ /rgya chen don la bslab pa'i chos drug ni/ /'khor ba ji srid 'gro la phan 'dod dang*/ /zhe sdang 'tshe med kun la byams sems dang*/ /rmongs med thabs kyis 'gro ba bsgral 'dod dang*/ /phrag dog med blos mnyam nyid bde 'god dang*/ /nga rgyal rlom med gzhan don 'ba' zhig dang*/ /ser sna'i 'khres med dge tshogs btang blo dang*/ /ldan pas phan bde byed pa
