(4) bslab pa gces/ /bdag 'dzin rtsad nas gcod pa'i chos drug ni/ / rgyal rnams bdag gi mgon skyabs byed pa bzhin/ /bdag gis de dag grogs su ci 'gro bya/ /rgyal sras tshogs rnams mgon skyabs byed pa bzhin/ / bdag gis de dag grogs su gzhan phan sgrub/ /dam can rnams kyis bdag gi grogs byed bzhin/ /bdag gis de dag dam tshig stong grogs bya/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams mgon skyabs gyur pa bzhin/ /bdag gis chos kyi grogs gyur legs bsgrub bya/ /brtse ba'i rang bzhin bdag gi grogs gyur bzhin/ /bdag gis de dag grogs gyur dge la 'bad/ /dam pa'i bla ma bdag gi mgon gyur bzhin/ / bdag gis sems can mgon gyur phan byed bya/ /snyam du bsam zhing gus pas bsgrub par bya/ / rnam dag drug gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni/ /thos bsam rnam dag phyogs med dgongs pa rtogs/ /lta ba rnam dag zung 'jug don la mkhas/ /sgom pa rnam dag gnyis 'dzin rang sar sangs/ /spyod pa rnam dag rang rgyud dri ma med/ /nyams rtogs rnam dag 'gag med rtsal du 'byongs/ /dngos grub rnam dag chos nyid klong du gyur/ /de ltar ldan na theg chen don la mkhas/ /bdag las gzhan gces bsgrub pa'i chos drug ni/ /bdag gzhan blang dor mthong tshor 'di ltar bya/ /bdag gi sdug bsngal khyad du bsad byas la/ /gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zhi la brtson pa bskyed/ /bdag gi bde ba khyad du bsad byas la/ /gzhan gyi bde ba bsgrub la brtson pa bskyed/ /bdag gi dug lnga rnam rtog khyad bsad la/ /gzhan gyi nyon mongs 'joms phyir brtson pa bskyed/ /bdag gi ye shes skye ba khyad bsad la/ /gzhan gyi ye shes bskyed la brtson pa bskyed/ /bdag gi sgrib gnyis sbyong ba khyad bsad la/ /gzhan gyi sgrib gnyis sbyong phyir brtson pa bskyed/ /bdag gi tshogs gnyis bsag pa khyad bsad la/ /gzhan gyi tshogs gnyis bsag phyir brtson pa bskyed/ /de ltar su byed myur du rang don 'grub/

/ dgongs pa dpag par dka' ba'i chos drug ni/ /rgyal sras kun gyi spyod pa ma lus pa/ /gcig tu bsdoms pa bdag gis spyad (1) snyam dang*/ /bdag gis byang chub thob tshe bde gshegs rnams/ /kun mnyam 'phrin las bdag gis bsgrub snyam dang*/ /sems can re re'i phyir yang bdag gis ni/ /bskal pa grangs med sdug bsngal bzod snyam dang*/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis spyad par ma nus pa'i/ /sems can don rab dka' ba spyad snyam dang*/ /dpag tu med pa'i zhing khams re rer yang*/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa bsam yas bsgrub snyam dang*/ / de dag bdag gis rdzogs par ma byas na/ /rgyal ba sras bcas bslus par 'gyur snyam pa'i/ /go cha chen po drug ni rtag tu bgo /bdud kyis mi thub go cha rnam drug ni/ /nya pa shan pa zhing pa dmag mi dang*/ /tshong pa bran khol 'tsho ba tsam gyi phyir/ /tsha grang bkres skom gces pa'i srog dor nas/ /snyom las med par rtag tu sgrub byed na/ /dpe drug mthong nas tshad med 'gro ba'i phyir/ /rnyed dka'i byang chub sgrub la nan tan bskyed/ /bdud drug spang bar gdams pa'i chos drug ni/ /thar lam sems bskyed gzhan don sgom sgrub bor/ /rang don snyan grags bsgrubs na khe grags bdud/ /rang rgyud tha mal gnas las ma 'phags par/ /'phags pa'i spangs rtogs tshig rtsod dred po'i bdud/ /rtse gcig bsam gtan phyi dus rab bzhag nas/ /'bras bu yid smon re ba le lo'i bdud/ /ri ngogs dben pa bsten pa rab spangs nas/ /khe spogs so nam 'bun skyed 'dod pa'i bdud/ /lung rigs man ngag thos bsam rab spangs nas/ /blun sgom yid dpyod spom yor rmongs pa'i bdud/ /rang skyon khong du sbas nas gzhan gyi skyon/ /med kyang sgro 'dogs gshe ba phrag dog bdud/ /rang rgyud bdud kyis ma zin shin tu gces/ /mi bskyod skyon las thar ba'i chos drug ni/ /nyan rang sems kyis mi bskyod ri rgyal 'dra/

/nyon mongs rnam rtog mi bskyod nam mkha' 'dra/ /rnyed bkur 'ching bas mi bskyod 'phags pa 'dra/ /na tsha sdug bsngal mi bskyod sa gzhi 'dra/ /bkres skom tsha grang mi bskyod rgya mtsho 'dra/ /gdon bgegs 'tshe bas mi bskyod me dpung 'dra/ /de dang su ldan theg mchog don la gnas/ /shin tu gces pa'i chos drug bstan pa ni/ /rang bde gzhan bde byed pa shin tu gces/ /gong mas dman pa'i don byed shin tu gces/ /bde legs sems can drin shes shin tu gces/ /gnod lan phan bde byed pa shin tu gces/ /rgyal ba mchod pas sems can don byed gces/ /rang bde bor nas gzhan sdug bsal ba gces/ /'di dag theg chen gzhung srol chen po yin/ /bka' drin che ba'i gdams pa rnam drug ni/ /'tshe bas nyen nas chos dang phrad pa ste/ /thar lam rnyed pas gnod byed bka' drin che/ /sdug bsngal yid dbyung chos dang phrad pa de/ /gtan bde rnyed pas sdug bsngal bka' drin che/ /mi min gnod pas chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /'jigs med rnyed pas 'dre gdon bka' drin che/ /mi sogs sdang bas chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /phan bde rnyed pas sdang byed bka' drin che/ / rkyen ngan drag pos chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /'gyur med lam rnyed rkyen ngan bka' drin che/ /gzhan gyis bskul bas chos dang 'phrad pa de/ /snying po'i don rnyed bskul mkhan bka' drin che/ / mnyam du drin gzo dge ba de la bsngo/ /'tshe ba lam slong gtan tshigs rnam drug ni/ /gnod pa'i skyabs gnas bla ma phrad phyir dang*/ /sdug bsngal skrag nas chos la 'jug phyir dang*/ /tshad med gcig skyes sems bskyed 'phel phyir dang/ / sems can don sbyangs bsag sbyong brtson phyir dang*/ /rang ngo bltas pas rtogs pa bskyed phyir dang*/ /sa lam yon tan gong du 'phel phyir dang*/ /dge la bskul phyir gnod 'tshe dang du blang*/ /gzhan don bsgrubs pa'i phan yon rnam drug ni/

/'jigs kun bskyab pa'i skyel ma byed pa dang*/ /gdon bgegs rnams kyi srung ba byed pa dang*/ /'du ba'i nad sel sman pa byed pa dang*/ /bar chad bdud sel dpa' bo byed pa dang*/ /las dang nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod pa dang*/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas byang chub thob pa ste/ /dpag med phan yon nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin no/ /rab tu bsngags pa'i phan yon rnam drug ni/ / sdig chen ma lus 'joms par byed pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas can gyis bsngags par 'gyur ba dang*/ /'khor ba spang zhing phan bde 'grub pa dang/ /rgyal sras sa thob mchod sdong 'gyur ba dang*/ /tshad med 'gro ba'i ded dpon 'gyur ba dang*/ / gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis phun sum tshogs/ / gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa'i chos drug ni/ /gnas lugs 'gyur med nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ / mi g.yo 'gag med rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ /rtog med 'dod 'byung nor bu lta bu dang*/ /rkyen gyis tha dad ga bur (1) lta bu dang*/ / gsal stong rnyog med me long lta bu dang*/ /kun khyab phyogs med til mar lta bu dang*/ /rnam pa drug tu gtan la dbab pa gces/ /dang po nam mkha' lta bu'i chos drug ni/ /phyogs lhung med pas nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ /rgya chad med pas nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ /yangs dog med pas nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ /mtho dman med pas nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ /kha dog dbyibs med nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ /'khor 'das kun 'byung nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i chos drug ni/ /gnas lugs yangs shing rgya che rgya mtsho 'dra/ /dngos med zang thal gting zab rgya mtsho 'dra/ / blo yis dpag dka' tshad med rgya mtsho 'dra/ /mtha' gnyis mi g.yo dngas pa rgya mtsho 'dra/ /klong yangs ma 'gag rang gsal rgya mtsho 'dra/ /rtog pa'i rba rlabs rang grol rgya mtsho 'dra/ / gsum pa nor bu 'dra ba'i chos drug ni/ /rtog med dgos 'dod 'byung bas nor bu 'dra/ /byung yang phyogs lhung med pas nor bu 'dra/

/gnas lugs rang bzhin dag pas nor bu 'dra/ /rtsal las rgyan du shar bas nor bu 'dra/ /dngas gsal spros pa med pas nor bu 'dra/ /thams cad dbyings gcig rang bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /bzhi pa ga bur 'dra ba'i chos drug ni/ /ma rtogs 'khor ba 'byung bas ga bur 'dra/ /rigs drug sdug bsngal myong bas ga bur 'dra/ /rtogs nas sangs rgyas 'byung bas ga bur 'dra/ /sku gsum zhi bde 'grub pas ga bur 'dra/ /gzhi la gnyis ka med pas ga bur 'dra/ /rkyen gyis tha dad snang bas ga bur 'dra/ /lnga pa me long lta bu'i chos drug ni/ /gnas lugs gzhi nas gsal bas me long 'dra/ /sgrib g.yogs g.ya' dang bral bas me long 'dra/ /rol pa 'gag med 'char bas me long 'dra/ /mtshan nyid gnyis su med pas me long 'dra/ /rtog med ngang dngas gnas pas me long 'dra/ /rang gsal ye nas dag pas me long 'dra/ /drug pa til mar 'dra ba'i chos drug ni/ /sems can sangs rgyas khyab pas til mar 'dra/ /rgyu 'bras skye shi snang bas til mar 'dra/ /sems nyid yul la snang bas til mar 'dra/ /yul rtog sems nyid grol bas til mar 'dra/ /bsgoms na chos skur 'char bas til mar 'dra/ /'bras bu rgyur mi ldog pas til mar 'dra/ /de ltar rtogs na gnas lugs don la mkhas/ /gnyis snang zhen pa gcod pa'i chos drug ni/ /rmi lam dpes mtshon snang ba sems su sprad/ /rmi lam sad pas stong ltar snang ba yang*/ /rang bzhin gyis stong ma rig sangs tshe dag

/ phyi rol yul gyi bden 'dzin 'jig pa yin/ /sgyu ma'i dpes mtshon snang sems nus mthur sprad/ /gang snang gis stong bag chags 'khrul par shes/ /gzugs brnyan dpes mtshon sems nyid rang bzhin sprad/ /snang bas stong ste gzung 'dzin bral bar shes/ /na bun dpes mtshon sems kyi rol par sprad/ /yul snang rang yal stong par rtogs pa yin/ /'ja' tshon dpes mtshon sems kyi rgyan du sprad/ /mkha' la thim ltar rang snang ye shes grol/ /man shel dpes mtshon sems kyi rang gdangs sprad/ /rang ngo rang gdangs gnyis med ye shes grol/ / ngo sprod drug gi bsdu ba'i chos drug ni/ /don gyi kun gzhi gnyis med ris bral dang*/ /de la 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i rang bzhin dang*/ /'khrul snang 'khrul 'dzin rang sems cho 'phrul dang*/ /de las bzlog pa gzhi med rtsal sbyong dang*/ /snang sems rang log ye shes grol ba dang*/ /ye shes rang dngas gdod mar btsan sa zin/ /'di drug chos kyi spyi chings gal po che/ /rtogs pa tsam gyis rang bzhin 'tshengs pa yin/ /zab don mthar thug sku gsum ngo sprod ni/ /rnam pa drug las dang po lhun grub ni/ /shel gong me long nyi zer rnam pa dang*/ /ngang dngas rang bzhin bdag nyid gsum nyid do/ /chos sku rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i ngang*/ /shel gong dri med gdod nas dag pa 'dra/ /longs sku 'dug tshul 'od gsal rang bzhin te/ /me long dag pa'i nang na gzugs brnyan 'dra/ /sprul sku snang tshul phyi nang med bdag nyid/ /nyi zla'i zer bzhin phyogs bcur 'phro ba yin/ /'di dag rang la ye nas lhun grub pas/ /gzhan nas ma tshol rang chas shes par gyis/ /gnyis pa nor bu 'gag med ngo sprad pa/ /rang bzhin gyis dag ngo bo chos kyi sku/ /'od gsal ma 'gag rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs/ /ye shes ma 'gag thugs rje sprul pa'i sku/ /rang chas nyid de gyad kyi nor bu bzhin/ /gsum pa nyi ma rang shar ngo sprad pa/

/nyi ma'i snying po zang thal mi rtog ltar/ /rig pa'i ye shes mi rtog chos kyi sku/ /sprin gyis ma bsgribs rang gsal dag pa bzhin/ /sgo lnga har sangs gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs/ /zer rnams kun tu 'char zhing snang ba ltar/ /yul drug 'char ba ma 'gags sprul pa'i sku/ /nam langs nyi shar 'dra ba'i rang rig la/ /sku gsum rang chas rang ngo shes par gyis/ / bzhi pa dbyings shar nyi mas ngo sprad pa/ /mkha' ltar rnam dag chos nyid chos sku la/ /nyi ltar rang byung 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs/ /rang bzhin gnyis med rig stong sprul pa'i sku/ /rang la yod pa rang ngo shes par gyis/ /lnga pa dpe don rtags gsum ngo sprad pa/ /dpe ni mkha' ltar rnam dag chos kyi sku/ /rgya chad phyogs lhung kun las 'das pa yin/ /don ni 'od gsal rang dag longs spyod rdzogs/ /ye nas lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa yin/ /rtags ni rang 'od ngos snang sprul pa'i sku/ /sgron ma rang gsal yid ches bskyed pa yin/ /drug pa dbyings rig mthar thug sprad pa ni/ /mkha' ltar chos dbyings ka dag chos kyi sku/ /dbyings ltar 'dug tshul 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs/ /phyogs dang bral ltar rig stong sprul pa'i sku/ /rang rig ngang 'dir ye nas grub zin pas/ /gzhan du ma tshol rnyed pa'i dus med do/ /de ltar ma shes rdo ba gser sgrub dang*/ /dmus long gser tshol nyi ma sprin bsgribs dang*/ /rkang med rkas 'dzeg long bas lha khang phyin/ /mun nag zla shar lta bur 'gro ba ste/ /gsal gsal 'dra yang ma rig bag zhar yod/ /de bas ma nor legs par thag bcad nas/ /sems nyid don la brtan pa thob pa gces/ /mnyam rjes 'bral med dgongs pa rnam drug ni/ /dpe rnams drug gis shes par bya ba las/ /dang po bar snang ser bu'i dpes mtshon nas/ /gsal dag ye shes nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang*/ /'gyu ba dag grol rang dngas nyams su blang*/ /zang thal 'dzin med nyams su myong ba yin/

/de ltar ma shes rtse gcig ting 'dzin ni/ /mar me rlung gis bskyod bzhin rkyen mi thub/ /gnyis pa nam langs nyi shar dpes mtshon nas (1) / /ngang dngas gsal 'grib mtha' bral nyams su blang*/ /rang dag gsal dngas ye shes myong ba yin/ /de ltar ma shes rims nad thebs pa ltar/ /bying rmugs 'phro rgod gnas lugs don la sgrib/ /gsum pa rlung med mar me'i dpes mtshon nas/ /snang sems g.yo 'gul med par nyams su blang*/ /ma bcos mnyam pa chen po myong ba yin/ /de ltar ma shes bu chung ngan pa ltar/ /thun mtshams bsgoms pas dgos dus mi bstongs nyid/ /bzhi pa nam mkha' klong yangs dpes mtshon nas/ /gsal khyab mtha' stong phyam gdal nyams su blang*/ /re dogs 'dzin grol dgongs pa nyams su myong (1) / /de ltar ma shes bya bran gshog chag gis/ /mkha' la 'phur bzhin brtson 'grus g.yang sar lhung*/ /lnga pa rgya mtsho rba rlabs dpes mtshon nas/ /rang byung klong thim ngang du nyams su blang*/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum chos nyid klong 'dres myong*/ /de ltar ma shes gzhi la gnyis bzung na/ /dgag sgrub gzung 'dzin yul dang 'bral mi nus/ / drug pa chu phran rgya mtsho dpes mtshon nas/ /rtog tshogs sems nyid ngang 'dus nyams su blang*/ /du ma ro gcig thig le nyag gcig myong*/ /de ltar ma shes yungs kar bang 'thor ltar/ /rtog pa'i rnam grangs snying pos 'dul mi nus/ /de 'dra'i man ngag gnad du bsnun shes na/ /chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor chen po yin/ /de ltar ma shes chu phran skams pa ltar/ /lta sgom spyod pas rkyen mi thub pa yin/ /lta ba'i rang sa gzung ba'i gnad drug las/ /dang po gzung 'dzin med pa'i lta ba la/ /rang rig gnyis med rang sa gzung ba ni/ / yul drug stong pas gzung ba'i mtha' las grol/ /rang gsal ye shes 'dzin pa'i mtha' las grol/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis med gnyis ka'i mtha' las grol/ /mtha' grol ming tsam gnyis med mtha' las grol/

/de ltar rtogs pas gang la'ang zhen 'dzin med/ /gnyis pa yod med rtag chad las grol ba'i/ /lta bas rang sa gzung ba'i man ngag ni/ /rang byung ye shes yin pas med pa'i mtha' las grol/ /rtog pa'i dri ma med pas yod pa'i mtha' las grol/ /yul med ming dang bral bas gnyis ka'i mtha' las grol/ /rol pa gnyis kar snang bas gnyis med mtha' las grol/ /ye grol yongs grol chen por shes par gyis/ /gsum pa skye 'gag grol bar sa bzung ni/ /mkha' ltar skye gzhi ma grub skye ba'i mtha' las grol/ /rol pa ma 'gags 'gag pa'i mtha' las grol/ /skye dus skye med gnyis ka'i mtha' las grol/ /lta byed ma grub gnyis med mtha' las grol/ /rang bzhin dbyings gcig dag par rtogs par gyis/ /bzhi pa snang stong las grol sa bzung ni/ /rang bzhin gsal bas stong pa'i mtha' las grol/ /rnam par mi rtog snang ba'i mtha' las grol/ /dbye bsal med pas gnyis ka'i mtha' las grol/ /gza' gtad med pas gnyis med mtha' las grol/ /rang grol mnyam pa chen por shes par gyis/ /lnga pa rtag chad las grol sa bzung ni/ /ci shar ngo bo stong pas rtag pa'i mtha' las grol/ /stong pa sna tshogs 'char bas chad pa'i mtha' las grol/ /snang stong 'du 'bral med pas gnyis ka'i mtha' las grol/ /lta mkhan rang ngo dag pas gnyis med mtha' las grol/ /thams cad ye nas ma skyes gdod nas dag par gzung*/ /drug pa bzang ngan grol bar sa bzung ni/ /mthon por ma chad bzang po'i mchog 'dzin sangs/ /dma' mor ma chad ngan pa'i spang blo sangs/ /gnyis su ma chad gnyis 'dzin rang sar stong*/ /gnyis med ma chad mu mtha' kun las grol/ /de ltar lta ba'i rdzong chen ma shes na/ /rang tshugs mi thub gol sgrib ldang ba dang*/ /'og ma'i don las bogs mi thon par 'gyur/ /des na sa bzung gnad kyi man ngag gces/ /rnam rtog grogs su slong ba'i chos drug ni/ /rnam shes rang yal ser bu lta bur khyer/

/rang byung ye shes nang nas 'char ba yin/ /'gyu ba rang dag bar snang glog ltar sbyangs/ /ci 'gyus rang gsal ye shes 'char ba yin/ /dran pa rang sangs chu rnyog lta bur khyer/ /ci dran rang byung rgyal ba'i dgongs par 'char/ /ci rtog chos nyid lings pa grogs su khyer/ / blang dor med pa'i dgongs pa khong nas 'char/ /'dzin pa rang zad yul med grogs su khyer/ /gzhi med mthong yal ye shes rang la 'char/ /rang gdangs gsal dag klong gsal grogs su khyer/ /wal po rjes med ye shes khong nas 'char/ /de ltar nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /rnam rtog nyid las ye shes 'char ba yin/ /shing skam dag las me chen 'bar ba ltar/ /thams cad grogs su 'char ba shin tu gces/ /chos nyid ngang la gnas pa'i gnad drug ni/ /rtsa rlung khams rnams rang gnad dgod pa'i gnad/ /lus ni bsam gtan chos drug bca' ba dang*/ /tha mal rang ga'i 'khrul snang dgrol ba'i gnad/ /snod bcud rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor shes pa dang*/ /bde ba chen po rang lugs 'bar ba'i gnad/ /'og sgo bsdams te steng rlung bsdu ba dang*/ /rtog med chos nyid ngang la gnas pa'i gnad/ /lce rtse gyen bzlog rkan gnyis ma reg bya/ /rang gsal ye shes mkha' la dag pa'i gnad/ /mig gnyis mtho gang nam mkhar gtad pa dang*/ /gnyug ma'i ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i gnad/ /sems nyid ma bcos glod nas dngas sangs bzhag /de ltar thabs ldan chos nyid ngang la gnas/ /brtson pas gnad du bsnun cig skal ldan kun/ /chos nyid ngang la bzhag thabs rnam drug ni/ /man ngag drug gis shes par bya ba la/ /dang po dus gsum dbyer med man ngag gis/ /gnyis 'dzin blo yi rtog mtha' bsal ba ni/ /'das rjes mi dpyad ma 'ongs sngun mi bsu/ /da ltar 'dzin med ngang du lhan gyis bzhag /thi bya tshang du 'jug pa'i man ngag gis/ /re dogs gnyis kyi rtog mtha' bsal ba ni/ /da ltar sems la 'byung 'jug gnyis med pas/

/ma yengs mnyam nyid ngang la glod la zhog /skyes bu bya ba btang ba'i man ngag gis/ /gza' gtad 'dzin pa'i rtag mtha' bsal ba ni/ /sems nyid gnas lugs ma bcos mnyam pa'-i ngang*/ /'dzin bral chen por bor la phyam gcig bzhag /khyung chen nam mkhar lding ba'i man ngag gis/ /the tshom gnyis 'dzin rtog mtha' bsal ba ni/ /shes pa mthar bcad rang byung rnal ma'i ngang*/ / yangs pa chen por bor la phyam gcig bzhag /nam langs nyi shar dag pa'i man ngag gis/ /yul snang sna tshogs rtog mtha' bsal ba ni/ /dbang po mi bsdu 'gyu ba mi dgag par/ /tshogs drug lhug par btang ste glod la bzhag /mtshan ma rang sar dngas pa'i man ngag gis/ /sna tshogs rnam rtog rtog mtha' bsal ba ni/ /ci snang yul la blang dor gnyis med par/ /ma bcos so ma'i ngang la ji bzhin bzhag /de ltar bzhag rnams gnyis med ngang gnas pas/ /mtha' grol klong yangs dgongs pa 'char bar nges/ /bsgom pa'i spyi skyon rnam drug bstan pa ni/ /gsal dngas ma phyed mi rtog lteng por song/ /ched du gsal bsgoms ye shes phyogs chad song/ /'phro ba nang bsdus sems 'dzin kol tser song*/ / gting gsal ma rtogs kha 'byams phyal bar song*/ /gting thag ma chod the tshom rkyen dbang song*/ /sgo gsum bcos mas rnam rtog nying 'khrul song*/ /de ltar skyon drug gang byung sgrib pa ste/ /yang dag don 'dod rnams kyis bsal nas bsgom/ /gol sa drug gi rnam grangs bstan pa ni/ /skye mched mu bzhi'i sgom pa yid byed dang*/ /kun rdzob rgyu 'bras med 'dzin chad lta dang*/ /gzung 'dzin mi 'gyur rtag pa chen por 'dzin/ /yul snang dgra dang tsher mar bltas nas song*/ /thams cad sems bsdus rang rig rang gsal bsgom/ /rtog tshogs lhar 'gyur don las 'gyangs pa ste/ /de drug ma song chos nyid phyogs bral klong*/ /mnyam pa chen po'i ngang las ma 'das gces/ /skyon drug byung na bcos pa'i thabs drug ni/

/mkha' la sprin dengs lta bur bcos pa ni/ /sems kyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs ci shar yang*/ /chos nyid mkha' la rang bzhin dngas pas bcos/ /khang stong rkun mas phyin ltar bcos pa ni/ /rnam rtog ngo bo rang bzhin med pa de/ /ci skyes dus nas ma skyes ngos gzung med/ /glod pa tsam las bsal du med par bcos/ /dgun gyi nags me mched ltar bcos pa ni/ /yul rtog ci byung de nyid ngo brtags pas/ /chos nyid grogs su spar bas bcos par bya/ /dug la sngags kyis btab ltar bcos pa ni/ /rnam rtog skye med ngang du bsad pas bcos/ /'bangs kyis rgyal po mthong ltar bcos pa ni/ /dug lnga skye dus ngos gzung rang glod pas/ /chos nyid don dang rang ngo phrad par bcos/ / gzings kyi bya rog lta bur bcos pa ni/ /'phro rgod ci byung chos nyid ldog pa las/ /gzhan du 'gro sa med pa'i ngang du bcos/ /de ltar gnad drug 'gyus dran ci skyes kun/ /rang thog rang dag rang sangs dgrol ba gces/ /yang dag rtogs pa'i gdeng gi rtags drug ni/ /skyon yon gang la'ang dpa' bkong zhum pa med/ /gdos bcas lus la rang sems chos skur zhugs/ /'khor bar ma chags gzhan don skyo dub med/ /gol sgrib phyogs bral thig le nyag gcig rdzogs/ /bdud rnams chos nyid bar chad nyam nga med/ /bde sdug mkha' klong spang blang re dogs med/ /de ltar rtogs rnams gnas lugs mthar phyin 'gyur/ /yang dag brtan pa thob pa'i tshad drug ni/ /snang srid chos rnams sgyu ma'i rang snang zhing*/ /rang bzhin med pa'i rtags la rgyun du 'char/ /nyon mongs ngo bo ye nas ka dag pas/ /dug lnga mi 'khrugs rang gsal ye shes 'char/ /skyon yon ye shes chen por ye shar bas/ /blang dor gnyis kyi 'dun pa rang sangs 'char/ /snying po'i don la gzhan snang med rtogs pas/ /dran rtog chos nyid ngang du gsal ba dang (1) / /sems nyid nor bu rang la rnyed gyur pas/

/'chi 'pho'i 'jigs bral nyam nga med pa 'char/ /rang sems chos nyid sangs rgyas don mthong bas/ /brtson 'grus re dogs 'ching ba grol ba 'char/ /de 'dra'i rnal 'byor mngon par sangs rgyas yin/ /dgongs pa klong du gyur pa'i gdeng drug ni/ /chos rnams mtha' bral dbu mar rtogs pa dang*/ /zung 'jug 'od gsal chen por rtogs pa dang*/ /mnyam nyid bde ba chen por rtogs pa dang*/ /gnyis med thig le nyag gcig rtogs pa dang*/ /lhun grub phyogs bral chen por rtogs pa dang*/ /ka dag rnal mar rtogs pa mthar phyin yang*/ /de dag rtogs par 'dod pa po med cing*/ /rtogs pa nyid la rlom pa'i sems med pas/ /sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor dpe dang bral ba yin/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i grol tshul rnam drug ni/ /phyi rol yul rnams snang ba'i dus nyid nas/ /snang thog grol ba chab rom chur zhu 'dra/ /nang du rig pa'i chos rnams rig dus nas/ /rig thog grol ba chu bur chur thim 'dra/ /bar du 'gyu ba'i yid gnyis 'gyu dus nas (1)/ /'gyu thog grol ba bar snang glog 'gyu 'dra/ /sgra btags ming rnams grag pa'i dus nyid nas/ /ming thog grol ba brag ca'i sgra dbyangs 'dra/ /gzung ba'i grub mtha' 'dod pa'i dus nyid nas/ /'dod thog grol ba mkha' la 'ja' yal 'dra/ /bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu grub thog nyid grol ba/ /nor bu'i rgyal la dgos 'dod 'byung bzhin te/ /rang bzhin rang grol gnyen po rang sar dengs/ /ming med yul bral dgongs par lhun gyis grub/ /de ltar rab rnams skye shi bar dor grol/ /'bring rnams chos nyid bar dor grol ba ni/ /drug tshan gnyis kyis shes par bya ba las/ /lus rgya'i dor lugs rnam pa drug po ni/ /phyi nang sems su 'dus pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /gzung ba'i yul dang bral ba'i dus yin la/ /sems nyid ye shes dbang du 'dus pa'i tshe/ /'dzin pa'i sems dang rang bzhin bral ba yin/ /rig pa'i ye shes bag chags sbubs 'dus tshe/
/sa rlung chu la thim pas lus mi thegs/ /'pho bar bya zhing bshang gci dri ngan 'byung*/ /chu rlung me ru thim pas lus kyi yan lag 'phra/ /byad la rdul chags kha chu sna chu 'dzag

/me rlung rlung thim kha sna'i chu skam zhing*/ /lus kyi drod shor kha sna'i gzi mdangs sdud/ /'di yi dus su rkang mthil drod 'dus na/ /dmyal bar skye zhing gsang bar yi dwags dang*/ /lte ba byol song snying ga mi dang ni/ /mgrin pa lha min mig 'dus lhar skye la/ /spyi bor drod yal bla med 'bras bu 'thob/ /rlung gi rlung rnams rnam shes thim pa'i dus/ /phyi dbugs brtsegs 'byung nang du sdud mi shes/ /mig gi rang 'od sgron ma yal 'gyur zhing*/ /phyi yi dbugs 'chad rnam shes 'od gsal thim/ /nang dbugs 'chad cing lus sems 'bral ba ste/ / lus de der bzhag ye shes dbyings la 'char/ /'di dag thog mar 'byung ba'i thim tshul yin/ /drug tshan gnyis pa dbang po'i grol tshul la/ /rnam pa drug las dang po bstan pa ni/ /dbang po rab kyi rnon po de nyid la/ /bar do mi 'char lus rgya bral ma thag /chos nyid lhag mthong chen por rang gsal nas/ /spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar gnas pa yin/ /gnyis pa dbang po rab kyi rtul po ni/ / skad cig gsum par grol ba thob pa ste/ /lus sems bral ba'i skad cig dang po la/ /rang gsal chos sku rtog bral chen po 'char/ /skad c-ig gnyis par longs sku zer du 'char/ /skad cig gsum par 'od gsal rnam grol nas/ / mkha' ltar mnyam nyid chos sku'i ngang du gnas/ /gsum pa 'bring gi rnon po zhag gcig gam/ /gsum du rtog bral brgyal thabs gnas pa ste/ /de nyid sangs nas ye shes 'od du 'char/ /sku yi rang 'od gsung gi rang sgra dang*/ / thugs kyi zer gdangs zhag lngar 'char dus su/ /sku gsung thugs su rang ngo shes pas grol/ /bzhi pa dbang po 'bring gi rtul po ni/ /zhag gsum par ram lnga ru brgyal thabs gnas/ /de sangs ye shes lnga 'phro 'od gsal te/ /dngangs skrag ma skyes 'jigs med rang snang grol/ /lnga pa dbang po tha ma'i rnon po ni/ / zhag gsum bar du rig pa brgyal thabs gnas/

/de sangs ye shes lnga yi 'odagasal te/ /zhag lnga lon nas ye shes snang ba nub/ /'od las yul dang sgra las zer dang ni/ /zer las rtog par shar dang de yi tshe/ /sngon gyi yul dang nor dang mi rnams kyi/ /dran pa sad dus snga ma'i chos dran nas/ /gnyen po sad de 'dzin med rang gsal gyi/ /ye shes rang shar bar do'i snang ba grol/ /chos dbyings ngang du mngon par byang chub yin/ /drug pa dbang po tha ma'i rtul po ni/ / zhag gcig rig pa brgyal thabs gnas pa las/ /de sangs ye shes snang ba zhag gcig 'char/ /de nub snga ma'i gzugs su yod snyam zhing*/ /dbang po kun tshang gar yang thogs med rgyu/ /rnam shes rten bral yul dang 'dug sa tshol/ / las kyis mngal sgo tha dad 'jug pa las/ /de nyid mi lus yon tan bdun thob nas/ /zab mo'i chos phrad skye ba des grol 'gyur/ /de yang shin tu sdig pa can rnams la/ /bar do mi snang lus sems bral ma thag /rang snang 'khrul nas dmyal bar snang ba yin/ /sdig pa 'bring spyad bar do yun thung gnas/ /de nas ngan song gzhan gnyis myong ba yin/ /dge sdig cha snyoms bar do yun ring ste/ / zhag grangs bzhi bcu rtsa dgu gnas pa las/ /de nas las kyi lus len 'gyur ba yin/ /de yang chos nyid bar do nub pa las/ /rtul po gnyis la srid pa'i bar do 'char/ /de bas da lta mi dge rnam spangs te/ /dge sgrub sems nyid gtan srid zin pa gces/ /phan pa'i gdams ngag yin no sems la zhog / mthar thug 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ /mngon par byang chub chos drug bstan pa ni/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bag chags kun bral nas/ /'khrul snang 'khrul 'dzin dbyings su nub pa yin/ /sprin dengs nyi mkha' bzhin du dag pa'i tshe/ /dang po chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan ni/ /gsal ba'i ye shes chos nyid dbyings su shar/ /spros bral 'od gsal khyab gdal chen po nyid/ /lhun grub ka dag phyogs la grol ba yin/

/gnyis pa longs spyod rdzogs sku dag pa ni/ /de nyid ngang las sa bcu'i sems dpa' la/ /'ja' tshon lta bu rigs lnga gang chen mtsho/ /mtshan rdzogs dpe byad 'bar ba snang ba yin/ /gsum pa sprul sku'i de nyid zla gzugs bzhin/ /gdul bya'i chu snod gang yod der snang ste/ /bzo dang skye ba mchog gi sprul pa sogs/ /gang la gang 'dul de la der snang bas/ /'gro drug gnas na srid pa ji srid bar/ /sems can don mdzad 'phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /sku la brten pa'i ye shes drug ldan ni/ /chos dbyings ye shes chos nyid 'pho 'gyur med/ /me long ye shes rang gsal kun snang gzhi/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ro gcig 'byed pa med/ /kun rtog ye shes ji snyed ji bzhin gzigs/ /bya grub ye shes mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/ /lhun grub ye shes 'dus ma byas nyid ni/ /dpe bral rgyal ba'i ye shes kun gyi bdag /nor bu bzhin du mi rtog don kun 'byung*/ /bzhi pa thugs rje 'gro la 'byung tshul ni/ /sems bskyed smon lam tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ /lhun grub ngang las ye shes stobs kyis 'byung*/ /lnga pa thugs rje ji ltar skye tshul ni/ /rang bzhin shugs kyis thugs rje skye ba dang*/ /yul dang phrad pa'i thugs rje skye ba dang*/ /bskul zhing gsol ba gdab las skye ba'o/ /drug pa de las 'gro don mdzad tshul ni/ / rten can rten med ngo bo nyid gsum ste/ /phyogs char chad rnams 'di bzhi nges bya ba/ /chos skus go 'byed rten med don mdzad cing*/ /smon lam sems bskyed nus pas sgrib sbyangs te/ /'gro la gzugs sku snang bar mdzad pa'o/ /longs sku ye shes thugs rje rang snang bas/ /rten can don mdzad sa bcu'i sgrib pa sbyong*/ / ngo bo nyid kyis don mdzad dbyings kyi sku/ /yod med sgro skur zhi ba'i ngang nyid las/ /gdul bya rnams la gang 'dod der snang bas/ /sna tshogs sprul pas don kun mdzad pa yin/

/grub pa'i mtha' las rten can don mdzad pa/ /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa de na/ /sku dang ye shes grub pas don mdzad 'dod/ /rten med de ltar grub pas 'gag med de/ /'on kyang drang srong mchod sdong bsgrubs pa bzhin/ /smon lam dbang gis de ltar snang bar 'dod/ /ngo bo nyid kyis don gnyis mdzad pa yang*/ /de dag gnyis ltar yod med sgro skur grol/ /dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku de las/ /ji ltar 'tshams par bzhag nas don byed 'dod/ /'di dag gsum yang don la gcig dgos pas/ /snga ma lta bur khong du chud par bya/ /de yis phyogs 'dzin yod med gzeb las grol/ /de ltar bla med byang chub brnyes pa ni/ /so so skye bo mos pa phun tshogs la/ /thun mong khyad par mchog gi lam gsum la/ /brten nas 'bad pas rim gyis gong bgrod de/ /yon tan yid bzhin lhun gyis grub pas na/ /thar lam bsgrub la rang bzhin 'bad pa gces/ /deng sang dus ngan bsams shing skyo ba 'phel/ /tshe la long med yeng ma'i lam la 'dzad/ /shes bya thug med spros la zad pa med/ / de bas nyin mtshan snying po'i chos sgrubs shig /tshe 'di'i bya ba shi shir zin dus med/ /gcig gis gcig khrid chu yi gnyer ma 'dra/ /'chi dus bstongs sam legs par ser thob la/ /de ring nyid nas thar pa'i byang chub sgrubs/ /gar 'gro cir 'gyur bdag la cha yod pa/ /sus bstongs 'dir bde mi 'jigs gdeng ci yod/ /de bas da lta rang dbang yod dus su/ /gtan yul thar pa'i gnas su snyegs re ran/ /lus dang longs spyod mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba ma lus kun bor nas/ /gcig pu sus kyang mi bstongs 'gro ba soms/ /de dus skyabs dang dpung gnyen tshol re ran/ /da lta'i 'di bzhin gtan du mi 'ong bas/ /gnam sa 'dre ldog 'chi bdag 'byung ba'i tshe/ / bdag gis ci bya de dus su la re/ /de bas da lta dam pa'i chos sgrubs shig

/ mdzangs dang gros 'dun mkhas dang mi mkhas dang*/ /'chi dus rag ste dge ba'i dpung tshogs bskyed/ /snying po'i sems nyid gnyug ma'i don la sgoms/ /mtho ris bde 'gro'i dga' bde lhun gyis grub/ /thar ba'i gnas bzang rin chen pho brang du/ /rgyal bas sngun bsu rang rig ye shes mchog /byang chub 'byor pa shin tu mtha' yas shing*/ /rtag tu mi 'gyur bde chen don la spyod/ /chos med sprang po bdag gis de skad bskul/ /phan pa'i snying gtam lags kyis sems la zhog / de ltar chos tshul yon tan rin chen mdzod/ /drug tshan res kyang snying po'i don 'grub pa/ /yid bzhin rin chen gdams pa'i snying po 'di/ /dad ldan thar ba bsgrub rnams don du spros/ /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /ma lus bde gshegs snying po'i sar gzhol nas/ /spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan phun tshogs te/ /don gnyis lhun grub chos kyi rgyal por shog /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /srid na mi skyo sems can don bsgrub cing*/ /dam pa rnams las chos kyi mdzod thos te/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pas rgyal ba mnyes par shog /byang chub thob kyang sems can mi 'dor zhing*/ /'khor bar gnas kyang nyes pas kyang mi gos/ /mthong thos dran reg thar pa'i lam 'dren pas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rab tu mnyes par shog /skal ldan rnams la zab mo'i chos ston cing*/ /skal med rnams la chos kyi sa bon 'debs/ /sgrub pa lhur len nyams len mthar phyin pas/ /dpal mgon bla ma dam pa mnyes par shog / man ngag rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la mang du thos pa'i nor gyis 'byor zhing*/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don la/ thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa'i shes rab kyis legs par sbyangs pa/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/
